items.text:
Edit: added parts about social and modding.

Full of bugs, poor design around every corner, and questionable balance. Also very unique, with absolutely no alternative.

Would I play it more? Absolutely. Would I enjoy it? Probably not. That's the nature of a toxic relationship.

Now, a little bit more in depth:

[h1]Bugs.[/h1]

There are a lot. Honestly, at some point I'm not entirely sure what is a bug and what is bad design. FPS drops, script errors, physics, memory leaks, everything would be broken at some point. I liked it a lot one time when the game created all files for a save, but didn't put them into a zip archive and couldn't read this save file. Easy fix, though.

[h1]Poor design[/h1]

Well, the list would be as long as the game features. Basically, everything that you would do in this game would be made in the most stupid, time-consuming, unfun way. I'm pretty sure that AI slop would make a better design. Here is a little list of examples:

When you load the game, the splash screen with update info is right before loading. I think it doesn't block the loading itself, it's just its placement is very inconvenient.

* UI is just plain bad. All of it. Like, when you're in a helmet, it blocks your UI. Because of this, I missed a very important button for 30 hours. All bags are just a fit of tedious micromanagement. Character traits are just a long list of perks without much formatting. Visor in damage mode doesn't let you see building marks, and it's VERY NEEDED to see them in that mode. When you dock, "Match speed" and "Prox Warn" alarms are not in the dock screen, AND YOU REALLY NEED THEM IN THE DOCK SCREEN.

* Quests are just 98% plain text, without barely any choices, no scene art, not even book formatting.
AI. It's very long to describe how poor the AI in this game is, it's easy to find info on all problems with it. Let's just say they often choose death instead of being part of this game. But without jokes, many people decide to play without crew at all and not deal with AI. I guess that says a lot.

* Close-quarters combat is rudimentary. Well, it's just not fun at its core and stupid. Why the hell do people with lethal wounds in vacuum die after like 5 minutes?

* Ship building. It mostly works. But there is absolutely no dry dock in the game, so you need to do it in vacuum, and that means you need to deal with AI and micromanage them, because they can randomly stop changing batteries or O2 tanks and just die. It's also a HUGE TIME SINK. At least 15 of my playtime hours were spent waiting for things to be done.

[h1]Loot[/h1]

It's sad to say, but you will see 80-90% of loot in the first 4 hours in the starter playground. There is just barely any WOW effect, not many things to be discovered. No gold mine to strike. It's just a tedious, steady grind. This problem is tied to general economy balance. In a game about making coin by salvage and exploration, this was a HUGE LETDOWN.

[H1]Social combat/NPC dialogues [/H1]

You know, I like it on paper. I think I even grasp what you need to do for results. But there is no real explanation of the system in the game or on the internet. But in reality, it's a mesh of bad UI and poor action feedback to the player. First, why do you need to look at 3-4 different parts of the screen to see the outcome of your actions after every click? Second, why do stats jump like mad when you click on an option with a simple outcome? NPCs 80% of the time answer gibberish because they play the same system, and you also say a lot of gibberish. There's really good gameplay here, but it's buried under layers of undercooked implementations.


[h1]Balance[/h1]

Well, it's shaky at best. Economy is weird and very artificial. As I said, it's a problem tied to loot. Without interesting, varied loot, it's hard to balance the economy. So they made GIGS. So you don't need to look for 10-20k ships, you can take a gig that will pay you 30k for a VERY easy task at the ship, and you can also loot this ship. But gig payments crumble under their own weight, because they're balanced around distance. So you have delivery gigs that pay you 1500, and the same delivery gigs that pay you 10mil. So, why would I salvage anything in this game about salvaging things, when I can just travel from A to B and make 2000% more profit?

Little bit about combat balance. Imagine, you're a skilled space suit user. You're in vacuum. You have a crowbar. You feel brave and on top of your game. You have no combat experience. And your enemy is a poor space suit user. He has insomnia and is on the edge of a breakdown. He's terrified. He has a pocket knife. He's 1 level higher than you in combat. Who would win? Of course, the enemy. He will absolutely destroy you with his bare hands; he wouldn't even use the pocket knife. I guess that's fair.

[h1]Mods[/h1]
Modding community is strong for a generally low playerbase. But they mostly fix annoying and bad design and UI, but they can't fix everything. This is a job for the developer. There really shouldn't be a mod that mutes the proximity alarm when you're docked, or a mod that adds EVA suit lockers, or a mod that lets AI grab multiple items before starting to work with said items. This all should be part of the base game like yesterday.

--------

So no, I can't recommend this game to anyone. Developers shouldn't release games in such a poor state out of desperation. But yes, I would probably play it more, because this is a way of a toxic relationship.
items.text_zh:
编辑：添加了关于社交和模组的部分。

到处都是bug，每个角落的设计都很糟糕，平衡性也值得怀疑。同时它又非常独特，完全没有替代品。

我会玩得更多吗？绝对会。我会享受它吗？大概不会。这就是有毒关系的本质。

现在，再深入一点：

[h1]Bug。[/h1]

有很多。老实说，到了某个时候，我都不完全确定什么是bug，什么是糟糕的设计。帧率下降、脚本错误、物理、内存泄漏，一切都会在某个时候出问题。有一次我特别喜欢的是，游戏为一个存档创建了所有文件，但没有把它们放进zip压缩包，然后无法读取这个存档文件。不过修复很简单。

[h1]糟糕的设计[/h1]

嗯，这个清单会和游戏功能一样长。基本上，你在这个游戏里做的每件事都会以最愚蠢、最耗时、最不好玩的方式来完成。我很确定AI生成的垃圾都能做出更好的设计。这里有一个小例子清单：

当你加载游戏时，带有更新信息的启动画面就在加载之前。我觉得它不会阻止加载本身，只是它的位置非常不方便。

* UI就是纯粹的糟糕。全部都是。比如，当你戴着头盔时，它会挡住你的UI。因为这个，我错过了30个小时里一个非常重要的按钮。所有背包都只是一堆繁琐的微观管理。角色特质只是一长串没有多少格式的perk。伤害模式下的面罩不让你看到建筑标记，而在那个模式下看到它们是非常必要的。当你停靠时，“匹配速度”和“接近警告”警报不在停靠界面里，而你在停靠界面里真的非常需要它们。

* 任务98%都是纯文本，几乎没有选择，没有场景美术，甚至没有书籍排版。
AI。描述这个游戏里的AI有多糟糕需要很长时间，很容易找到关于它所有问题的信息。我们就说他们经常选择死亡，而不是成为这个游戏的一部分。但不开玩笑地说，很多人决定完全不带船员玩，不跟AI打交道。我想这说明了很多。

* 近身战斗很简陋。嗯，它的核心就是不好玩而且愚蠢。为什么在真空中受了致命伤的人会在大概5分钟后死掉？

* 飞船建造。它基本上能用。但游戏里绝对没有干船坞，所以你需要在真空中进行，这意味着你需要处理AI并微观管理他们，因为他们会随机停止更换电池或氧气罐，然后直接死掉。这也是一个巨大的时间黑洞。我至少有15个小时的游戏时间花在等待事情完成上。

[h1]战利品[/h1]

说起来很遗憾，但你会在新手游乐场的前4个小时里看到80-90%的战利品。几乎没有什么WOW效果，没有多少东西可供发现。没有金矿可挖。这只是一个乏味、稳定的刷。这个问题与总体经济平衡有关。在一个通过打捞和探索赚钱的游戏中，这是一个巨大的失望。

[H1]社交战斗/NPC对话 [/H1]

你知道，理论上我喜欢它。我想我甚至明白你需要做什么才能得到结果。但游戏里或网上都没有对这个系统的真正解释。但实际上，它是糟糕UI和对玩家行动反馈不佳的混合体。首先，为什么你每次点击后都需要看屏幕上3-4个不同的部分才能看到你行动的结果？其次，为什么当你点击一个结果简单的选项时，属性会疯狂跳动？NPC有80%的时间回答的是胡言乱语，因为他们玩的是同一个系统，你也会说很多胡言乱语。这里确实有很好的玩法，但它被层层未煮熟的实现埋没了。


[h1]平衡[/h1]

嗯，往好了说也是摇摇欲坠。经济很奇怪而且非常人为。正如我所说，这是一个与战利品相关的问题。没有有趣、多样的战利品，就很难平衡经济。所以他们做了GIGS。这样你就不需要寻找1-2万的飞船，你可以接一个GIG，在飞船上做一个非常简单的任务就能付你3万，而且你还可以打捞这艘飞船。但GIG的报酬在自身重量下崩溃了，因为它们是围绕距离来平衡的。所以你有付你1500的送货GIG，也有付你1000万的同样的送货GIG。那么，在这个关于打捞东西的游戏中，我为什么要打捞任何东西，当我可以从A旅行到B并赚取多2000%的利润时？

关于战斗平衡说一点。想象一下，你是一个熟练的太空服使用者。你在真空中。你有一根撬棍。你感到勇敢，状态极佳。你没有战斗经验。而你的敌人是一个可怜的太空服使用者。他失眠，处于崩溃边缘。他吓坏了。他有一把袖珍刀。他在战斗中比你高1级。谁会赢？当然是敌人。他会赤手空拳绝对摧毁你；他甚至不会用袖珍刀。我想这很公平。

[h1]模组[/h1]
对于一个总体玩家基数很低的游戏来说，模组社区很强大。但他们大多修复烦人和糟糕的设计与UI，但他们不能修复一切。这是开发者的工作。真的不应该有一个模组来在你停靠时静音接近警报，或者一个模组来添加EVA服储物柜，或者一个模组让AI在开始处理物品之前抓取多个物品。所有这些昨天就应该成为基础游戏的一部分。

--------

所以不，我不能向任何人推荐这个游戏。开发者不应该出于绝望而发布处于如此糟糕状态的游戏。但是的，我可能会玩得更多，因为这是一种有毒关系的方式。
系统，而且你也会说很多胡言乱语。这里确实有很好的玩法，但它被层层半生不熟的实现埋没了。


[h1]平衡[/h1]

嗯，往好了说也是摇摇欲坠。经济很奇怪，而且非常人为。正如我所说，这是一个与战利品相关的问题。没有有趣、多样的战利品，就很难平衡经济。所以他们做了GIGS。这样你就不需要去找价值1万到2万的飞船，你可以接一个在飞船上完成非常简单的任务就付你3万的活儿，而且你还能搜刮这艘飞船。但任务报酬会在自身重量下崩塌，因为它们是按距离平衡的。所以你有付你1500的送货任务，也有同样的送货任务付你1000万。那么，在这个关于打捞东西的游戏里，我为什么还要打捞任何东西，当我可以直接从A到B旅行并多赚2000%的利润？

稍微说说战斗平衡。想象一下，你是一个熟练的太空服使用者。你在真空中。你有一根撬棍。你觉得自己很勇敢，状态正佳。你没有战斗经验。而你的敌人是一个可怜的太空服使用者。他有失眠症，正处在崩溃边缘。他吓坏了。他有一把袖珍小刀。他在战斗方面比你高1级。谁会赢？当然是敌人。他会赤手空拳把你彻底摧毁；他甚至不会用那把袖珍小刀。我猜这很公平。

[h1]模组[/h1]
对于一个总体玩家基数很低的游戏来说，模组社区很强。但他们大多修复烦人的糟糕设计和UI，却无法修复一切。这是开发者的工作。真的不应该有一个在你停靠时静音接近警报的模组，或者一个添加EVA宇航服储物柜的模组，或者一个让AI在开始使用物品前先抓取多个物品的模组。这些早就应该成为基础游戏的一部分。

--------

所以不，我不能向任何人推荐这款游戏。开发者不应该出于绝望而把游戏以如此糟糕的状态发布。但是的，我可能还会多玩一些，因为这是一种有毒关系的方式。

observations.evidence: they often choose death instead of being part of this game. But without jokes, many people decide to play without crew at all and not deal with AI
observations.evidence_zh: 他们常常选择死亡，而不是成为这个游戏的一部分。但不开玩笑地说，很多人决定完全不带船员游玩，不去应付AI

items.text: I really, really wanted to like this game. The initial gameplay loop of exploring wrecks and pulling the copper out of the walls is really fun. I have no idea why they didn't just lean into making that the whole game when they weren't willing to clean up the rest of it. NPC communication is clunky and pointless. The Jobs are very lackluster, they're all just travel somewhere or beat up someone and deal with the inability to keep a prisoner. Survival is trivial. You can live in your EVA suit at the cost of burning through more water and downtime so why bother pressurizing your vessel at all until you're rich and well fed enough for it not to matter and the rewards from one early game salvage run will keep you fed in high quality food for the rest of the game. It's still riddled with bugs, poor communication of mechanics, and has little to do once you get you first ship remodeled and running. This has the skeleton to be an outstanding title, but it would require such a hard pivot from the direction the game has been going in that I don't think it'll ever manifest. The majority of my time was spent repeating the first 10 hours over and over due to constantly have to restart from gamebreaking errors or from being on fast forward and my guy walked outside without his helmet for the fun of it.
items.text_zh: 我真的、真的非常想喜欢这款游戏。最初探索残骸、从墙壁里拽出铜的游戏循环真的很有趣。我不明白为什么他们不愿意把其余部分收拾干净，却不肯干脆把这一点做成整个游戏。NPC交流既笨拙又毫无意义。任务非常乏味，全都只是去某个地方或者揍某个人，还要应付无法关押囚犯的问题。生存要素微不足道。你可以靠你的EVA服活着，代价只是消耗更多水和停机时间，所以在你足够富有、吃得够饱，以至于这些都无所谓之前，何必费心给自己的飞船加压呢？而且早期一次打捞任务的奖励就能让你在游戏剩下的时间里一直吃上高质量食物。它仍然满是bug，机制说明糟糕，而且当你把第一艘船改装好并运转起来后，就几乎没什么可做的了。它具备成为一款杰出作品的骨架，但这需要从游戏一直以来的方向上进行如此艰难的转向，我觉得它永远不会实现。我的大部分时间都花在反复重复最初的10个小时上，因为不断得从破坏游戏的错误中重启，或者因为开着快进而我的角色为了好玩没戴头盔就走到了外面。

items.text:
Where is the Fun ?
I love games like Dwarf Fortress, I enjoyed the EA (because it was EA), but the 1.0 feel worse to play. I discover the fire update and I can only thing: WHY???? Your ship burn ALLLLLL the time! Every actions in the game are tedious, even opening a bag! Crew AI didn't improved, you're just better to play alone, because micro manage your character is already a nightmare, imagine two or more guys... Combat is horrible and don't work with more than one char ? Switching char reset the actions.

This game is just pain. The UI make everything tedious. Ultima 7 in the 90s was 100x better. If AI was smart enough, it could work, but no, you have to micro everything. Huge potential, killed by UI & UX.
items.text_zh:
乐趣在哪里？
我喜欢《矮人要塞》这样的游戏，我享受过EA阶段（因为那是EA），但1.0玩起来感觉更糟。我发现了火焰更新，我只能想：为什么？？？？你的飞船一直一直一直在燃烧！游戏里的每一个操作都很繁琐，连打开一个包都是！船员AI没有改进，你最好还是单人玩，因为微操你自己的角色已经是一场噩梦了，想象一下两个或更多家伙……战斗很糟糕，而且不止一个角色时根本行不通？切换角色会重置动作。

这游戏就是痛苦。UI让一切都变得繁琐。90年代的《创世纪7》要好上100倍。如果AI足够聪明，它或许能行，但没有，你必须微操一切。巨大的潜力，被UI和UX杀死了。

items.text:
The idea of the game is great, i supported with early access a long ago and I returned to it with every major milestone, but very disappointed in 1.0
The problems are: there are too many things that do not work as intended or are just plain bugs.
The core loop, at the start at least, is
- find ship -> disassemble ship -> sell parts -> complain that you don't have money -> repeat

BUT
- the automated commands for disassemble, build and haul to hangar zones do not work well
> they are laggy
> they are buggy: you unistall a wall that had a power conduit in it? If you give the command Haul restricted to electrical things, the wall gets hauled in the elettrical zone of your hangar too. And so it's with a lot of other things
- After the first one or two ships you have to use the automation IA of the characters to do things, but it's simply crap as:
> it prioritize things in a non easy to undestarnd way, and there is no control over its priorities
> it's buggy: it get stuck doing the same things, it takes in game minutes to figure out what to do

Then also: it's a sci-fi building / exploring game and you have to manage your resources and keep track of items... but there is no way of knowing things like
> My ship consumes 70W, ok: which part is draining power, how can I manage that? i cannot know, and the simple answer is just power down thing MANUALLY when you dont need them. 
I'm building a spaceship, but i don't get basic logic circuits to manage it.

Like: i'm docket at port -> power down air systems or navigation or whatever.
The Fun would be building those systems and see them work or fail. If you give building capabilities then... you have to have them, you cant just have a middle ground.

I really hope they improve this basic mechanics as they really bug the the whole game which is good
items.text_zh:
这个游戏的点子很棒，我很久以前就在抢先体验阶段支持了它，并且每次重大里程碑更新我都会回来玩，但对1.0版本非常失望。
问题在于：有太多东西没有按预期运作，或者干脆就是纯粹的bug。
核心循环，至少一开始是
- 找到飞船 -> 拆解飞船 -> 卖掉零件 -> 抱怨自己没钱 -> 重复

但是
- 用于拆解、建造和搬运到机库区域的自动化命令运作得不好
> 它们很卡
> 它们有bug：你拆掉一面里面有电力导管的墙？如果你下达限制为电气物品的搬运命令，那面墙也会被搬运到机库的电气区域里。很多其他东西也是如此
- 在最初一两艘飞船之后，你必须使用角色的自动化AI来做事情，但它简直就是垃圾，因为：
> 它以一种不容易理解的方式排列优先级，而且无法控制它的优先级
> 它有bug：它会卡住反复做同样的事情，要花游戏内好几分钟才能弄清楚该做什么

然后还有：这是一款科幻建造/探索游戏，你必须管理资源并追踪物品……但根本没有办法知道诸如
> 我的飞船消耗70W，好吧：哪个部件在耗电，我该如何管理？我无法知道，而简单的答案就是在你不需要它们时手动关闭设备。
我正在建造一艘宇宙飞船，但我却拿不到用来管理它的基础逻辑电路。

比如：我停靠在港口 -> 关闭空气系统或导航或其他什么。
乐趣本应是建造这些系统并看着它们运作或失败。如果你给了建造能力，那么……你就必须拥有它们，你不能只搞个折中方案。

我真的希望他们改进这些基础机制，因为它们确实搞坏了整个游戏，而这游戏本身是好的

items.text:
1.0, but still incredibly buggy. Give it a bit.

Pretty decent storylines, or at-least what they're consisting of so far is pretty good. The game, even after 'full release' is basically Bethesda-coded, with bugs that range from minor annoyances to "I had to restart my 60 hour save because of this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ bug." And some of the worst combat I've seen in a game like this. 

Ideas to make the game less of a misery:
-Fix the horrible bug that disables your ability to actually construct anything, despite having the tools and items to do so
-Get rid of the annoying loading splash screen (Why do we gotta' click? Just load.)
-Fix the god-awful lag/stuttering/freezing issues
-Fix the scroll-wheel's zoom rubber banding after exiting a menu.
-Fix the horrible PDA files ui
-Fix the strangely low spawn rate for Heavy Water containers.
-Make it obvious which PDA is yours in the files menu
-Make it impossible for police to warrant you when a ship's transponder is off.
-O2 tank refill auto-shutoff
-Player-placed items REMAIN the player's property. (That's my battery charger, stop arresting me because I picked it up.)
-Allow docking at stations while towing a vessel
-Make most containers on-board ships and station private property so I can't just yoink someone's weed cigs.
-Different ways of reaching other planets without having to grind for RL days to get a Torch Drive.
-More space horror
-Add the transit kiosks in a tram-like station so we aren't just teleporting to other parts of stations.
-More advancements from certain NEOScavenger plots.
- Less tedious sleep/super-fast skip mechanic
- Refined auto-task coding (No, I don't want you to stand there with an empty power drill, PUT your fully charged back-up battery in it!)
items.text_zh:
1.0，但仍然bug多得离谱。再给它点时间吧。

剧情还算不错，至少目前的内容相当可以。这游戏即使在“正式发布”之后，基本上还是贝塞斯达式的，bug从轻微烦人到“因为这个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥的bug我不得不重开我60小时的存档”都有。而且战斗是我在这种游戏里见过最糟糕的之一。

让游戏不那么痛苦的想法：
-修复那个可怕的bug，它会让你无法实际建造任何东西，尽管你有工具和物品
-去掉烦人的加载启动画面（为什么非得点一下？直接加载就行了。）
-修复那糟糕透顶的卡顿/掉帧/冻结问题
-修复退出菜单后滚轮缩放的回弹问题
-修复糟糕的PDA文件界面
-修复重水容器生成率异常低的问题
-在文件菜单里明确标出哪个PDA是你的
-让警察在飞船应答器关闭时无法通缉你
-O2罐加满后自动关闭
-玩家放置的物品保持为玩家财产。（那是我的电池充电器，别因为我把它捡起来就逮捕我。）
-允许在拖拽船只时停靠空间站
-把飞船和空间站上的大多数容器设为私有财产，这样我就不能随便顺走别人的大麻烟了
-提供不用为了弄到火炬引擎而肝现实里好几天就能到达其他星球的不同方式
-更多太空恐怖
-在有轨电车式车站里加交通亭，这样我们就不是直接传送到空间站其他部分了
-某些NEOScavenger剧情线有更多进展
-减少繁琐的睡眠/超快跳过机制
-改进自动任务编码（不，我不想让你拿着空电钻站在那里，把你充满电的备用电池装进去！）

No, its not worth your time. When you need a mod so AI can pick up stacks of parts for repairs and they can't grab everything they need to repair or build something at once that is a waste of your real life time.

items.text:
Coming as someone who ONLY played this after the 1.0 release - 

An amazing, great game. One of the best of all time maybe.
But only If you can tolerate the janky UI and total lack of documentation on what is actually a feature of the game, and what isn't.

So, why do I love it so much? Well, it's the most immersive spaceship game I've ever played. It's not just about piloting the spaceships - it's about living a simulated life *as* a spaceship captain. 

In this game, everyone, including you, needs to sleep somewhere, drink, eat, use the toilet, and socialize.

I've visited bars on the space station just to chat and flirt with random people in order to address my psychological needs. I've used coffee as a replacement for sleep, and suffered the consequences. I've engaged in idle chitchat with someone with the intention of pivoting to the subject of hiring them as crew - and succeeded. 

I've spent hours alone working on my ship, sending my needs for achievement, privacy, and security to the best they can possibly be, while my needs for socialization, belonging and intimacy tanked.

I've left the helm unattended, risking colliding with something just to get a few extra minutes of repairs in before I need to take control again. 

I've shut off alarms because they annoyed me, only to die because I forgot they were off and I didn't get the warning in time.

I've accidently left my air pumps on and didn't notice my ship was pressurized to ~50 times earth atmosphere until I started hearing metal creaking from the fusion fuel tanks inside my ship being crushed.

I've been pressed into my pilot seat by gforces from accelerating. I've had crew members fall over while they were working when I did a sudden maneuver.

I've died to fires in my ship, and I've had my life saved by my CO2 alarm going off while I was piloting. I've vented the entire cabin into space to get rid of the smoke and co2, and lived to tell about it. I've fled into the space station from a fire on my ship while docked, only to die of heat stroke, burns, and inhalation of smoke and co2.

I've accidently walked into space without a sealed suit too many times to count, and usually lived. One time I did so while working on my ship in dock, and barely made it into the pressurized station - at the end I was moving at a snails pace, on the verge of blacking out, body pressed to the absolute limits. A minute or so of rest, and I went back to work on my ship, now a little smarter.

I've subdued or killed pirates with my fists, a tactical knife, a 9mm pistol, and a katana. I've had pirates panic after shooting at them several times, even though I didn't hit them. I've sold a colt 1911 I found on a junked ship because I have no idea where to buy .45 ammo in this backwater I'm stuck on. I sold a cutlass I found because who needs one when they already have a katana.

I finally assembled a fusion reactor, and figured out how to start it. I also made a small mistake and seriously wore it out and almost exploded it. I reloaded a save game to avoid having to find a new one that hadn't been taken to the verge of ruin by a stupid newbie. Then I figured out what I did wrong, and successfully started and used the reactor without damaging it.

I've been putting things like bedrooms, bathrooms, and exercise rooms in my ship - in preparation for my first journey from this junkyard rock in the middle of nowhere, to an actual place like the cloud cities of Venus, affluent Mars, the moon (which I've been told is haunted) or the United States Military Industrial Complex, located on the moon Titan. Just some of the examples of places I could go, from The Sun, out to the Oort cloud. 81 hours in and I've barely scratched the surface!


So what's bad? Mostly the UI. 

The UI works, it tells you what you need to know, and lets you do what you need to do - but you will need to spend maybe 20 hours figuring out just the basics of what the f it's telling you, and how the f you do the things.

For the first 10-20 hours playing, if you're like me you're going to be asking yourself WTF did that just happen (haven't learned how to read the UI yet, don't know what's possible within the game),

Why did my character/this NPC do this stupid fatal thing (probably because I told it to do that stupid thing, or it wasn't actually stupid).

Why does this ship part work in this stupid way (it probably doesn't work that way, or the way it works is actually not stupid). 

Why do I have to micromanage everything all of the time! (don't have to micromanage everything all of the time, but learning how to use the install planning / orders system and the tasks system is a whole new learning experience compared to directly controlling your character).

That was my experience anyway. 

Finally, bugs. As near as I can tell everything important in the game works fine, which I consider a miracle given the scope of the game. So I don't know what all the "this game is buggy and unplayable!" people are talking about. 
 
That being said, I have experienced the following 6 things that I believe are bugs:

1. The one system I've encountered that seems flat out bugged and not working seems to be pirates surrendering - the game seems to imply I can give a surrendered pirate orders or take control of them somehow, but I've never had any control whatsoever over them. Can't even ask them to drop their weapon, frisk them, or restrain them. They do stop attacking for a while, but that's it.

2. Speaking of dumb pirates, sometimes when a pirate jumps me and docks to my vessel - instead of actually boarding me they just stay on their ship and do random tasks. Also it seems like I can just undock from forced docking? I've yet to have permission to undock refused. Seems like a bug?

3. I've also had occasional stuttering that sucks but is still playable - it seems to happen after a while playing, and goes away after quitting and reloading. 

[strike]4. The game hasn't crashed on me yet, but it does hang when I quit the game more often than not, and I have to force close. Annoying, but not game breaking in any way.[/strike] Fixed by a post release patch.

5. Sometimes the character interaction leaves me hanging at "waiting for the other person to respond". But this is relatively rare/situational and seems to resolve itself eventually. Unfortunate and I hope they fix it, but again - not unplayable.

6. Last bad thing - sometimes NPC ships ignore the speed of their ship and the limits of the human body. I didn't see this happen until relatively recently when a pirate jumped my extremely fast ship. I dodged them, outran them, out accelerated them - but then, they went from rapidly falling behind me to surging into me in an amount of time that would have turned them into goo. After killing them I observed that their ship wasn't that fast either. Devs, this sucks - please fix it.


So overall? This game has been amazing. Not broken, not unplayable. Just has a really high UI learning curve, a few non fatal technical issues, and some unfortunate bugs. Maybe all the game breaking stuff happens after the 81 hour mark?
items.text_zh:
作为一个只在1.0发布后才开始玩这款游戏的人——

一款令人惊叹的、伟大的游戏。也许是有史以来最好的游戏之一。
但前提是你能够忍受那蹩脚的UI，以及完全没有文档说明游戏中哪些是真正的功能、哪些不是。

那么，我为什么这么喜欢它呢？嗯，这是我玩过的最具沉浸感的太空飞船游戏。它不仅仅是驾驶太空飞船——而是*作为*一名太空飞船船长过着模拟生活。

在这款游戏中，每个人，包括你自己，都需要找个地方睡觉、喝水、吃饭、上厕所、社交。

我去过空间站上的酒吧，只是为了和随机的人聊天、调情，以满足我的心理需求。我用咖啡代替睡眠，并承受了后果。我和某人闲聊，意图把话题转向雇佣他们作为船员——而且成功了。

我独自花了几个小时在飞船上工作，把我的成就、隐私和安全需求提升到尽可能最好的状态，而我的社交、归属感和亲密需求却一落千丈。

我让舵位无人看管，冒着撞上什么东西的风险，只为在我需要重新掌控之前多挤出几分钟的修理时间。

我关掉了警报，因为它们烦我，结果却因为忘了它们关着、没能及时收到警告而死。

我不小心让空气泵一直开着，直到我开始听到飞船内部聚变燃料箱被压碎时金属发出的嘎吱声，才注意到飞船被加压到了约50倍地球大气压。

我被加速产生的G力压在驾驶座上。当我突然机动时，有船员在工作时摔倒。

我死于飞船上的火灾，也曾在驾驶时因二氧化碳警报响起而获救。我曾把整个舱室排空到太空中以清除烟雾和二氧化碳，并活了下来讲述这件事。我曾因停靠时飞船上的火灾而逃进空间站，结果却死于热射病、烧伤以及吸入烟雾和二氧化碳。

我不小心没穿密封服就走入太空的次数多到数不清，而且通常都活了下来。有一次我在船坞里修理飞船时这么做了，勉强进入了加压的空间站——最后我以蜗牛般的速度移动，濒临昏厥，身体被逼到了绝对极限。休息了一分钟左右，我又回去修理飞船，现在稍微聪明了一点。

我用拳头、战术刀、9毫米手枪和武士刀制服或杀死了海盗。我曾让海盗在朝他们开了几枪后惊慌失措，尽管我并没有打中他们。我卖掉了一艘废弃飞船上找到的柯尔特1911，因为我完全不知道在这个我困守的穷乡僻壤哪里能买到.45弹药。我卖掉了一把找到的弯刀，因为已经有武士刀了谁还需要它呢。

我终于组装好了一个聚变反应堆，并弄清楚了如何启动它。我也犯了一个小错误，严重磨损了它，差点把它弄爆炸。我重新加载了一个存档，以避免不得不去找一个新的、还没被某个愚蠢新手折腾到濒临报废的反应堆。然后我弄明白了自己做错了什么，并成功启动和使用了反应堆而没有损坏它。

我一直在往飞船里放卧室、浴室和健身房之类的东西——为我的第一次旅程做准备，从这个位于荒无人烟之地的废品场岩石，前往一个真正的地方，比如金星的云城、富裕的火星、月球（有人告诉我那里闹鬼）或者位于土星泰坦上的美国军工联合体。这些只是我能去的地方的一些例子，从太阳一直延伸到奥尔特云。玩了81个小时，我几乎还没触及皮毛！


那么有什么不好的呢？主要是UI。

UI能用，它会告诉你需要知道的东西，让你做需要做的事——但你可能需要花大约20个小时才能弄清楚它到底在说什么鬼东西，以及你到底该怎么做这些事。

在玩的前10到20个小时里，如果你像我一样，你会问自己这到底发生了什么（还没学会怎么看UI，不知道游戏里什么是可能的），

为什么我的角色/这个NPC做了这件愚蠢的致命事情（可能是因为我叫它做了那件蠢事，或者它其实并不蠢）。

为什么这个飞船部件以这种愚蠢的方式工作（它可能不是那样工作的，或者它的工作方式其实并不蠢）。

为什么我时时刻刻都得微观管理一切！（不必时时刻刻微观管理一切，但学习如何使用安装规划/命令系统和任务系统，与直接控制你的角色相比，是一种全新的学习体验）。

反正这就是我的经历。

最后，bug。据我所知，游戏中所有重要的东西都运行良好，考虑到游戏的规模，我认为这是个奇迹。所以我不知道那些说“这游戏bug多到没法玩！”的人在说什么。

话虽如此，我遇到过以下6件我认为是bug的事情：

1. 我遇到的唯一一个似乎彻底出bug、无法正常运作的系统，似乎是海盗投降——游戏似乎暗示我可以给投降的海盗下命令或以某种方式控制他们，但我从来没能对他们有任何控制权。甚至不能叫他们放下武器、搜身或捆绑他们。他们确实会停止攻击一段时间，但仅此而已。

2. 说到愚蠢的海盗，有时当海盗跳到我船上并停靠到我的飞船时——他们并不真正登船，而是待在自己的船上做随机任务。而且似乎我可以直接从强制停靠中脱离？我还没有被拒绝过脱离许可。看起来像个bug？

3. 我偶尔也会遇到卡顿，很烦但还能玩——似乎玩了一段时间后会出现，退出并重新加载后就消失了。

[删除线]4. 游戏还没有在我这里崩溃过，但退出游戏时它经常卡住，我不得不强制关闭。烦人，但绝不至于破坏游戏体验。[/删除线]已由发布后补丁修复。

5. 有时角色互动会让我卡在“等待对方回应”。但这相对罕见/视情况而定，而且似乎最终会自行解决。很不幸，我希望他们能修复它，但再次强调——并非无法游玩。

6. 最后一件坏事——有时NPC飞船会无视自己飞船的速度和人体极限。我直到最近才看到这种情况发生，当时一艘海盗船跳到了我极快的飞船上。我躲开了他们，跑赢了他们，加速超过了他们——但随后，他们在本应把他们变成糊状的时间内，从迅速落后于我变成猛冲撞向我。杀死他们后，我观察到他们的飞船其实也没那么快。开发者们，这很糟糕——请修复它。


所以总体而言？这款游戏一直很棒。没有坏掉，并非无法游玩。只是UI学习曲线非常高，有一些非致命的技术问题，以及一些不幸的bug。也许所有破坏游戏的东西都发生在81小时之后？

items.text: Not a big fan of y'all banning someone for "misinformation" because he has the apparent wrong opinion on the games current state. I haven't even experienced most of the reported issues yet but there's so many quality of life thins that should just be plain obvious to fix years ago (thank god for modders so I can simply haul what I uninstall without having to micro). Not to mention talking to NPCs seemed buggy, but I figured it was a one off issue, now that I read it's a common occurrence and apparently recommended to just not deal with them? How is this 1.0 worthy. It certainly actually feels like a game unlike the early days, but it seems to need more than the one year of support it's allegedly even going to get.
items.text_zh: 不太喜欢你们因为某人“散布虚假信息”就封禁他，只因为他对游戏当前状态显然持有错误的观点。我甚至还没经历过大多数被报告的问题，但有太多生活质量方面的事情，几年前就应该显而易见地修好（感谢模组作者，这样我就可以直接搬运我卸载的东西，而不用手动微操）。更不用说和NPC对话似乎有bug，但我以为那是一次性的问题，现在读到我发现这是常见现象，而且显然建议干脆别和他们打交道？这怎么配得上1.0。它确实感觉像一款游戏，不像早期那样，但它似乎需要的支持不止据称它将获得的那一年。

items.text:
Ostranauts is definitely not easy to recommend in its current state as of 1.0.  It's got jank and a lot of half-baked features, but the hard sci-fi elements of salvaging, building and piloting ships around the solar system is fun enough.  Traveling long distances feels equally rewarding and risky, as lack of preparation, improper planning or a piloting mistake will leave you stranded.  That said, you'll probably get a more complete experience if you wait a while for more patches to be added and mods to be developed.

Here a few things that I dislike about the current state of the game:

-NPC interactions.  I like the idea, but interacting with NPCs is just bland at the surface level once you understand the minigame.  There is hardly any unique dialogue outside of the rather few story missions.
-Speaking of missions, NPCs will randomly ask you, a seemingly complete stranger, to do a task for them that involves finding someone, talking to them (beating them up first being optional sometimes), and then traveling back.  The "someone to find" is random and sometimes on a completely different planetary body, or in my case, driving a police patrol craft in deep space 1.2 AU from Ganymede, where they should have been stationed.  Oh, and there is no reward for these, so I'm not really sure what the point is.  (The actual story missions are neat, but few and far between.)
-Lack of ship VFX.  We're under thrust using a torch drive burning at 4gs spinward, yet ships have no visible drive plumes.
-Stats of ship components are not visible anywhere.  For example, the mass and durability of walls and floors vary based on the manufacturer, but this isn't listed anywhere in-game and cannot be viewed outside of obtaining a mass scanner plugin for your PDA, which you probably won't find until you've already added on to your ship.  This applies to basically every electronic item in the game too.
-NPC crew member controls.  During scheduled work time, NPCs will often ignore orders and just do whatever the hell they want.  The only way I could get them to stop "studying" on the computer I installed in the break room was to unplug it during working hours.  Also there needs to be global orders you can quickly give that override other activities, such as "emergency repairs" and "secure for maneuvering" (to you know, get in a crash couch before they are crushed to death.)
-Lack of advanced hauling/bartering zone controls to let you specify exactly where items should be stored, and for NPCs to actually haul items to be stored there.  Currently, if I purchase scrap, it ends up in my fridge, even though the fridge is set as a "food only" zone.  The opposite happens too.  
-Physics simulation is a little too simple.  It doesn't matter where you put your thrusters or where your center of mass is, the ship behaves the same regardless.  Aerodynamics is determined entirely by mass and how many heavy lift rotors and aerodynamic hull parts you have, not necessarily the shape of the ship.  There is no explosive decompression, and atmospheric flight using heavy lift rotors needs a pass.  (Specifically, you have to have an even number of clockwise and counter-clockwise spinning heavy lift rotors, otherwise you get stuck in a death spin.  There is no way to change direction other than unpowering and repowering them.)
-Inventory is just weird.  You have a space suit, but no specially designed bag to carry stuff around in while in a space suit, so your character has to occupy a hand by dragging around a backpack permanently.
-No way to automate putting on/taking off a suit.  Until a person spends enough time in a space suit (upwards of a month from what I can tell), they suffer a severe work speed penalty.
-Lack of proper airlocks.  You're always briefly leaking atmos when crew enter/leave the ship because airlocks are effectively two doors put a few feet apart, with no way to "cycle" airlocks.
-Lack of crew retention and benefits.  Crew are paid a pathetic amount daily.  You could be bringing in millions in a trade run, but they're only getting $250.  Micromanage them too hard or don't meet one of their needs (which are somewhat obfuscated), and they'll just up and quit on you, and there is no way to give them a higher salary until they decide to quit.  A way to reward hard work (because crew do slack off)/match their pay to the skills they've developed since joining, and maybe even a healthcare plan to automate the treating those nasty blisters they got when your ship suddenly lost pressure and their skin boiled would be a really nice addition.

These are just to name a few, and thankfully, there are a few mods that can cover some half-baked features and IMO should be included in the full game:

"Ship's Water" - A mod that adds water tanks, showers, waste water storage/processing and the ability to bulk purchase water.  Otherwise, you're filling up bottles in slowly recharging sinks on stations, or tediously buying containers of it.  Crew need to drink and bathe with water with or without this mod, but this makes managing water much less tedious. This is seriously a "must have" mod.

"Uninstall and Haul" - In Vanilla, when you first dock with a wreck, you can run through and mark anything you want to salvage in-tact with an "uninstall" order.  Unfortunately, you will then have to order it to be "hauled" back to your ship after the component was uninstalled.  This mod adds a combined order that will save you a ton of time and needless tedium.
items.text_zh:
就1.0版本目前的状况而言，《Ostranauts》绝对不容易推荐。它有不少毛病和大量半生不熟的功能，但在太阳系各处打捞、建造和驾驶飞船这些硬科幻元素还是足够有趣的。长途旅行既让人感到有回报又充满风险，因为准备不足、计划不当或驾驶失误都会让你被困在途中。话虽如此，如果你等上一段时间，等更多补丁加入、模组开发出来，你可能会获得更完整的体验。

以下是我不喜欢游戏当前状态的一些地方：

-NPC互动。我喜欢这个想法，但一旦你理解了这个小游戏，与NPC互动在表面层面上就显得平淡无奇。除了相当少的故事任务之外，几乎没有任何独特的对话。
-说到任务，NPC会随机要求你——一个看似完全陌生的人——为他们做一项任务，包括找到某人、与他们交谈（有时可以先揍他们一顿，这是可选的），然后再返回。那个“要找的人”是随机的，有时在一个完全不同的行星体上，或者就我的情况而言，在距离木卫三1.2天文单位的深空中驾驶一艘警察巡逻艇，而他们本该驻扎在那里。哦，而且这些任务没有奖励，所以我真不太确定意义何在。（实际的故事任务很不错，但少而间隔很远。）
-缺乏飞船视觉特效。我们正在使用火炬驱动器以4g的加速度向旋进方向推进，但飞船却没有可见的驱动尾焰。
-飞船部件的属性在任何地方都看不到。例如，墙壁和地板的重量和耐久度因制造商而异，但这在游戏内任何地方都没有列出，除非为你的PDA获得一个质量扫描插件，否则无法查看，而你很可能在已经给飞船加建之后才会找到它。这基本上也适用于游戏中的每一件电子物品。
-NPC船员控制。在预定的工作时间，NPC经常会无视命令，想干什么就干什么。我唯一能让他们停止在我安装在休息室的电脑上“学习”的办法，就是在工作时间里拔掉电脑电源。此外还需要可以快速下达、覆盖其他活动的全局命令，比如“紧急维修”和“固定好准备机动”（你懂的，让他们在被压死之前坐进防撞座椅。）
-缺乏高级搬运/交易区域控制，无法让你精确指定物品应该存放在哪里，也无法让NPC真正把物品搬运到那里存放。目前，如果我购买废料，它最终会出现在我的冰箱里，即使冰箱被设置为“仅限食物”区域。反过来也会发生。
-物理模拟有点太简单了。你把推进器放在哪里、你的质心在哪里都无所谓，飞船的表现都一样。空气动力学完全由质量和你有多少重型升力旋翼以及空气动力学船体部件决定，而不一定是飞船的形状。没有爆炸性失压，使用重型升力旋翼的大气飞行也需要重新调整。（具体来说，你必须拥有偶数个顺时针和逆时针旋转的重型升力旋翼，否则你就会陷入死亡旋转。除了断电再重新通电之外，没有办法改变方向。）
-物品栏就是很奇怪。你有一套太空服，但没有专门设计的包可以在穿着太空服时携带东西，所以你的角色必须占用一只手，永久拖着一个背包。
只能永久拖着一个背包，占用一只手。
-无法自动穿上/脱下宇航服。在一个人在宇航服中待够足够长的时间之前（据我所知要一个月以上），他们会遭受严重的工作速度惩罚。
-缺乏真正的气闸。每当船员进出飞船时，你总是会短暂地泄漏大气，因为气闸实际上只是相隔几英尺的两扇门，无法对气闸进行“循环”。
-缺乏船员留存和福利。船员每天的报酬少得可怜。你可能在一次贸易运输中赚到数百万，但他们只拿到250美元。对他们微观管理得太狠，或者没有满足他们的某项需求（这些需求有些模糊不清），他们就会直接辞职不干，而且在他们决定辞职之前，你没有办法给他们更高的薪水。一种奖励辛勤工作（因为船员确实会偷懒）/让他们的薪酬与他们加入后发展出的技能相匹配的方式，甚至也许一个医疗计划来自动治疗当你的飞船突然失压、他们的皮肤沸腾时他们得到的那些讨厌的水泡，将会是非常棒的补充。

这些只是列举几个，幸运的是，有一些模组可以覆盖一些半成品功能，在我看来应该被纳入完整游戏中：

“Ship's Water”——一个添加水箱、淋浴、废水储存/处理以及批量购买水的能力的模组。否则，你只能在空间站上缓慢补水的洗手池里灌瓶子，或者繁琐地购买一箱箱的水。无论有没有这个模组，船员都需要用水喝水和洗澡，但这让管理水变得不那么繁琐。这绝对是一个“必备”模组。

“Uninstall and Haul”——在原版中，当你第一次与一艘残骸对接时，你可以跑过去并用“卸载”命令标记任何你想完好打捞的东西。不幸的是，在组件被卸载后，你还得再命令把它“搬运”回你的飞船。这个模组添加了一个组合命令，将为你节省大量时间和不必要的繁琐操作。

observations.description: NPC 船员无视命令
observations.evidence: During scheduled work time, NPCs will often ignore orders and just do whatever the hell they want.
observations.evidence_zh: 在预定的工作时间，NPC 经常会无视命令，想干什么就干什么。

items.text:
I can build as many fusion reactors as i want, Amanda. Thank you very much.

I walked around in early access and it was a little too rough for me, with 1.0 i got a little disappointed that even some widely known bugs like being permanently barefoot and needing to debug it out were still present or came back to life on release. But the devs are awesome and hard at work and already patched most of them. The simulating is quite wild so some wonky stuff is just part of it. 

The patch has ended this but, It was very fun watching multiple random criminal npc's spawn and beat armed law enforcement officers into the ground by dual wielding briefcases. On my 3rd in game hour this one non-binary officer shot through her colleague to finally put the stations "public enemy" down (they resisted arrest while unarmed). I felt bad for the law enforcer bleeding out on the ground but couldn't figure out how to administer medicine so i just dragged him to a bed. He survived despite his EVA suit evaporating. 

I later got tracked down by a pirate for 200km, I called SOS for approaching threat twice in between drastic course correction to avoid being boarded by the pirate. When the police i called finally arrived to my rescue, the pirate was unconscious in my ship after putting me in a self defense situation. The same officer I dragged to a bed so he wouldn't bleed out in front of the scrap seller kiosk, that same guy, showed up in his underwear and a wifebeater to shake me down for 28 grand after asking me twice if i knew why he was boarding my ship. "I don't even care to find a reason to fine you. You are being fined!" Said Tobey Stuart, a pillar of the community in between nano therapy sessions for brain damage and anger issues. 

Really like building stuff in this. So much free real state.
items.text_zh:
我想造多少聚变反应堆就能造多少，Amanda。非常感谢。

我在抢先体验阶段四处走动过，对我来说有点太粗糙了，到了1.0我有点失望，因为即使是一些广为人知的bug，比如永久赤脚并且需要调试才能解决，在发布时仍然存在或者又复活了。但开发者们很棒，正在努力工作，已经修补了其中大部分。模拟相当狂野，所以一些古怪的东西就是它的一部分。

补丁已经结束了这个，但看着多个随机犯罪NPC生成并用双持公文包把武装执法人员打倒在地非常有趣。在我游戏内的第3个小时，这名非二元性别警官射穿了她同事的身体，终于把空间站的“公敌”放倒了（他们在手无寸铁的情况下拒捕）。我为那个流血倒地执法人员感到难过，但搞不懂怎么给药，所以我就把他拖到床上。尽管他的EVA服蒸发了，他还是活了下来。

后来我被一个海盗追踪了200公里，我在两次大幅改变航向以避免被海盗登船之间，两次呼叫SOS报告有威胁逼近。当我叫来的警察终于赶到救我时，海盗已经在我船上昏迷了，因为让我陷入了自卫局面。就是那个我拖到床上以免他在废料商亭前流血而死的警官，同一个人，穿着内裤和背心出现，在问了我两次是否知道他为什么登我的船之后，向我敲诈2万8千块。“我甚至懒得找个理由罚你。你正在被罚款！”Tobey Stuart说道，这位社区支柱在因脑损伤和愤怒问题接受纳米治疗之间。

真的很喜欢在这里建造东西。这么多免费房地产。

items.text:
В целом впечатления от игры положительные, к сожалению ей критически не хватает полировки второстепенных механик, отчего её душность растёт в геометрической прогрессии.

Когда всё делаешь вручную, отпиливаешь по одной детальке и занимаешься менеджментом скромного инвентаря, геймплей луп работает очень хорошо. Проблемы начинаются когда заводятся первые деньги, и ты решаешь заняться чем-то помасштабнее, типа ремонта дереликтов.

Чинить каждую клетку вручную это нереально долго и уныло, включаешь автотаски персонажу, и вот он вроде побежал чинить всё сам, казалось бы - сиди кайфуй, но нет. Вот у него в сварочном аппарате батарея кончилась, и вместо того чтобы подойти к своему зарядному устройству и взять свежую, он бежит на станцию, достаёт из какого-то ящика чужой сварочный аппарат и начинает чинить унитаз на станции. Чо?

Ну ладно, посмеялись, вернулись на корабль, включил автотаску, скорость на х16, ушёл пить чай. Возвращаюсь, а ничо не сделано. Потому что время вернулось на х1 как только я ушёл, потому что в 5 км от станции пролетал какой-то тарантас и сработало предупреждение об опасном сближении, которое возвращает время на х1. А я на земле ваще стою.

Окей, третья попытка - ремонт идёт, и даже батарею болванчик пошёл брать из зарядника - круто!? Не круто. Вот он достал батарею и стоит, час игрового времени стоит, два стоит, а дереликт не чинится. А не чинится он потому что корабль большой и болванчик просто "не видит" что ему чинить. Вокруг зарядки-то всё целое.

Короче, единственный способ сделать чтобы авторемонт работал это собрать корабль с реактором, и висеть где-то посреди космоса где никто не летает, и нет станции на которую можно убежать чинить толчки. Ну и зарядки надо возле буксира поставить. Ну и дереликт должен быть не слишком большой. А, и  весь мусор из него надо убрать заранее, потому что иначе болванчик будет 12 часов чинить какую-нибудь пивную банку.

Короче, я пока этот реактор собирал по всему космосу, весь шарм из игры выветрился.

Первые часов 15 играть интересно, пока учишься и изучаешь новое, но как только ты всё понял и хочешь сделать что-то оптимально и круто, игра ломается.
items.text_zh:
总的来说，对这款游戏的印象是正面的，遗憾的是，它极度缺乏对次要机制的打磨，因此它的枯燥感呈几何级数增长。

当你什么都手动做，一块一块地锯零件，管理着简陋的库存时，游戏循环运作得非常好。问题始于你赚到第一笔钱，决定做点更大规模的事情，比如修理废弃船的时候。

手动修理每一个格子实在太漫长太无聊了，你给角色开启自动任务，他好像就自己跑去修一切了，看起来——坐着享受就行了，但并不是。他的焊接设备里电池用完了，而他没有走向自己的充电装置去拿一块新的，而是跑向空间站，从某个箱子里拿出别人的焊接设备，开始修理空间站上的马桶。啥？

好吧，笑过了，回到船上，开启自动任务，速度调到x16，去喝茶。回来一看，什么都没做。因为我一离开，时间就回到了x1，因为在离空间站5公里处有某个破车飞过，触发了危险接近警告，这会把时间恢复到x1。而我根本就是站在地面上。

好吧，第三次尝试——修理正在进行，甚至那个笨蛋还去充电器拿电池了——酷！？不酷。他拿出电池就站着，站了一个游戏小时，站了两个小时，而废弃船就是修不好。修不好是因为船很大，那个笨蛋只是“看不到”该修什么。充电器周围的一切都是完好的。

总之，让自动修理起作用的唯一办法就是造一艘带反应堆的船，然后悬停在宇宙中某个没人飞过的地方，那里没有空间站可以跑过去修推进器。而且还得把充电器放在拖船旁边。而且废弃船不能太大。啊，还有，得提前把里面所有垃圾都清掉，因为否则那个笨蛋会花12个小时去修某个啤酒罐。

总之，当我在整个宇宙中收集这个反应堆的时候，游戏的所有魅力都消散了。

前15个小时玩起来很有趣，当你学习和探索新事物的时候，但一旦你全都搞懂了，想要做点最优最酷的事情时，游戏就崩坏了。

items.text:
Oh my God it's so frustrating just how awful this game is because it could really be something special. Put in about 53 hours since 1.0 in the last few days, and for the most part I thought things had really improved significantly since I played in late 2024, but it's just not worth the frustrations. This should not have been released, and I refuse to believe the developer doesn't know that. So why? Running out of funds and need to push it out to get another round of suckers?

Authority/Pirate ships will randomly try to dock with you which is fine and adds some excitement. However what is NOT fine is that they blast towards you at ridiculous speeds and dock with you while travelling >100 m/s which obliterates both of your ships. I had to reload a save 10 times trying to maintain a relative velocity with the authority ship below 100 m/s just so they could dock with me. One of those times I managed to do it and the NPC just stood on their bridge for 5 minutes doing nothing. So, I requested undocking permission, which was granted, but after trying to release clamps they walked up to me at my navigation terminal and identified me as a criminal. Reload again, and again, and eventually able to show them my license and go about my business.

AI crew is still absolutely and despicably abhorrent. Hygiene low? Better brush my teeth. Oh - oops I'm wearing an EVA suite in a vacuum, silly me I'll go back to work. Oh hygiene is still low, let me walk back to the same spot that I just failed to brush my teeth at and try again. Nope still in an EVA suit in a vacuum. Well, back on the ship with perfect atmosphere I'll try brushing my teeth. Damn! I am still wearing a helmet, guess I'll suffer. 

Comfortable bunk in the ship, accessible and available. Crew will be standing NEXT TO the bunk and decide to walk to the air lock (which is pulled to a vacuum) without a helmet and sleep on the floor. Perfectly fine when controlling the crew and forcing them to use the bed.

Otherwise all psychological and physiological needs were met with this crew member after manually intervening - until I decided to have the captain sleep, and fast-forward 6 hours. Suddenly they were just having a miserable existence and wanted to quit. Well, they got locked in the airlock and the turbo pumps suddenly and mysteriously turned on and slowly suffocated, so at least there was a good ending.

Eventually flying to Venus with torch drive, trash AI pirate attempts to intercept me - probably a coffin or something. Can't catch me, but after a couple hours and having gone from 100m/s - >100km/s relative to OKLG they are still chasing me. How can they have that much N2 (IR sensor shows no reactor)? Given up on this save as I know that once I reach drift phase they will eventually catch up, travelling at some insane speed and just slam into me anyway.

Restored He-3 tank while in transit, also one of the pellet feeders. He-3 went from 2000Kg to full and after that no longer losing any fuel despite reactor running at full flow and still burning. Great time.

Loaded up that save after a day and hit with mortgage for my ship as it was 00:00 on 9/1. What's this? Also a mortgage for 00:00 8/1? That's before the start date on the damn game. 

Just save yourself the pain and frustration and steer clear.
items.text_zh:
哦我的天哪，这游戏烂得让人太沮丧了，因为它本来真的可以很特别。自1.0以来，这几天我玩了大约53个小时，大部分时候我觉得自从2024年末玩过之后，情况确实有了显著改善，但那些挫败感还是不值得。这游戏本不该被发布，我拒绝相信开发者不知道这一点。那为什么呢？资金耗尽了，需要把它推出去再骗一轮冤大头？

权威/海盗船会随机尝试与你对接，这没问题，还增添了一些刺激感。然而没问题是——它们以荒谬的速度朝你冲过来，并在以超过100米/秒的速度航行时与你对接，这会摧毁你们双方的飞船。我不得不重新读档10次，试图与权威船保持低于100米/秒的相对速度，好让它们能与我对接。其中一次我成功做到了，结果那个NPC就站在他们的舰桥上5分钟什么也不做。于是，我请求解除对接许可，获得了批准，但在尝试释放锁扣之后，他们走到我所在的导航终端前，把我认定为罪犯。再次读档，一次又一次，最终才得以向他们出示我的执照，继续做我的事。

AI船员依然绝对且可鄙地令人憎恶。卫生度低？最好去刷牙。哦——糟糕，我在真空中穿着EVA服，我真傻，我回去工作吧。哦卫生度还是低，让我走回刚才刷牙失败的那个地方再试一次。不行，还是在真空中穿着EVA服。好吧，回到大气完美的飞船上，我来试着刷牙。该死！我还是戴着头盔，那就忍着吧。

飞船上有一张舒适的双层床，可到达且可用。船员会站在双层床旁边，然后决定不戴头盔走到气闸（已被抽成真空）并睡在地板上。当控制船员并强迫他们使用床时，一切完全正常。

除此之外，在手动干预之后，这名船员的心理和生理需求都得到了满足——直到我决定让船长睡觉，并快进6个小时。突然间他们就过着悲惨的生活，想要辞职。好吧，他们被锁在气闸里，涡轮泵突然而神秘地启动了，他们慢慢窒息而死，所以至少有个好结局。

最终用火炬驱动器飞往金星，垃圾AI海盗试图拦截我——大概是个棺材之类的东西。追不上我，但几个小时后，相对于OKLG从100米/秒变成了>100公里/秒，他们还在追我。他们怎么会有那么多N2（红外传感器显示没有反应堆）？放弃这个存档了，因为我知道一旦我进入漂移阶段，他们最终会追上来，以某种疯狂的速度飞行，然后照样撞上我。

在运输途中恢复了He-3储罐，还有一个燃料丸供给器。He-3从2000公斤变成了满罐，之后尽管反应堆全流量运行并仍在燃烧，却不再消耗任何燃料。真是好时光。

一天后加载那个存档，因为到了9月1日00:00，就收到了我飞船的抵押贷款。这是什么？还有8月1日00:00的抵押贷款？那是在这该死的游戏开始日期之前。

还是省省你的痛苦和挫败吧，离它远点。

items.text:
[h1]Ostranauts - świetny szkielet, który wciąż czeka na właściwą grę[/h1]

Gra kusi obietnicami wysokiego poziomu symulacji i ciekawymi metodami budowania statków kosmicznych. Ale czy tych obietnic dotrzymuje?

[b]Poniekąd tak.[/b]

Można spędzić wiele godzin na szukaniu wartych splądrowania wraków, sprzedawaniu komponentów, byle tylko starczyło na hipotekę, a kiedy ma się już trochę pieniędzy - na ulepszaniu swojego okrętu. Tworzymy wtedy jakiś nieboży amalgamat posklejany z dziesiątek innych statków.

Po drodze robimy małe śledztwa detektywistyczne, aż w końcu dochodzimy do momentu, w którym możemy flipować gruzy z dużym zyskiem. A jeśli dobrze się postaramy, znajdzie się nawet miejsce na własny reaktor fuzyjny.

I trzeba przyznać - [b]samo robienie tego jest całkiem ciekawe.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Problem zaczyna się wtedy, kiedy już zrobimy to, co mieliśmy zrobić[/h2]

[b]Po co?[/b]

I to jest największa bolączka, jaką mam z tą grą. [i]Ostranauts[/i] to po prostu bardzo dobry szkielet symulacji kosmicznej, ale mam wrażenie, że na tym szkielecie wciąż brakuje właściwej gry.

Postawiłeś reaktor i odblokowałeś podróż międzyplanetarną? Spoko. Tylko po co właściwie wybierać się na inne planety? Podróż trwa kupę czasu, nie wiesz, co tam zastaniesz, musisz wcześniej przygotować odpowiednie kwatery i zapasy, a ostatecznie raczej nie czeka tam na ciebie nic przełomowego.

Interakcje społeczne są dość kiepskie. Jeśli chcesz, żeby ktoś został twoim przyjacielem, to w zasadzie wystarczy wystarczająco długo z nim gadać. A kiedy już jesteście przyjaciółmi - co dalej? Nic specjalnego. Może trochę łatwiej da się go zwerbować czy coś, ale o załodze jeszcze za chwilę.

Ulepszyłeś statek, masz fajne silniki i sporo paliwa, więc możesz podróżować dalej. Tylko co z tego? Nie spotykasz lepszych wraków ani szczególnie ciekawych przeszkód.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Piraci i konsekwencje (a raczej ich brak)[/h2]

Czasami na wraku można spotkać pirata. Swoją drogą, pirat siedzący zupełnie sam na wraku, bez zadokowanego własnego statku, rodzi pytanie:

[b]Co on tam w ogóle robi?[/b]

Takiego pirata można bez większych problemów rozwalić. Ale załóżmy, że nasza postać nie jest maszyną do zabijania i chcemy go oszczędzić. Nokautujesz go i zabierasz na swój statek. Po chwili delikwent wstaje i mimo że jest bezbronny, rzuca się na ciebie i każe oddawać fanty.

Więc jaka jest opcja na rozprawienie się z piratami?

[b]Wystrzelenie ich w otchłań kosmosu.[/b]

Nasza postać oczywiście w żaden sposób nie przeżywa traumy związanej z odebraniem komuś życia.

Można również werbować załogę, ale wydawanie rozkazów jednej postaci było już wystarczająco toporne, a większa załoga jest bardzo kosztowna - zarówno jeśli chodzi o pieniądze w grze, jak i o twój komputer.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Performance[/h2]

[b]Jasny gwint.[/b]

Czy ta gra działa na jednym wątku, czy o co tutaj chodzi?

Załóżmy, że dokujesz do średniej wielkości wraku. Najpierw wydajesz rozkaz, żeby twój ludzik zdemontował 20 ścian i podłóg. Odpalasz prędkość x16. Czasem chrupnie, ale jakoś to idzie.

Potem wydajesz rozkaz, żeby utworzyć nowe pomieszczenie na swoim statku. Rozkładasz siatkę podłogi i dookoła stawiasz ściany.

[b]I jest koniec.[/b]

Nie wiem, czy logika dostarczania przedmiotów sprawdza każdą kratkę twojego statku i wraku, ale ściny są momentami nierealne. Jeśli chcesz postawić 20 podłóg, wygląda to tak, jakby wszystkie kratki były sprawdzane 20 razy, a kiedy gra już wszystko przemieli, nagle jest OK.

A mówimy tutaj o pomieszczeniu 4×5. Co się stanie, jeśli ktoś będzie chciał zbudować pomieszczenie 20×10?

Do tego dochodzą długie loadingi i głupie AI. Potrzebujesz pięciu takich samych przedmiotów? Zamiast podnieść cały stack pięciu, postać woli zrobić pięć osobnych wycieczek.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Świat[/h2]

Niestety świat jest również bardzo pusty i sprawia wrażenie makiety.

Na stacji kosmicznej zawsze jesteś jedynym zadokowanym statkiem. Nigdy nie zobaczysz NPC-a, który przyleci, zadokuje albo odleci. Jeśli podlecisz do wraku, do którego NPC już zadokował, to ten NPC faktycznie tam będzie - ale nic nie robi.

Możesz więc po prostu ograbić wrak, a on nawet nie zwróci na ciebie uwagi.

Jeszcze lepiej jest, kiedy przylecisz do miejscówki piratów i wymontujesz istotny dla tamtejszego reaktora komponent. Nikt nie zareaguje. Możesz po prostu zabrać go na swój statek i odlecieć.

To wszystko sprawia, że świat wygląda bardziej jak zbiór scenariuszy przygotowanych specjalnie dla gracza niż żywe miejsce, w którym faktycznie coś się dzieje.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]I mimo wszystko… polecam[/h2]

[i]Ostranauts[/i] ma [b]bardzo dużo niedociągnięć[/b]. I mimo całej tej krytyki [b]polecam grę[/b].

Nie widziałem jeszcze całej zawartości gry - nie dotarłem do eksploracji planet, asteroid miningu ani części endgame'u, więc nie będę udawał, że oceniam całość.

Przez [b]41 godzin[/b], które w niej spędziłem, byłem naprawdę pochłonięty. Jest tutaj sporo rzeczy do robienia, a samo budowanie, ulepszanie i kombinowanie ze statkiem potrafi dać mnóstwo satysfakcji.

Uważam jednak, że obecny poziom ukończenia wskazuje bardziej na [b]bardzo dobry Early Access niż na finalny produkt[/b].

Dałbym tej grze jeszcze rok albo dwa rozwoju. Będę śledził newsy i czekał na duży update.

[b]Na ten moment: polecam, ale z zastrzeżeniami.[/b]
items.text_zh:
[h1]Ostranauts——一副出色的骨架，却仍在等待真正的游戏[/h1]

游戏以高度模拟和有趣的太空飞船建造方式为诱饵。但它真的兑现了这些承诺吗？

[b]某种程度上是的。[/b]

你可以花很多小时寻找值得搜刮的残骸、出售部件，只为凑够抵押贷款，而当你已经有点钱时——就用来升级自己的飞船。这时我们会造出一个由数十艘其他飞船拼凑而成的不伦不类的混合体。

一路上我们会做些小小的侦探调查，直到最终到达可以高利润倒卖废墟的阶段。如果我们足够努力，甚至还能给自己的聚变反应堆找到一席之地。

而且必须承认——[b]做这件事本身相当有趣。[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]问题始于我们做完本该做的事之后[/h2]

[b]为了什么？[/b]

这就是我对这款游戏最大的痛点。[i]Ostranauts[/i]只是一个非常好的太空模拟骨架，但我感觉这个骨架上仍然缺少真正的游戏。

你装好了反应堆，解锁了行星际旅行？不错。但究竟为什么要去其他行星？旅程要花很长时间，你不知道那里会遇到什么，必须提前准备好合适的舱室和补给，而最终那里大概也不会有什么突破性的东西等着你。

社交互动相当糟糕。如果你想让某人成为你的朋友，基本上只要跟他聊得足够久就行。而当你们已经是朋友之后——然后呢？没什么特别的。也许招募他会稍微容易一点之类的，但关于船员的事待会儿再说。

你升级了飞船，有了不错的引擎和大量燃料，所以你可以航行得更远。可那又怎样？你不会遇到更好的残骸，也不会遇到特别有趣的障碍。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]海盗与后果（或者说根本没有后果）[/h2]

有时在残骸上会遇到海盗。顺带一提，一个海盗孤零零地坐在残骸上，没有自己的飞船停靠在那里，这引出一个问题：

[b]他到底在那儿干什么？[/b]

这样的海盗可以毫无困难地干掉。但假设我们的角色不是杀人机器，我们想饶他一命。你把他打晕并带回自己的飞船。过了一会儿，这家伙站起来，尽管手无寸铁，却扑向你，要你交出财物。

那么对付海盗的选项是什么？

[b]把他们射进宇宙深渊。[/b]

我们的角色当然丝毫不会因为夺走他人性命而遭受创伤。

也可以招募船员，但指挥一个角色就已经够笨拙了，而更大的船员队伍非常昂贵——无论是游戏里的钱，还是你的电脑。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]性能[/h2]

[b]我的天。[/b]

这游戏是单线程运行的吗，还是怎么回事？

假设你停靠在一艘中等大小的残骸上。首先你下令让你的小人拆掉20面墙和地板。你开启x16速度。有时会卡一下，但勉强还能进行。

然后你下令在自己的飞船上建造一个新房间。你铺开地板网格，在四周竖起墙壁。

[b]然后就完了。[/b]

我不知道物品运送逻辑是否检查了你飞船和残骸的每一个格子，但墙壁有时慢得不真实。如果你想铺20块地板，看起来就像所有格子都被检查了20遍，而当游戏终于把所有东西处理完时，突然就OK了。

而我们说的
这里说的是4×5的房间。如果有人想建造一个20×10的房间，会发生什么？

再加上漫长的加载时间和愚蠢的AI。你需要五个相同的物品？角色宁愿跑五趟单独的来回，也不愿一次拿起整叠五个。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]世界[/h2]

不幸的是，这个世界也非常空旷，给人一种模型布景的感觉。

在空间站里，你永远是唯一停靠的飞船。你永远不会看到NPC飞来、停靠或飞走。如果你靠近一个NPC已经停靠的残骸，那个NPC确实会在那里——但什么也不做。

所以你可以直接洗劫残骸，而它甚至不会注意到你。

更妙的是，当你飞到海盗的地盘，拆下对那里反应堆至关重要的组件时。没有人会做出反应。你可以直接把它搬上自己的飞船然后飞走。

这一切让这个世界看起来更像是一堆专门为玩家准备的场景集合，而不是一个真正有事情发生的活生生的地方。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]尽管如此……我还是推荐[/h2]

[i]Ostranauts[/i]有[b]非常多的不足之处[/b]。尽管有这么多批评，[b]我还是推荐这款游戏[/b]。

我还没有看完游戏的全部内容——我还没到行星探索、小行星采矿或终局部分，所以我不会假装自己在评价整体。

在我投入的[b]41个小时[/b]里，我真的非常投入。这里有很多事情可做，光是建造、升级和折腾飞船就能带来极大的满足感。

不过我认为，目前的完成度更像是一个[b]非常优秀的抢先体验版，而不是最终成品[/b]。

我会再给这款游戏一到两年的开发时间。我会关注新闻，等待大型更新。

[b]目前来说：推荐，但有保留意见。[/b]

万人受けはしないが刺さる人には刺さるゲームではあるが、いかんせん不便も多い
良い所は他のレビューで見てくれたら分かるので気になった点を

Ver1.0.7で0.15.0.7向け日本語化MODを入れてプレイ

色々と説明不足なUI

例えば空調UI
エアポンプと酸素缶を設置してオートにしたら良い感じに動いてくれるだろう
→動いてくれない？？？何故？？？
→オート設定時にUIのネジをクリックしてパネル外して出て来るUIでセンサーと接続しないとオート稼働しない

自動運搬AI周りが非効率的で、自動建設指示してもあらかじめ設置するフロアやら電線を所持させておかないとわざわざ一つずつ拾ってきて設置するとかされる
そういうお馬鹿な挙動のケアを手動でする必要が出て来るから忍耐力を要求される面は確実にある

犯罪した際に無限に罰金要求されて詰みデータになったりもするのは日本語化MODが古いからなのか？
だからちゃんとライセンス購入し合法的な活動を心掛ける必要がある

それと寄港している際に一般NPCが勝手に乗船して冷蔵庫開けて食糧盗み食いしたり水飲んだりしてくる
マップ上にある物資の所有権の概念がないからか、おそらく公共の共有物として盗まれる
対策としてドアをロックすればが良いが特定の向きの問題なのか内側からロックしたいのに、外側に出てからロック処理始めるから内側からロックできないみたいなバグ挙動がある
面白い部分も多いが、そういう細かい不具合や不便も味や癖強だと許容できる人向けではある

もっと手軽に宇宙スカベンジやりたいライト層ならば『Space Haven』とかやった方が満足できると思う
明確にヘビー層向けの作品
items.text_zh:
虽然不是大众向，但对上电波的人来说会很喜欢，不过不便之处也确实很多
优点看其他评测就能明白，所以我来说说在意的点

在Ver1.0.7下装了面向0.15.0.7的日语化MOD进行游玩

各种说明不足的UI

比如空调UI
设置好气泵和氧气罐并调成自动，应该就能很好地运作吧
→不运作？？？为什么？？？
→自动设置时，点击UI上的螺丝拆下面板后出现的UI里，如果不连接传感器，就不会自动运行

自动搬运AI效率低下，就算下达自动建设指令，如果不事先让它持有要设置的底板和电线之类的东西，它就会特意一个个捡来再设置
必须手动处理这种愚蠢行为，所以确实有要求玩家有耐心的方面

犯罪时会被无限要求罚款，甚至变成死档，这是不是因为日语化MOD太旧了？
所以有必要好好购买许可证，注意进行合法活动

还有，停靠时普通NPC会擅自上船，打开冰箱偷吃食物或喝水
大概是因为地图上物资没有所有权概念，被当作公共共有物偷走
作为对策，锁门就好，但可能是朝向的问题，明明想从内侧上锁，却会先跑到外侧才开始上锁处理，导致无法从内侧上锁，有这种bug行为

有趣的地方也很多，但这类细小故障和不便，也属于味道和怪癖很强、能容许的人才适合

如果想更轻松地玩太空拾荒的轻度玩家，我觉得去玩《Space Haven》之类的会更满足
明确是面向重度玩家的作品

items.text:
why is this game even fully released?

i spent like first 200hrs of my entire playtime on waiting for stutterings, guessing if this is bug or not and screaming at the monitor like a mad man. 
this game doesnt even have good content or ai system. no career options, no social system, no real consequences for crimes, and combat is too easy. and most of the skills in the games r not even implemented yet so there is no reason to choose them in character creation. every new game is the same and actually, the only reason u have to make a new game is because the incompetence of developers who keep updating the game every week and it causes the save file more problems and mod community tired.

the game advertises hiring crew and using gun is a fun thing to do. sounds fantastic? u can have ur own private army, pirate ship or mercenaries. and there r npcs with gun skills and u can start with gun skill actually.
however, these gun skills r not even implemented in the game. and they r not even acquirable during the game. weird right? if u shoot a lot enough, u should be able to hit something at some point. but player keep shooting themselves even with the gun skill. also most of the pirates carry empty hand guns and npcs do not carry rifles even tho guns r really cheap and they sell them in bulk in space station.

i asked the developer directly, why r u guys not fixing these gun skill problems? and he said, combat is not our priority. huh? so they r admitting they just false advertised one of the core game mechanicism?

also even after the full release, crew had ai problem that they just didnt work properly. so most of the players just didnt hire anyone and played the game without the feature. so i would call this game just a slop and a scam. considering that this game has been in a development for like idk a decade? and most of the space stations in the game arent even connected to other stations even tho they have subways? 

lack of content, false advertisement, repetitive gameplay and just insult to a gaming community for fully releasing the game
items.text_zh:
这游戏到底凭什么算正式发布了？

我整个游戏时间的前200小时左右，都花在等待卡顿、猜测这是不是bug，以及像个疯子一样对着显示器尖叫上。
这游戏甚至没有好的内容或AI系统。没有职业选择，没有社交系统，犯罪没有真正的后果，战斗也太简单了。而且游戏里大多数技能甚至都还没实装，所以角色创建时根本没有理由去选它们。每一局新游戏都一样，实际上，你之所以要开新档，唯一原因就是开发者无能，他们每周都在更新游戏，结果给存档文件带来更多问题，还让mod社区疲惫不堪。

游戏宣传说雇佣船员和使用枪械是件有趣的事。听起来很棒吧？你可以拥有自己的私人军队、海盗船或雇佣兵。而且还有具备枪械技能的NPC，你实际上也可以以枪械技能开局。
然而，这些枪械技能甚至都没在游戏里实装。而且它们在游戏过程中也无法获得。很奇怪吧？如果你开枪开得足够多，总该在某个时候能打中点什么吧。但玩家即使有枪械技能也还是会打到自己。此外，大多数海盗都带着空的手枪，NPC也不携带步枪，尽管枪械真的很便宜，而且空间站里还成批出售。

我直接问过开发者，你们为什么不修复这些枪械技能问题？他说，战斗不是我们的优先事项。哈？所以他们是在承认，他们只是虚假宣传了游戏的核心机制之一？

而且即使在正式发布之后，船员仍有AI问题，他们就是不能正常工作。所以大多数玩家干脆谁也不雇，在没有这个功能的情况下玩游戏。所以我会把这游戏称为一坨烂货和一场骗局。考虑到这游戏已经开发了大概，我也不知道，十年？而且游戏里大多数空间站甚至都没有和其他空间站连接起来，尽管它们有地铁？

内容匮乏、虚假宣传、玩法重复，简直就是对游戏社区的侮辱，居然还正式发布了这游戏

items.text:
[h2]A great core idea but with an underbaked release[/h2]

I've had my eye on this game for a long time, deliberately holding off until it was finished. So I was thrilled to see it hit 1.0 a few days ago, and with a sale on top of that I bought it immediately. The recent mixed reviews gave me pause, but I didn't pay them much attention because I wanted to finally experience the game for myself. In hindsight I probably should have listened, because I now find myself agreeing with the consensus: this is a very underbaked 1.0.

And I don't just mean bugs, of which there are many. You can tell while playing that a lot of features were built to about 20% and then left there.

Space navigation. It's genuinely very well done and enjoyable, and it's the one part of this game I have nothing bad to say about.

One example that stands in for a dozen: I have a zone full of building materials, a cart in my hands, and a blueprint waiting to be filled, and my character will deliver the materials [b]one at a time[/b], despite correctly using the cart when I explicitly tell him to haul. These systems are just plainly unfinished.

My read is that the devs got overly ambitious and tried to implement a lot of different things at once instead of going vertical and polishing each set of features before moving on, until they hit some kind of wall (money ran out, publisher pressure, burnout after years on the same project, who knows) and ultimately labeled this a finished product.

The NPC system exemplifies this. Hiring crew, but also just talking to station NPCs to handle mood requirements: something I thought was really cool for the first two minutes and that turned out so bad I wish it simply wasn't in the game. Contrast this with something like Project Zomboid, where the devs pulled NPCs entirely because they weren't satisfied with the implementation, and shipped narrow but fully polished slices with each release instead. That's the discipline this game needed, rather than forcing a broken system in.

[h3]Where that leaves me[/h3]
Exactly where I was trying not to be by waiting for 1.0: enamored with the premise and creative direction, but frustrated enough with the state of the game that I can't enjoy it without getting mad at some system not working properly every five minutes.

The devs have promised at least another year of development, and I hope that means more than a few bugfixes, because several systems urgently need more love and attention. As things stand I can't recommend it to new players, partly so nobody else walks into what I walked into. Wait 6 to 12 months and see where the progress is by then, because whatever labels are used, [b]this game is still in an EA state[/b].

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Software engineering side note[/h3]
I've read the dev's post about not wanting to use generative AI for coding tasks, and everyone is free to work how they please, but as a software engineer I think it's a self-inflicted wound. Getting half-finished features across the line is exactly where these tools are strongest. Hardcoded text strings apparently blocking localization is a couple of days of work at most with an assistant scanning the codebase for them.

[h2]一个很棒的核心创意，但发布版本火候未到[/h2]

我关注这款游戏已经很久了，一直刻意等到它完成才入手。所以几天前看到它发布1.0版本时我非常激动，再加上还有打折，我立刻就买了下来。最近的褒贬不一评价让我犹豫了一下，但我没太在意，因为我想终于亲自体验一下这款游戏。事后看来，我大概应该听进去的，因为我现在发现自己同意主流看法：这是一个非常半生不熟的1.0版本。

而且我说的不只是bug，虽然bug确实很多。玩的时候你就能看出来，很多功能只做到了大约20%就被搁置了。

太空导航。这部分确实做得非常好，也很有趣，是这款游戏里我唯一挑不出毛病的地方。

举一个能代表十几个问题的例子：我有一个堆满建筑材料的区域，手里有一辆推车，还有一个等着被填充的蓝图，而我的角色会[b]一次一件地[/b]运送材料，尽管当我明确告诉他要搬运时，他确实会正确使用推车。这些系统显然就是没做完。

我的理解是，开发者过于雄心勃勃，试图一次性实现很多不同的东西，而不是纵向深入、在继续前进之前把每一组功能打磨好，直到他们撞上了某种墙（钱花完了、发行商施压、在同一个项目上做了多年后倦怠了，谁知道呢），最终把这个标成了完成品。

NPC系统就是典型例子。雇佣船员，以及仅仅为了处理心情需求而和空间站NPC交谈：这东西我头两分钟还觉得真的很酷，结果差到我希望它干脆别出现在游戏里。对比一下《僵尸毁灭工程》这样的作品，那边的开发者因为对NPC实现不满意而把NPC整个撤掉了，每次发布都只推出范围狭窄但完全打磨好的部分。这才是这款游戏需要的自律，而不是硬塞进一个坏掉的系统。

[h3]这让我处于什么境地[/h3]
正是我当初等到1.0就是想避免的境地：被它的前提和创作方向迷住了，但对游戏的状态沮丧到无法享受它，因为每五分钟就会因为某个系统不能正常工作而生气。

开发者承诺至少还会再开发一年，我希望这不只是修几个bug，因为有好几个系统迫切需要更多关爱和关注。就目前情况而言，我无法向新玩家推荐它，部分原因也是不想让别人再走进我走进的这个坑。等6到12个月，看看那时进展如何，因为不管用什么标签，[b]这款游戏仍然处于EA状态[/b]。

[hr][/hr]

[h3]软件工程方面的附注[/h3]
我读过开发者关于不想在编码任务中使用生成式AI的帖子，每个人都有按自己意愿工作的自由，但作为一名软件工程师，我认为这是自找麻烦。把半成品功能推过终点线，恰恰是这些工具最擅长的地方。据说阻碍本地化的硬编码文本字符串，在助手的帮助下扫描代码库找出它们，最多也就几天的工作量。

this game could be cool but it needs time to cook

items.text:
I just can't recommend getting it as is i am afraid. 

- The character creation sucks and is lacking features like presets and preset saving, which is not that major anyways, since there is one player model and no matter what it won't look anything like your character regardless of what you chose. It's not just a visual element, i just also dislike the element of randomness in a character creation.

- The UI is awful. In fact, i think this has got to be bar none the worst UI i've ever had to deal with in a video game and i've known the dos era. The information is disorganized, badly presented, implies insane amounts of clicking, the (too) many UI elements have little graphic/logical coherency, it's just a terrible, terrible time dealing with it all. Sure you *can* get used to it. But it was just bad design that stuck throughout EA when it should have been scrapped and redone. No UI/UX person on board and it really shows sadly. Whether it be inventory, character information, terrain or anything else, you'll be trying to enjoy yourself in spite of it the whole time. 

- The game's whole premise is to foster a "theatre of the mind" (dev's words, not mine), but the entire NPC interaction system is just terrible. It's essentially the sims type of interactions, with no logic or coherency in interactions. It all boils down just standing like a chimp in front of NPCs you wish to engage with and spamming dialogue options until you get high enough relations that they decide to acknowledge your existence and give you what you expect from them. At no point this system even attempts to make sense and you find yourself chaining nonsensical interactions. It is *so bad*.

- The graphical fidelity still gets in the way of readability on many objects and terrain. Beyond the aesthetic choice, it's just so low fidelity that one struggles to just make sense of what's on screen most of the time, and while in many games this sort of aesthetic can look pleasing when done right, this just looks unreadable, visually busy and unappealing.

- The performance, which was a big problem when i first picked the game up during EA, has been improved, although i'm still experiencing memory leaks and major slowdowns with very little on the screen = Automatic negative review. Those leaks were identified over a year ago, there was ample time to fix them.

- Feature wise it's rather rich in my opinion but content wise it's still rather devoid of content and sadly my understanding is that the dev simply had to push it out the door for lack of funds. In this game you'll find very little story-driven elements and hand-crafted narratives. What's there is good, but it's insufficient. For a sandbox game like this one, it feels very empty.

- The soundscape is still very bland, which for a game purporting to immerse you, is a big let-down.

- The game pushes you to hire a crew but the whole crew management/interaction gameplay (and especially performance, yikes) feels very janky. 

- Outside of the few handcrafted quests, the rest is typical sandbox busy work nonsense fluff and fetch-quests. Yawn.

- Jobs (non handcrafted quests) tend to be buggy and break, leading players to decide to just skip this entire area and to focus on other revenue streams.

So what's there to enjoy then?

- The ship piloting feels excellent.
- The scavenging, albeit repetitive as sin over time, is interesting.
- Ship building is interesting to engage with and has plenty of features to deal with.
- Exploring, although limited because again, world feels bland, empty and unfinished.
- There's some measure of hope for this game as it features a steam workshop integration.
- Murder investigations, if they weren't still as buggy, would be enjoyable as well.

My hope for the game is that the dev keeps working on it to finish what was clearly not yet cooked and ready to come out of the oven. On top of that, i hope for modders to address the main issues of this game, first and foremost the unforgivably bad NPC interaction system, and if at all possible, the UI.

As it stands though, do yourself a favor and do not engage until significant work is done on this title. It's a big let down for me and i'm sorry about it because i have a lot of respect for the Dev as a person, but this soured me on supporting their future endeavors a great deal.
items.text_zh:
恐怕我只能说，就目前这个样子，我实在没法推荐购买。

- 角色创建很糟糕，缺少预设和预设保存之类的功能，不过反正这也没那么重要，因为只有一个玩家模型，不管你选了什么，它看起来都完全不像你的角色。这不仅仅是个视觉元素的问题，我也很讨厌角色创建里的随机性元素。

- UI 糟透了。事实上，我觉得这绝对是我在电子游戏里遇到过的最烂的 UI，我可是经历过 DOS 时代的人。信息杂乱无章，呈现得很差，意味着要疯狂点击，那些（过多的）UI 元素在图形/逻辑上几乎没有连贯性，处理这一切简直就是一段糟糕透顶、糟糕透顶的体验。当然，你*可以*习惯它。但这本身就是糟糕的设计，在整个 EA 阶段一直存在，本该被废弃重做。团队里没有 UI/UX 方面的人，这一点很遗憾地暴露无遗。无论是物品栏、角色信息、地形还是别的什么，你全程都得在忍受它的同时努力让自己玩得开心。

- 这游戏的整个前提是营造一种“心灵剧场”（这是开发者的话，不是我说的），但整个 NPC 交互系统就是糟糕透顶。它本质上是《模拟人生》那种交互，交互中毫无逻辑或连贯性。一切都归结为像只黑猩猩一样站在你想互动的 NPC 面前，狂刷对话选项，直到关系值够高，他们才决定承认你的存在，给你你期望从他们那里得到的东西。这个系统在任何时候都甚至没有尝试过要讲得通，你会发现自己在一连串毫无意义的交互中循环。它*太糟了*。

- 图形保真度仍然妨碍着许多物体和地形的可读性。抛开审美选择不谈，它的保真度就是太低了，大多数时候人都很难看懂屏幕上是什么，虽然在很多游戏里这种审美如果做得好会看起来令人愉悦，但这个看起来就是难以辨认、视觉上杂乱且毫无吸引力。

- 性能问题，在我最初于 EA 阶段入手这游戏时是个大问题，现在已经有所改善，不过我仍然会遇到内存泄漏和严重的卡顿，而屏幕上几乎没什么东西 = 自动差评。那些泄漏一年多以前就被发现了，有充足的时间去修复。

- 就功能而言，在我看来相当丰富，但就内容而言，它仍然相当缺乏内容，而且遗憾的是，据我所知，开发者只是因为缺钱不得不把它赶着推出门。在这个游戏里，你会发现极少有剧情驱动的元素和手工打造的叙事。现有的内容是不错，但不够。对于像这样的沙盒游戏来说，它感觉非常空洞。

- 音景仍然非常平淡，对于一个号称要让你沉浸其中的游戏来说，这是很大的失望。

- 游戏推动你去雇佣一支船员，但整个船员管理/交互的玩法（尤其是性能，哎呀）感觉非常蹩脚。

- 除了少数几个手工打造的任务之外，其余都是典型的沙盒式忙碌工作、无意义的填充内容和跑腿任务。呵欠。

- 工作（非手工打造的任务）往往有 bug 并且会出故障，导致玩家决定干脆跳过这整个区域，转而专注于其他收入来源。

那么还有什么可享受的呢？

- 飞船驾驶手感极佳。
- 拾荒，尽管时间久了重复得要命，但挺有意思。
- 飞船建造玩起来很有意思，而且有大量功能可以折腾。
- 探索，尽管受限，因为还是那句话，世界感觉平淡、空洞且未完成。
- 这游戏还有一定希望，因为它集成了 Steam 创意工坊。
- 谋杀案调查，如果它们不是仍然那么多 bug 的话，也会挺有趣的。

我对这游戏的希望是开发者继续努力，把那些显然还没煮熟、还没准备好出炉的东西做完。除此之外，我希望模组作者能解决这游戏的主要问题，首当其冲的就是那不可原谅的糟糕 NPC 交互系统，如果可能的话，还有 UI。

不过就目前而言，行行好，在这个作品有重大改进之前别去碰它。这让我非常失望，我也为此感到遗憾，因为我个人非常尊重这位开发者，但这件事让我在支持他们未来事业方面大打了折扣。
需要处理的特性。
- 探索，尽管有限，因为再次强调，世界感觉平淡、空洞且未完成。
- 这款游戏还有一些希望，因为它集成了Steam创意工坊。
- 谋杀调查，如果它们不那么漏洞百出的话，也会很有趣。

我对这款游戏的希望是开发者继续努力，完成那些显然还没煮熟、还没准备好出炉的部分。除此之外，我希望模组制作者能解决这款游戏的主要问题，首先是那不可原谅的糟糕NPC互动系统，如果可能的话，还有UI。

不过就目前而言，帮自己一个忙，在游戏有重大改进之前不要碰它。这让我非常失望，我很抱歉，因为作为一个人，我非常尊重开发者，但这大大削弱了我支持他们未来项目的意愿。

items.text:
It's a hit or miss kind of game that does a lot of cool things, but also has some issues.

I'll just get this out of the way but the game is a little pozzed. Just take a look at some character attributes, the fact the devs only have a Blusky account and the just the way the characters looks. A bit of a shame but it's ignorable for the most part, just think there's an unrealistic amount of a certain kind of people walking around these stations. I should have expected as much for anything published by Kitfox, but the games they publish are usually really great games with deep mechanics and systems. This game looked the same, and to a solid extent it is.

I quite enjoyed Blue Bottle's previous game, Neo Scavenger, especially for its excellent worldbuilding and writing. The same can be found in this title. The mechanics are just as intriguing if not more, and I'm always down for a space sim RPG game. I like the looting system (when it's not being buggy or clunky) and the shipbuilding and maintenance is fun and somewhat immersive. I also like how it portrays itself being dense and with lots to learn while being quite approachable in reality, if you just take a moment to follow the built in tutorial. That being said, this game feels unfinished.

Yes perhaps content-wise, it's complete, but the game is missing QoL and has some very annoyings bugs that especially makes the automation elements of this game perform poorly. I've repeatedly gotten a super annoying bug where my character decides to just cycle an empty battery from his inventory, to the ground and to a wall charger on my ship while under automation orders even after I've manually put a fresh, fully charged battery into the tool he was replacing the battery for. I've also had my character just straight up ignore his tasks to repair some random part rather than do the work he was supposed to do and had all the necessary components accessible for. Doing major time skips while you set your character to repair parts of the ship automatically doesn't seem to do anything. I've had moments where the game just decides certain cells in my inventory are no longer allowed to hold anything, and then fix itself later with no explanation. I'm not sure why I need a mod to assign an automated task to pick up items into a character's inventory. AI ships seems to travel at ridiculous speeds in space compared to you... And more.

There's just a lot of little things that make this game uncessarily frustrating. I could look past some of these things in a game that is less time consuming, but this game is very slow and it takes a lot of time to do many things. The automation mechanics aren't the best or are buggy which make this worse. I think it's game but it's just being held down by issues I think the devs need to address. So I can't give this game a thumbs up especially with it being in 1.0 and still in this state.

The bugs I mentioned were fixed.
items.text_zh:
这是一款时好时坏的游戏，做了很多很酷的事情，但也有一些问题。

我就直说了吧，这游戏有点被政治正确污染了。只要看看一些角色属性、开发者只有一个Blusky账号这个事实，还有角色的长相就知道了。有点遗憾，但大部分情况下可以忽略，只是想想这些空间站里走来走去的某类人数量多得不太现实。我本该料到Kitfox发行的东西会这样，但他们发行的游戏通常都是真正很棒的游戏，有着深度的机制和系统。这款游戏看起来也一样，而且在很大程度上确实如此。

我非常喜欢Blue Bottle的上一款游戏《Neo Scavenger》，尤其是它出色的世界观构建和写作。这款作品里也能找到同样的东西。机制同样引人入胜，甚至更胜一筹，而我一直都很喜欢太空模拟RPG游戏。我喜欢拾荒系统（当它没有出bug或笨拙的时候），造船和维护也很有趣，还有一定的沉浸感。我也喜欢它把自己表现得内容密集、有很多东西要学，但实际上相当平易近人，只要你花点时间跟着内置教程走。话虽如此，这游戏感觉没做完。

是的，也许在内容方面它是完整的，但游戏缺少生活质量改进，还有一些非常烦人的bug，尤其是让游戏的自动化元素表现得很差。我反复遇到一个超级烦人的bug：我的角色在自动化指令下，决定把一块空电池从他的物品栏里循环地拿到地上、再拿到飞船上的墙壁充电器上，即使我已经手动把一块全新的、充满电的电池放进了他正在更换电池的那个工具里。我还遇到过我的角色直接无视自己的任务，去修理某个随机的部件，而不是去做他本该做的工作——而且他本来就能拿到所有必要的组件。当你把角色设置为自动修理飞船部件时，进行大幅时间跳跃似乎什么也不做。我还遇到过游戏突然决定我物品栏里的某些格子不再允许存放任何东西，然后又莫名其妙地自己恢复正常。我不明白为什么我需要一个mod才能给角色分配一个自动拾取物品到物品栏的任务。AI飞船在太空中的飞行速度似乎快得离谱，跟你比起来……还有更多。

就是有很多小事情让这款游戏变得不必要地令人沮丧。在一款不那么耗时的游戏里，我或许可以忽略其中一些事情，但这款游戏非常慢，做很多事情都要花大量时间。自动化机制不是最好的，或者有bug，这让情况更糟。我觉得这是款好游戏，但只是被一些问题拖累了，我认为开发者需要解决这些问题。所以我不能给这款游戏点赞，尤其是它已经是1.0版本了却还是这种状态。

我提到的那些bug已经被修复了。
