items.text:
[h1]A game that tries to become something it will never be.[/h1]

 [b]WARNING[/b]: [i]Everything said below is a part of my subjective opinion; I may OverEstimate the game idea in some parts of my review or even imply devs are having some 4D-super-strategy-moves mumbo-jumbo; it's okay. That's the part of my impressions I received from the game after I actually started to play it DEEP.[/i]


I've seen various games... Haven't touched some of them, but definitely seen.
Some of them specialised on LSS maintaining like Stationeers.
Some - on how you build, fly and fight on your ships like Space Engineers or Empyrion.
Some - on the travel and (fast)looting aspect, like Pulsar:LC, Duskers or Scavenger SV-4 
Some - on the paranormal/thrilling stuff like VotV or Isolated Inhale...
I also enjoyed the Sunless Sea as well as it's sequel Sunless skies... 
And there was also an specimen of those so-called "Perfect sims" in the face of Shadow of Doubt...

So, the reason why I named all of those games here is because sometimes it's hard to implement even ONE of those aspects, even if you know what you're doing, yet the Devs of this game, without much of appropriate experience, still decided to try and Combine all of those things in a one...

[i]Blue. Bottle.[/i]


Honestly, I've been writing this review for more than two weeks for sure, but I'm still not sure I'll be able to fully convey my dissapointment with...
Ugh... let's say - EVERYTHING.

And the most tragic about that is the fact it's not a fault of bad code (maybe?), questionable choices (perhaps?), or attitude towards the project itself (not at... all? I guess).
Everything bad comes from the game itself... literally because of how it's imagined by design; let me explain...
Do you know what the Ouroboros is? Yeah, the self-eating snake, which can't actually eat itself yada-yada, well... This game is literally It. 
Except it DOES devour itself very vell... And first, let me tell how you will pass your gameplay time in this game:
First 30 minutes would be good, everything will be fast and easy as a light...
Then comes second 30 munites... And you'll start to notice slight issues - microlags, few seconds "to think", stuttering while accelerated...
Then comes the rubicon - At one with a half hours game will be hard to play... slow, sometimes freezing...
And eventually it grinds down to a halt. You find yourself staring at the game that spends ten minutes in "not responding" state for each minute of "responding"... And eventually you just kill the process, wait ten seconds, restart the game(Probably along with restarting half of your apps, because as Game keeps devouring your Ram way past the 12 out of 16Gb, your PC WILL begin to freak out and try to lighten the load by putting everything "not used" into the "halted" state, Steam Included.) and the cycle begins anew.

"Why it's like that? How can we fix it? Why Devs won't fix it?" - You probably asked those questions, and looking into the resmon won't help your curious mind, not unless you read the logs.
Yep, the "Perfect-Sim" ambitions they sacrificed everything else for came back to bite their ass off.

So... Do you remember how you created a character? Unless you instantly hit "seek ship", picked The Retrofit and got out of CharGen (Towards your death, if that's your second char. Or Glory - if you're Professional.) - Game usually spits out a pack of an NPCs related to your aging-up shenanigas... Snobs, Cops, Thugs, Nitwits... Friends or Foes, an "Full deck" if short.
And guess what? Each spawned NPC somewhat DO pass through the same procedure! No, they're not autistically look into the mirror (that has last time seen the janitor probably the moment it got manufactured) like you... 
Yet they do get "rolled" life... And a Buckshot of sidekicks as well! And they also get their own... and again an again an again, until they hit some kind of a limiter, But (Yes there's a persky "But"! Probably an whole gang of "But"s!) it seems this "limiter" works... let's say sometimes (s)he(?) takes a [strike]day off[/strike] full maternity leave - NPCs occasionally multiply like a rabbits, which devoured a whole crate of "Adult chems"... you know (And if you don't... Why the f*ck are you reading this? This game isn't for kids FFS).

If your save had 300-320 NPCs on start - after a few days it would be a 370. Week later = 400... And a two-three weeks later = >500 (And DO thank god for not OVER9000!)
And guess what? Sometimes they spawn with a Ship! Or, if unlucky - on a derelict (I'm serous... I've seen like 5 of those dead ships with "Crew:1" stat. And no, It wasn't a corpses)! 
And with "Fire in the hold" They even get some Tin Cans with a guns! And even fight each-other! Does it somehow impacts your gameplay? 
Only if you're near Ceres WITH your ship but let's be honest - Unless using a PASS there isn't any good way to get to Ceres Quickly and Safely. 
And so there's a whole cacophony of "Creations" is happening like... Everywhere! Ships get created, destroyed, wrecked. Rooms appear and disappear. NPCs appear, travel, choke on the "acceptable algae" and get dragged into the local Valhalla. Sometimes a Pirate or just someone "not from the hood" spawns in and Whole Royal Cavalry of Seasoned OG's runs toward It to ROYALLY Wreck his mug (Watch out for trigger-happy cops!)! 

Oh! And every NPC also Eats, Sleeps, Sh*ts, each and everything you know, except maybe like.... Doing Work? Because in space everyone only Brags about their 12/12(both AM)/7, but keeps watching Drama reruns [i](Except Techies, though... They got two additional madskillz: "FIX-ZE-ZTUFF" and "IDGAF ABT UR SHIP GIMME UR TRENCHIES!"... I mean really... I had to put a Code on my pantry AND Galley doors to stop those "Elements" from ransacking my food/water reserves)[/i] for days and Getting Pissed off by a chair, why? Because he's an uncomfortable plastic b*tch, disallowing anyone reliably relax their ass more that two times in a row! It's even more funny as Game's wiki has a reference on the Rimworld's table behaviour... Uhhh... how do they say it? People who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones? 

And guess what? Your PC has to emulate [Sseth Tzeenach Voice] "ALL OF THIS SH*T", constantly and Simultneously! No mercy! No exceptions! "Be there or be Square, because you're not around!" - That's the motto of this game's simworks!
Oh and rest assure - 90% of that "content" WILL happen OUTSIDE of your reach(Without debug magic) and you know... I think all those quests that many Steam/Reddit players will suggest you not even touch aren't actually bugged... Or at least they wasn't in the first place. Let me cite the classics: [b]"Truth is... the game was rigged from the start."[/b]
It's just the Simulation itself has screwed you up before you could even realize that. 
How? Killing(Figuratively or literally... or sometimes - Both ways at once) an Quest-related NPC and Erasing it from existence ofc!
[i](P.s. THere is a rumor about the Corpse-room... and I'm prettty sure it's the K-Leg's OKLG-UNC... at least when I did a purge there was like... 70 or 90 Dead NPCs on that loc! So yeah... They did it. They did the meme - "Yes, 'Delete' him, and from the Trash bin too".)[/i]

And this is the Main fun-killer of the whole game! Other systems are simply UNDER-developed to present any issues at all or simply stuck in their primitive implementations, without any further development! It's just the fact that your Game tries to Simulate the WHOLE F**KING solar system of various'level deadbeats! And unlike "Shadows of Doubt" which has a finite number of NPCs the Ostranauts decided to have an different approach... 
(And I even suspect the Devs do actually aspire to reach the same numbers of ~1000 fully simulated active NPCs, with a few hundreds of a "Frozen spares", ready to substitute I'm afraid)


Unfortunately there's a limit of how much you can write, so check comments for the remaining part...
items.text_zh:
[h1]一款试图成为它永远无法成为的东西的游戏。[/h1]

[b]警告[/b]：[i]下面所说的一切都是我主观意见的一部分；我可能在评论的某些部分高估了游戏理念，甚至暗示开发者有什么4D超级战略招式的胡言乱语；这没关系。这是我在真正开始深入游玩后从游戏中得到的印象的一部分。[/i]


我见过各种各样的游戏……有些没碰过，但肯定见过。
有些专注于像Stationeers那样的LSS维护。
有些专注于像Space Engineers或Empyrion那样在你的飞船上建造、飞行和战斗。
有些专注于旅行和（快速）掠夺方面，比如Pulsar:LC、Duskers或Scavenger SV-4。
有些专注于超自然/惊悚的东西，比如VotV或Isolated Inhale……
我也很喜欢Sunless Sea以及它的续作Sunless Skies……
还有一款所谓“完美模拟”的样本，就是Shadow of Doubt……

所以，我在这里列出所有这些游戏的原因是，有时候即使你知道自己在做什么，实现其中哪怕一个方面都很难，然而这款游戏的开发者们，没有多少相关经验，仍然决定尝试把所有这些都结合到一起……

[i]蓝色。瓶子。[/i]


老实说，我写这篇评论肯定已经写了两个多星期了，但我仍然不确定我能否完全表达我对……
呃……这么说吧——一切的失望。

而最悲剧的是，这不是糟糕代码的错（也许？）、可疑选择的错（或许？），或者对项目本身态度的错（完全不是？我猜）。
所有糟糕的东西都来自游戏本身……字面意义上是因为它在设计上的构想；让我解释一下……
你知道衔尾蛇是什么吗？对，那条自噬的蛇，实际上不能吃自己之类的，好吧……这款游戏字面上就是它。
只不过它确实把自己吞噬得很好……首先，让我告诉你在这款游戏里你会怎样度过游戏时间：
前30分钟会不错，一切都会像光一样快速轻松……
然后第二个30分钟来了……你会开始注意到轻微的问题——微卡顿、几秒钟“思考”、加速时卡顿……
然后到了卢比孔河——一个半小时后游戏会变得很难玩……缓慢，有时冻结……
最终它会逐渐停摆。你会发现自己盯着游戏，每“响应”一分钟就要花十分钟处于“未响应”状态……最终你只能杀掉进程，等十秒钟，重启游戏（可能还要重启一半的应用，因为游戏会持续吞噬你的内存，远远超过16Gb中的12Gb，你的电脑肯定会开始发疯，试图通过把所有“未使用”的东西放进“暂停”状态来减轻负担，包括Steam。）然后循环重新开始。

“为什么会这样？我们怎么修复它？开发者为什么不修复它？”——你大概问过这些问题，而查看resmon不会满足你好奇的头脑，除非你读日志。
没错，他们为之牺牲其他一切的“完美模拟”野心反噬了他们自己的屁股。

所以……你还记得你是怎么创建角色的吗？除非你立刻点了“寻找飞船”，选了The Retrofit并离开角色创建（如果你这是第二个角色，那就是走向死亡。如果你是职业玩家，那就是走向荣耀。）——游戏通常会吐出一堆与你成长经历相关的NPC……势利眼、警察、暴徒、傻瓜……朋友或敌人，简而言之就是“一整副牌”。
你猜怎么着？每个生成的NPC某种程度上确实会经历同样的流程！不，他们不会像你一样自闭地盯着镜子（那面镜子上次见到清洁工大概还是它被制造出来的时候）……
但他们确实会“掷骰”人生……还有一大把跟班！而且他们也会有自己的……然后一次又一次又一次，直到碰到某种限制器，但是（是的，有个讨厌的“但是”！大概还有一整帮“但是”！）这个“限制器”似乎……这么说吧，有时候他/她(?)会请[strike]一天假[/strike]整整产假——NPC偶尔会像兔子一样繁殖，那些兔子吞下了一整箱“成人化学品”……你懂的（如果你不懂……那你他妈为什么在读这个？这游戏不是给小孩的，天哪）。

如果你的存档开始时只有300-320个NPC——几天后就会变成370。一周后=400……两三周后=>500（感谢上帝没有超过9000！）
你猜怎么着？有时候他们生成时带着一艘飞船！或者，如果不走运——在一艘废弃船上（我是认真的……我见过大概5艘那种带有“船员：1”属性的死船。不，那不是尸体）！
而且有了“货舱起火”，他们甚至还能得到一些带枪的锡罐！甚至互相打起来！这会以某种方式影响你的游戏吗？
只有当你带着飞船在谷神星附近时才会，但说实话——除非使用通行证，否则没有快速安全到达谷神星的好办法。
所以一整套“造物”的杂音正在发生，就像……到处都是！飞船被创造、被摧毁、被毁坏。房间出现又消失。NPC出现、旅行、被“可接受的藻类”噎住，然后被拖进当地的瓦尔哈拉。有时候一个海盗或者只是某个“不是本地人”的人生成进来，然后一整支经验丰富的老兵皇家骑兵队就会冲过去把他的脸狠狠地揍烂（小心那些动不动就开枪的警察！）！

哦！而且每个NPC也会吃、睡、拉，你知道的一切，除了也许……工作？因为在太空里每个人都只吹嘘他们的12/12（都是上午）/7，却一直看戏剧重播[i]（不过技术人员除外……他们有两个额外的疯狂技能：“修东西”和“我才不管你的飞船呢，把你的内裤给我！”……我是说真的……我不得不在我的食品储藏室和厨房门上装密码锁，才能阻止那些“分子”洗劫我的食物/水储备）[/i]好几天，还会因为一把椅子而生气，为什么？因为它是个不舒服的塑料婊子，不允许任何人可靠地放松屁股超过连续两次！更好笑的是游戏的wiki还引用了Rimworld的桌子行为……呃……他们怎么说来着？住在玻璃房子里的人不该扔石头？

你猜怎么着？你的电脑必须模拟[Sseth Tzeenach声音]“所有这些狗屎”，持续且同时！没有怜悯！没有例外！“要么在场，要么就滚，因为你不在场！”——这就是这款游戏模拟工程的座右铭！
哦，放心——那90%的“内容”都会发生在你触及不到的地方（没有调试魔法的话），而且你知道……我觉得那些Steam/Reddit玩家会建议你甚至不要碰的任务其实并不是有bug……或者至少一开始不是。让我引用经典：[b]“真相是……游戏从一开始就被操纵了。”[/b]
只是模拟本身在你意识到之前就已经把你搞砸了。
怎么搞的？杀掉（比喻或字面意义上……有时两者同时）一个任务相关的NPC，并把它从存在中抹除，当然！
[i]（附注：有个关于尸体房的传闻……我很确定那是K-Leg的OKLG-UNC……至少我清理那里时有大概……那个地点有70或90个死NPC！所以没错……他们做到了。他们玩了这个梗——“是的，'删除'他，还要从垃圾桶里删”。）[/i]

这就是整个游戏的主要乐趣杀手！其他系统开发得太不充分，根本不会造成任何问题，或者只是停留在原始实现上，没有任何进一步发展！事实就是你的游戏试图模拟整个他妈的太阳系里各种级别的废物！而且不像“Shadows of Doubt”有有限数量的NPC，Ostranauts决定采取不同的方法……
（我甚至怀疑开发者确实渴望达到约1000个完全模拟的活跃NPC，再加上几百个“冻结备用”，随时准备替补，我恐怕是这样）


不幸的是，能写的内容有限，所以剩余部分请看评论……
如果简短来说，就是“一整副牌”。
你猜怎么着？每个生成的NPC在某种程度上确实会经历同样的流程！不，他们不会像你那样自闭地盯着镜子看（那面镜子最后一次见到清洁工，大概就是它被制造出来的那一刻）……
但他们确实会获得“随机生成”的人生……还有一大把跟班！而且他们也会有自己的……然后一次又一次又一次，直到他们撞上某种限制器，但是（是的，有个讨厌的“但是”！可能是一整帮“但是”！）这个“限制器”似乎……这么说吧，有时候（他/她？）会[strike]休一天假[/strike]休完整的产假——NPC偶尔会像兔子一样繁殖，还是吞了一整箱“成人化学品”的兔子……你懂的（如果你不懂……那你他妈的为什么在读这个？这游戏不是给小孩玩的，靠）。

如果你的存档开始时只有300-320个NPC——几天后就会变成370。一周后=400……两三周后=>500（感谢上帝没有超过9000！）
你猜怎么着？有时候他们生成时会带着一艘船！或者，如果运气不好——会出现在一艘废弃船上（我是认真的……我见过大约5艘那种带有“船员：1”状态的死船。不，那不是尸体）！
而且有了“货舱起火”，他们甚至还会得到一些带枪的锡罐！甚至还会互相打起来！这对你的游戏体验有影响吗？
只有当你带着你的船在谷神星附近时才有——但说实话，除非使用通行证，否则没有什么快速又安全到达谷神星的好办法。
于是，一整套“造物”的嘈杂交响曲就这样……到处都在发生！飞船被创造、被摧毁、被撞毁。房间出现又消失。NPC出现、旅行、被“可接受的藻类”噎死，然后被拖进当地的英灵殿。有时候一个海盗或者某个“不是本地帮派的人”生成了，然后一整支由老资格OG组成的皇家骑兵队就朝它冲过去，把它那张脸狠狠地揍烂（小心那些一触即发的警察！）！

哦！而且每个NPC还会吃饭、睡觉、拉屎，你知道的一切，除了也许……工作？因为在太空里，每个人只会吹嘘自己的12/12（都是上午）/7，却一直看肥皂剧重播[i]（不过技术人员除外……他们有两个额外的绝活：“修-东-西”和“我他妈才不管你的船，把你的内裤给我！”……我是说真的……我不得不在我的食品储藏室和厨房门上装密码锁，才能阻止那些“分子”洗劫我的食物/水储备）[/i]一连好几天，还会被一把椅子惹毛，为什么？因为它是个不舒服的塑料婊子，不允许任何人可靠地放松屁股超过连续两次！更好笑的是，游戏维基里还引用了《环世界》的桌子行为……呃……他们怎么说来着？住在玻璃房子里的人不该扔石头？

你猜怎么着？你的电脑必须模拟[Sseth Tzeenach 嗓音]“所有这些狗屎”，持续不断地、同时进行！没有怜悯！没有例外！“要么在场，要么就滚蛋，因为你根本不在场！”——这就是这游戏模拟系统的座右铭！
哦，放心——那“内容”的90%都会发生在你触及范围之外（没有调试魔法的话），而且你知道……我觉得那些许多Steam/Reddit玩家会建议你连碰都别碰的任务，其实并不是有bug……或者至少一开始不是。让我引用经典：[b]“真相是……这游戏从一开始就被做了手脚。”[/b]
只是模拟本身在你意识到这一点之前就已经把你搞砸了。
怎么搞的？杀掉（比喻或字面意义上……或者有时候——两者同时）一个与任务相关的NPC，然后当然就是把它从存在中抹除！
[i]（附注：有个关于尸体房的传闻……而且我相当确定那就是K-Leg的OKLG-UNC……至少我清理那里的时候，那个地点上大概有……70到90个死掉的NPC！所以是的……他们做到了。他们玩了这个梗——“是的，‘删除’他，还要从垃圾桶里也删掉”。）[/i]

而这正是整个游戏的主要乐趣杀手！其他系统简直开发不足，根本不会造成任何问题，或者只是停留在原始实现阶段，没有任何后续开发！事实就是，你的游戏试图模拟整个他妈的太阳系里各种级别的废物！而且不像《疑影重重》那样有有限数量的NPC，Ostranauts决定采取不同的方法……
（我甚至怀疑开发者确实渴望达到大约1000个完全模拟的活跃NPC，再加上几百个“冻结备用”，随时准备替补，我恐怕是这样）


不幸的是，能写的内容有限，所以剩余部分请看评论……
关于那间尸体房……而且我相当确定那是K-Leg的OKLG-UNC……至少当我做一次清理时，那个地点上大概有……70或90个死亡NPC！所以没错……他们干了。他们玩了这个梗——“是的，‘删除’他，而且还要从回收站里删掉”。）[/i]

而这就是整个游戏最大的乐趣杀手！其他系统简直开发不足，根本不会造成任何问题，或者只是停留在原始实现阶段，没有任何后续开发！事实就是，你的游戏试图模拟整个该死的太阳系里各种级别的废物！而且不像《疑影重重》那样NPC数量有限，Ostranauts决定采用一种不同的方式……
（我甚至怀疑开发者确实渴望达到约1000个完全模拟的活跃NPC这样的数量，外加几百个“冷冻备用”，随时准备替补，我恐怕是这样）


不幸的是，能写的内容有字数限制，所以剩余部分请看评论……

items.text:
This is one of those really difficult reviews where I wish I could give a more nuanced rating than "yes" or "no", but I have to lean toward "no". While my hours are inflated (full hours get added up from if it was running when you enter/exit your computer's sleep mode), it's absolutely been something I'd come back to repeatedly, so if the question is "will you get ~$16  of entertainment?" the answer is very probably "Yes".

However, the game has MASSIVE flaws, and ultimately it hasn't changed much from the state it was in even like 4-5 years ago. 

I've seen a lot of reviews go into detail about issues with the AI, and while those can be real I think a lot of the discussion there is kinda missing the bigger picture:
[b]This game has no point.[/b]

Gameplay for you if you've started is gonna feel exciting! There's so many wrecks to go explore, if you have a keen eye you might notice a couple (as in just two...) nearby-ish areas worth checking out, and you'll probably find yourself in a pretty initially satisfying loop of scrapping ships for valuable components to sell and improving your own starter ship a little. 

Then you might start trying to flip ships to make some serious money sooner, or to at least be less dependent on OKLG since there's literally no sources of electrical power other than fusion reactors or buying it from a station.

Now the game will have started to feel a lot more grindy, especially as you start to realize how many systems just aren't deep at all... except maybe deeply repetitive. But alright, you're making money and maybe hired an NPC and you've been micromanaging twice as much as before because their autonomy sucks and the tools to give them specific orders suck (you can't even queue orders except in a very specific way that has no priority or order and might result in them deciding it's time to nearly smoke themselves to death in airlock instead of working). 

But hey, now you've got the cash to pay off your debt and afford fuel for the fusion reactor you've built by now! It's time to go torching across the system! And hey, there seemed to at least be one quest that had actual story to it instead of being FO4 infinite quest tier, over at The Flotilla, maybe the world's gonna finally open up now and have so much more depth!

Oh.

[i] Oh... [/i]

It's about here where, after journeying for a few days to Venus or Ceres, that feeling is going to start to creep in. You'll realize almost nothing is really different -- that every station feels exceptionally sterile and lifeless, and while there's a few tiny scattered bits of content you can try to participate in, there's somehow even less story content there to capture you than NEO Scavenger. 

Anyway, that probably does an adequate job of describing my main gripe with the game. 

Because, see, It runs well, it's truly cool how some systems can appear to have depth at first, and while there's massive issues with AI you don't really have to engage with them at all. Even with flaws like the AI, you can make some use of a crewmember by just keeping them on permanent repair duty inside the ship or just treat them as an organic sex doll + chatbot combo to keep your captain's moods up. Not that the moods really matter almost at all. 

Well, I guess even when saying it's cool, I can't avoid discussing flaws, huh! Same as I could discuss how cool the travel is... until you try docking at venus and realize the values you're provided are super wonky and there's very little in the way of orbital info provided to you, making docking a continuous-thrust sort of affair that somehow just feels deeply *wrong* speaking as a long-time player of games like KSP, COADE, Orbiter, etc.

Aaaaand then it always comes back to that sterility I mentioned. Every station feels empty and lifeless or just populated by ants, 99% of the apparent quests are totally sterile and literally lacking even distinct flavor text while the remainder aren't nearly common or deep enough and feel totally detached from all the systems you've otherwise been engaging with, and even the few legitimate additions compared to a few years ago like ship combat are just so simplistic and easy and hardly feel satisfying since they really don't feel meaningful on much of a level and tend to just make you realize that even on a systems level this is a game that might have 2 or 3 parts for something where another game might have 10 or 20+. 

Maybe some day Modders Will Fix It (tm), but I really don't think that seems likely. It's a great concept, but the execution is deeply lacking and frankly kinda lazy given the dev-time. If Dan ever reads this, I really don't wanna crush your spirits man, there's a reason I've still played the game probably something like 60-80 hours as of the time of the review, but this just feels like a game that could have been done significantly better instead of basically being released at a state that really feels like an Alpha or Beta build deeply in need of more content and depth. 




btw since some people have complained about performance, check my attached specs, my hardware absolutely isn't supercomputer tier and it runs just as well even on my thinkpad, I DO think the dev's done a pretty nice job on optimization.
items.text_zh:
这是一篇非常难写的评测，我希望能给出比“是”或“否”更细致的评分，但我不得不倾向于“否”。虽然我的游戏时长被夸大了（如果你在电脑进入/退出睡眠模式时游戏仍在运行，完整的小时数也会被累加进去），但这绝对是我会反复回来玩的东西，所以如果问题是“你能从中获得大约16美元的娱乐价值吗？”答案很可能是“能”。

然而，这款游戏有着巨大的缺陷，而且归根结底，它和四五年前的状态相比几乎没什么变化。

我看到很多评测详细讨论了AI的问题，虽然那些问题确实存在，但我认为很多相关讨论有点没抓住重点：
[b]这款游戏没有意义。[/b]

如果你刚开始玩，游戏体验会让你感到兴奋！有那么多残骸可以去探索，如果你眼尖的话，可能会注意到附近有那么几个（也就是仅仅两个……）值得一看的区域，而且你可能会发现自己陷入一个最初相当令人满足的循环：拆解飞船获取有价值的部件来出售，并稍微升级你自己的初始飞船。

然后你可能会开始尝试倒卖飞船来更快地赚大钱，或者至少减少对OKLG的依赖，因为除了聚变反应堆或从空间站购买之外， literally 没有任何电力来源。

现在游戏会开始感觉更加肝了，尤其是当你开始意识到有多少系统根本毫无深度……也许只是深度重复。但好吧，你在赚钱，也许雇了一个NPC，而且你一直在做双倍的微观管理，因为他们的自主性很糟糕，而且给他们下达具体命令的工具也很糟糕（你甚至无法排队命令，除非用一种非常特定的方式，这种方式没有优先级也没有顺序，可能导致他们决定是时候在气闸里把自己差点熏死，而不是去工作）。

但是嘿，现在你有现金来还清债务，并为你现在已经建好的聚变反应堆买得起燃料了！是时候穿越整个星系了！而且嘿，在The Flotilla那里似乎至少有一个任务有真正的剧情，而不是FO4那种无限任务级别的东西，也许世界终于要开放了，会有更多的深度！

哦。

[i] 哦…… [/i]

大约就是在这里，在前往金星或谷神星旅行了几天之后，那种感觉会开始悄悄袭来。你会意识到几乎没有什么真正不同——每个空间站都感觉异常 sterile 和毫无生气，虽然有一些零星的微小内容可以尝试参与，但那里能吸引你的剧情内容不知怎的比NEO Scavenger还要少。

总之，这大概足够描述我对这款游戏的主要不满之处了。

因为，你看，它运行良好，有些系统一开始看起来有深度，这真的很酷，而且虽然AI有巨大的问题，但你其实完全不必去碰它们。即使有AI这样的缺陷，你也可以通过让船员在飞船内永久执行维修任务来利用他们，或者干脆把他们当作有机性爱娃娃+聊天机器人的组合来保持船长的情绪。倒不是说情绪几乎完全不重要。

好吧，我想即使是在说它酷的时候，我也无法避免讨论缺陷，是吧！就像我可以讨论旅行有多酷……直到你尝试在金星对接，然后意识到提供给你的数值超级不稳定，而且几乎没有提供任何轨道信息，使得对接变成一种持续推力式的操作，作为一个长期玩KSP、COADE、Orbiter等游戏的玩家来说，这不知怎的就让人感觉深深*不对劲*。

然后一切又总是回到我提到的那种 sterile 感。每个空间站都感觉空荡荡、毫无生气，或者只是挤满了蚂蚁，99%的表面任务都完全 sterile，甚至字面上缺乏独特的风味文本，而剩下的那些又不够常见或不够有深度，感觉与你一直在互动的所有系统完全脱节，即使是相比几年前少数几个真正的添加内容，比如飞船战斗，也太过简单和容易，几乎不让人觉得满足，因为它们真的在大多数层面上感觉没什么意义，而且往往只会让你意识到，即使在系统层面上，这也是一款可能只有两三个部分的游戏，而另一款游戏可能有10个或20个以上。

也许有一天Modders Will Fix It（tm），但我真的不认为那看起来有可能。这是一个很棒的概念，但执行深度不足，坦率地说，考虑到开发时间，有点懒惰。如果Dan读到这个，我真的不想打击你的士气，老兄，我在写这篇评测时仍然玩了大概60到80个小时是有原因的，但这感觉就像是一款本可以做得明显更好的游戏，而不是基本上以一个真的感觉像是Alpha或Beta版本的状态发布，急需更多内容和深度。




顺便说一句，既然有些人抱怨性能问题，看看我附上的配置，我的硬件绝对不是超级计算机级别的，即使在我的ThinkPad上运行得也一样好，我确实认为开发者在优化方面做得相当不错。
在提供给你的轨道信息方面，对接变成了一种持续推力式的操作，作为一个长期玩KSP、COADE、Orbiter等游戏的玩家来说，这种感觉莫名地就是深深*不对劲*。

然后，一切又总是回到我提到的那种死气沉沉。每个空间站都感觉空荡荡、毫无生气，或者只是被一群蚂蚁占据着，99%的表面任务都完全死板，甚至字面上连独特的风味文本都没有，而剩下的那些又不够常见或不够深入，感觉与你本来一直在互动的所有系统完全脱节，即使是相比几年前少数几个真正的添加内容，比如舰船战斗，也太过简单、太容易，几乎感觉不到满足感，因为它们真的在大多数层面上感觉不到有意义，而且往往只会让你意识到，即使在系统层面上，这也是一个可能只有2到3个部分的东西，而另一个游戏可能会有10个或20多个。

也许有一天Modders Will Fix It (tm)，但我真的不认为那看起来可能。这是一个很棒的概念，但执行上严重不足，坦率地说，考虑到开发时间，还有点懒。如果Dan读到这个，我真的不想打击你的士气，老兄，有一个原因是我在写这篇评测时可能已经玩了大概60-80小时，但这感觉就像是一个本可以做得明显更好的游戏，而不是基本上以一个真的感觉像是Alpha或Beta版本的状态发布，急需更多内容和深度。




顺便说一句，既然有些人抱怨性能问题，看看我附上的配置，我的硬件绝对不是超级计算机级别的，即使在我的ThinkPad上运行得也一样好，我确实认为开发者在优化方面做得相当不错。

items.text:
Sadly not the game I was hopping for:

It's just a bunch of unrelated features thrown into a mix with a bad 2D space engineer rip-off.
Systems such as NPC interactions are completely meaningless and boring. 
The game is not challenging at all.

And you'll never be sure whether it's a bug or just not programmed into the game.
On one occasion, I had two NPCs die at the K-Log port in front of a kiosk. None of the other NPCs reacted to it, and the bodies were still there hours later.

Another example of this abysmal game design:
I boarded a neutral ship above K-Log, and the game indicated that this was a hostile act with consequences. However, neither the pilot nor anyone on K-Log recognised this. 

Even after killing the pilot and selling some of his ship parts at the port, nothing happened.

It feels like different mechanics have been thrown together without any real purpose.
items.text_zh:
遗憾的是，这不是我所期待的游戏：

它只是一堆互不相关的功能混杂在一起，再加上一个糟糕的2D版《太空工程师》山寨货。
像NPC互动这样的系统完全毫无意义且无聊。
这游戏根本没有任何挑战性。

而且你永远无法确定某个东西是bug还是根本没被编程进游戏里。
有一次，我在K-Log港的一个售货亭前有两个NPC死了。其他NPC都没有对此做出反应，几个小时后尸体还在那里。

另一个这种糟糕游戏设计的例子：
我在K-Log上方登上了一艘中立飞船，游戏提示这是一种敌对行为并会有后果。然而，无论是飞行员还是K-Log上的任何人都没有意识到这一点。

即使在杀死飞行员并在港口卖掉他的一些飞船部件之后，什么也没有发生。

感觉就像不同的机制被胡乱拼凑在一起，没有任何真正的目的。

items.text: It's really good, but not perfect. I think there could be much better 3D modeling for characters and held props and the life simulation/conversations with NPCs is very rough around the edges for this being 1.0. More often then not they'll just wander away mid conversation or simply fail to give a reply, stalling the convo until it fixes itself.  The prebaked responses get old fast, I genuinely feel like I'm just talking to the same person over and over again, no one so far really striking me as unique or memorable. Also the sprites used are pretty hard to identify visually at first, couldn't really tell what most things were at first glance without right clicking it or holding alt. All that being said, I really enjoy the concept and have had some fun so far. Just feel like it's missing a lot more depth/refinement/polish to truly immerse me in the world and characters. Hopefully this 1.0 achievement will fund the project a little further so these things can be overhauled. There's something truly great here, it just needs more time to fully get there imo.
items.text_zh: 它真的很好，但并不完美。我认为角色和手持道具的3D建模本可以好得多，而且对于1.0版本来说，与NPC的生活模拟/对话非常粗糙。很多时候他们会在对话中途直接走开，或者干脆不回复，让对话卡住，直到它自己恢复正常。预设好的回应很快就让人腻了，我真的感觉自己只是在一遍又一遍地和同一个人说话，到目前为止没有人真正让我觉得独特或难忘。另外，使用的精灵图一开始在视觉上很难辨认，第一眼不右键点击或按住Alt的话，我根本看不出大多数东西是什么。话虽如此，我真的很喜欢这个概念，到目前为止也玩得挺开心。只是觉得它缺少更多深度/打磨/润色，无法真正让我沉浸到这个世界和角色中。希望这个1.0成就能为项目再提供一些资金，让这些东西得以重做。这里确实有非常棒的东西，只是在我看来还需要更多时间才能完全达到那个水准。

items.text:
This is a game that is just compelling enough to get you to waste your time.

The game isn't done. Rarely will you even be able to do basic tasks in the starter area without the game breaking catastrophically. The good aspects of the game are compounded by half-baked time wasting excersizes. When it does get going, many things don't work; NPCs don't work, dialogue doesn't work, orders don't really work, timelapse doesn't work, plotting a course doesn't work, etc. Like, tell me a normal-ass Oblivion-style dialogue system wouldn't just be better than what's here?

When you are just scrapping a hull for valuable parts and everything is working as intended, it sure is fun, don't get me wrong. I'm all for confusing systems, but they have to work. NeoScavenger was good. They bit off more than they could chew with this one unfortunetly.

Edit: I havent played that many hours of the game, I just left it on overnight because it takes about thirty minutes to load up and is prone to crashing and losing saves. Anyways, I have found the way that this game crashes and breaks the most is with the pathing. Remove things from your ship that cause the path to break, don't hire crewmembers except if you need them and directly order them around (then fire them), and avoid using haul orders and orders in general, as they cause the pathing to break. If you don't think it's gonna work, don't try it; the game visibly stutters when trying to find a path to an order even under the best circumstances. Don't engage with bugged NPCs, you will have to reset your computer this game crashes so bad. 1.0 "release" my ass. Learn how to use the debug. Lucky I am used to playing broken games lol.

If you are really really really into games like this (like I unfortunetly am...) than go for it I guess. You will be fighting the game the whole time.

这是一款刚好足够引人入胜、让你浪费时间的游戏。

这游戏还没做完。你甚至很少能在起始区域完成基本任务而不让游戏灾难性地崩溃。游戏里好的方面被半生不熟、浪费时间的练习所拖累。当它真正运转起来时，很多东西都不管用；NPC不管用，对话不管用，命令不太管用，时间流逝不管用，规划航线不管用，等等。就像，告诉我一个普普通通的《湮灭》风格的对话系统难道不会比这里的东西更好吗？

当你只是在拆解船体获取有价值的零件、一切都按预期运转时，那确实很好玩，别误会我。我完全支持令人困惑的系统，但它们必须能运转。《新拾荒者》就很好。不幸的是，他们在这款游戏上贪多嚼不烂。

编辑：我没玩多少小时，我只是让它通宵开着，因为加载大约需要三十分钟，而且容易崩溃并丢失存档。总之，我发现这款游戏崩溃和出故障最多的方式是在寻路方面。从你的船上移除会导致路径中断的东西，不要雇佣船员，除非你需要他们并直接指挥他们（然后解雇他们），并避免使用搬运命令以及一般命令，因为它们会导致寻路中断。如果你觉得它不会成功，就别试；即使在最好的情况下，游戏在尝试为一条命令寻找路径时也会明显卡顿。不要与有bug的NPC互动，这款游戏崩溃得太厉害，你会不得不重启电脑。1.0“正式版”个屁。学学怎么用调试吧。幸好我习惯了玩坏掉的游戏，哈哈。

如果你真的真的真的非常喜欢这类游戏（就像我不幸地那样……），那我想你就去玩吧。你会全程和游戏作斗争。

Это странная игра. Что-то вроде внебрачного дитя barotrauma, kerbal space program, sims и Neo scavenger. В основе своей это RPG, вы играете за эдакого космического бича, который, получив где-то какой-то жизненный опыт (экран создания персонажа), обзавелся своим совершенно ушатанным ржавым космическим кораблём и теперь шарится по каким-то свалкам кораблей и помойкам ради оплаты ипотеки на этот самый корабль, венерианского гражданства и однушки на станции K-Leg. 

Вроде задел колоссальный, механик масса, а вроде играется как технодемка. Огромное количество багов и адски тупой ии, который убивает себя сам за считанные минуты. Часть багов смешные, часть совершенно ломающие, часть потенциально могут уничтожить ваш сейв. Большая часть того что вы можете и не можете делать так или иначе упирается в слабый ии. Более того игра постоянно подталкивает вас к кретинистическому взаимодействию с местными болванчиками. Возможно, просто мой персонаж такой стрёмный, но у меня не получается нормально взаимодействовать с местными нормисами и они все почему-то отказываются работать на моей ласточке.

items.text:
This is a game where you start off as an exploited worker on a corporate-run space station, barely scraping by with the money you get from salvaging derelict spaceships. But unlike in other games, you don't have to stay there. Instead of selling all that scrap, you can take and build your own ship with it. You can expand your existing ship, add rooms, build a reactor from scrap parts, and in the end you will have a ship that you know is yours. Not your character's, but yours. 

This games gives you a feeling of ownership and reality like none I have ever played. Every piece of bulkhead, every deckplate, every oxygen sensor, every oxygen pump, every electrical conduit is something you, the player, put there. Nothing is quite as satisfying as walking through the ship that you built, sleeping in the bedroom you made, then taking the ship around the solar system.

There are so many moments of organic storytelling here. One time, as I docked with a derelict, a pirate came on board and told me it was now his ship. I armed myself ready to fight, but it seemed like his heart really wasn't in it, and we ended up bantering about sports instead, and then after a few minutes of that, I asked him to leave my ship and he did. He went back onto the derelict and just sort of hung out there for a bit. I ended up feeling sorry for him and hiring him on as a crew member. He proved very useful as he was a hard worker who worked quickly to help me build my ship up, and he had hacking skills too, which came in handy on getting the good stuff out of the PDAs we found on the derelicts we were salvaging. After a few weeks, he quit. We parted companny amicably, and then he walked off my ship and onto the station, where he was immediately tackled by security and arrested. I never said he was smart.

The whole solar system is modeled here, distances and travel times are realistic, and even with your powerful torch drive engines driven by your fusion reactor, a trip to the outer planets can take weeks. And it reallys creates a sense of immersion spending that time living on your ship, going through daily meals, wishing you'd installed a few more creature comforts, maybe a TV or an arcade game cabinet, or a more comfortable bed, and it is genuinely cathartic when you finally reach your destination.

There are a few gripes, sure. While the Venus colonies are beautiful and have lots of stuff to explore, and your starting base of K-LEG feels suitably gritty, a lot of the rest of the system feels a bit under-developed. The AI can occasionally be stupid, which can be frustrating when you need them to do something for you. A lot of the in-game quests are broken, but none of those are really what the game is about. It's a game about being a spacer, and in that regard the experience is unmatched.

—Written by a human being.
items.text_zh:
这是一款游戏，你一开始是一家公司运营的空间站上的一名被剥削的工人，靠打捞废弃飞船赚来的钱勉强糊口。但与其他游戏不同，你不必一直待在那里。与其卖掉所有那些废料，你可以用它们来建造自己的飞船。你可以扩建现有的飞船，增加房间，用废料零件建造反应堆，最终你会拥有一艘你知道是属于你的飞船。不是你角色的，而是你的。

这款游戏给了我一种前所未有的归属感和真实感。每一块舱壁、每一块甲板、每一个氧气传感器、每一个氧气泵、每一条电缆导管，都是你，玩家，亲手放置的。没有什么比走过自己建造的飞船、睡在自己打造的卧室里、然后驾驶飞船环游太阳系更令人满足的了。

这里有太多有机叙事的时刻。有一次，当我与一艘废弃飞船对接时，一个海盗上了船，告诉我这现在是他的飞船了。我武装好自己准备战斗，但他似乎并不真心想打，结果我们反而聊起了体育，几分钟后，我让他离开我的飞船，他就走了。他回到那艘废弃飞船上，就在那里待了一会儿。我最后为他感到难过，就雇他当了船员。他证明非常有用，因为他是个勤奋的人，干活很快，帮我建造飞船，而且他还有黑客技能，这在从我们打捞的废弃飞船上找到的PDA中提取好东西时派上了用场。几周后，他辞职了。我们友好地分道扬镳，然后他走下我的飞船，走上空间站，在那里他立刻被安保人员扑倒并逮捕了。我从没说过他聪明。

整个太阳系都在这里被建模，距离和旅行时间都很真实，即使有你由聚变反应堆驱动的强大火炬引擎，前往外行星的旅程也可能需要数周。而花那些时间生活在你的飞船上，经历日常三餐，希望自己多装了一些舒适设施，也许是一台电视或一个街机柜，或者一张更舒适的床，这真的营造出一种沉浸感，当你最终到达目的地时，那是一种真正的宣泄。

当然，也有一些抱怨。虽然金星殖民地很美丽，有很多东西可以探索，而且你的起始基地K-LEG感觉也足够粗粝，但太阳系其余大部分地方感觉有点开发不足。AI有时会很蠢，当你需要它们为你做某事时，这可能会令人沮丧。很多游戏内任务都坏了，但这些都不是这款游戏真正的内容。这是一款关于成为一名太空人的游戏，在这方面，体验是无与伦比的。

——由人类撰写。

items.text:
It’s honestly really sad for me to leave a negative review for this game.
As you can see, I’ve spent over 150 hours in this game, and that was all for just a SINGLE playthrough.
I was able to visit all the major locations (OKLG, Venus, Ceres) featuring actual content (not placeholders) currently in the game, and I completed all the story missions.

So... What went wrong? 
This game has been in Early Access for SIX years already. In many respects, it still feels like an unfinished demo version of a real game.
You will constantly encounter bugs that break the gameplay, kill your characters, ruin the story, and so on.
This game is INCREDIBLY broken; I have never played a game that was more broken. The AI ​​is simply terrible -it constantly kills itself on your ship and at stations. On Ceres, all the AI ​​ships that are supposed to fight keep shutting down and dying, freezing in "stasis" until you use the game console to fix it.

And you know what? I was absolutely horrified when I saw that they plan to remove the "Early Access" tag on August 3, 2026 - even with the game in its current state.

So... It seems to me that the developers pinned huge hopes on this game. You can see it in the extent to which they rewrote the engine and core features, and in their attempts to "simulate a galaxy" -they wanted to create a new Space Rangers, but they lacked the skilled developers needed to pull it off. And here we are. They just want to abandon the game. It was clearly six years of troubled development for a game they simply weren't capable of making good. 
Can you have fun with this game despite all that? Yeah, but you’ll constantly be fighting against the game itself.. Cheers... It’s just sad; this game could have been something much bigger.

老实说，给这款游戏留下差评让我真的很难过。
如你所见，我在这款游戏里花了超过150个小时，而这仅仅是为了完成一次通关。
我得以造访了游戏中目前所有拥有实际内容（而非占位符）的主要地点（OKLG、金星、谷神星），并且完成了所有剧情任务。

那么……哪里出了问题？
这款游戏已经处于抢先体验阶段整整六年了。在许多方面，它仍然感觉像是一款真正游戏的未完成演示版。
你会不断遇到破坏游戏进程、杀死你的角色、毁掉剧情的bug，等等。
这款游戏坏得难以置信；我从未玩过比这更破碎的游戏。AI简直糟糕透顶——它会在你的飞船上和空间站里不断自杀。在谷神星上，所有本应战斗的AI飞船都会不断关机并死亡，冻结在“停滞”状态，直到你用游戏控制台来修复它。

而且你知道吗？当我看到他们计划在2026年8月3日移除“抢先体验”标签时——即便游戏还处于目前这种状态——我彻底被吓到了。

所以……在我看来，开发者对这款游戏寄予了巨大的期望。你可以从他们重写引擎和核心功能的程度，以及他们试图“模拟一个星系”的尝试中看出来——他们想创造一个新的《太空游侠》，但他们缺乏实现这一目标所需的有能力的开发者。于是就成了现在这样。他们只是想放弃这款游戏。这显然是六年的艰难开发，为了一个他们根本没有能力做好的游戏。
尽管如此，你还能从这款游戏中获得乐趣吗？可以，但你会不断地与游戏本身作斗争……干杯……只是很悲哀；这款游戏本可以成为大得多的东西。

items.text:
Its a tragedy this game is being released at 1.0 shortly. It needs a LOT more time to cook. The ideas are so phenomenal but the execution is just not there as things are. Basic functions in the game don't work reliably. AI is broken to the point where its easier and safer to just manually do everything instead of giving orders. Either that or get ready to reload the save because your auto-tasked character walked out into the vacuum of space without putting on their helmet, while you're in the middle of a salvage. Okay so full manual control it is. Except the art direction and UI make every moment a fight to do what you need to. The missions are bugged and randomly disappear. The performance is awful, even on a beefy computer. None of these would be deal breakers but apparently the game is being released as 'feature complete' in days. There is no way all the major issues are addressed in a few days when it hasn't happened over the years this has been in EA. 

It pains me to be so critical because there is currently nothing out there trying to do what this game is. Underneath all the issues is my dream space sim- one where you can pilot your own ship (complete with tactile switches and knobs), build and tinker with various parts, trade, fight, and basically just RP living in the Firefly universe.
items.text_zh:
这个游戏即将在1.0版本发布，真是个悲剧。它需要更多时间来打磨。想法非常出色，但就目前的情况来看，执行根本不到位。游戏中的基本功能无法可靠运行。AI坏到了极点，以至于手动做所有事情比下达命令更容易也更安全。要么就准备好重新加载存档，因为你自动分配任务的角色没戴头盔就走进了太空真空，而你正在打捞中途。好吧，那就完全手动控制吧。但美术方向和UI让每一刻都变成了一场为实现目标而进行的战斗。任务有bug并且会随机消失。性能很糟糕，即使在性能强劲的电脑上也是如此。这些都不是致命问题，但显然游戏几天后就要以“功能完整”的状态发布了。多年来在EA阶段都没能解决的问题，不可能在几天内全部解决。

如此苛刻地批评让我很痛苦，因为目前没有任何游戏在尝试做这个游戏所做的事情。在所有问题之下，是我梦想中的太空模拟游戏——一个你可以驾驶自己的飞船（配有触觉开关和旋钮），建造和修补各种部件，贸易，战斗，基本上就是在《萤火虫》宇宙中角色扮演生活。

items.text:
[h1]1000 Hours: Just getting started.[/h1]
TLDR; if you like slow, vibey, salvage and survival. And you can be patient for the first ten hours. You'll like this a lot.

I have been playing this game for over 1000 hours. I love it. The entertainment value of 400 movies.
I like to just veg out and salvage wrecks while I watch YouTube. I've done a few of the storylines. 
The main loop is satisfying enough for me. I've done several characters, learned how to survive well enough that I am not in immediate danger. But mostly I pay off my debt, get a nice ship and start visiting the rest of the solar system.

[h2]Pros[/h2]
[list]
[*] Atmosphere - love the setting and lore, even if I don't remember all of it or need to.
[*] Buy a ship or build your own, and build it however you want
[*] This is slow space. No instant gratification. Adds to the feel
[*] Lots of ways to play - mostly I focus on stripping every wreck for the $$$ parts
[*] Devs are very responsive - several things I've reported or experienced have been fixed within a month
[*] Vibes, everything feels lived in, real.
[/list]

[h2]Cons[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bugs: there are frequently minor bugs, but they [i]mostly[/i] don't crash or block gameplay anymore.
[*] [strike]Lag: the game used to slow down a LOT[/strike] the updates from the last few months have mostly fixed this.
[*] Quests: These need some work. It's unclear what to do to progress them sometimes without looking up the wiki or discord.
[*] Employees: Hiring people is often more trouble than it is worth. They ignore your orders and try to walk outside without a helmet.
[*] AI pathing can be psychotic.
[*] Moodlets and social combat? Never clear what to do and why my chars' mood is so poor. Everyone is too horny.
[/list]

This is not an easy game. But after the first ten hours you should be able to survive long enough to not die accidentally. Take it easy when you are travelling. Speed up the game instead of speeding up your ship.
If you feel inclined, reporting detailed bug reports helps and will usually be addressed.

If you want quick combat and crazy action, this really is not for you.
items.text_zh:
[h1]1000小时：才刚刚开始。[/h1]
长话短说；如果你喜欢缓慢、有氛围的回收与生存。而且你能在最初十个小时里保持耐心。你会非常喜欢这个。

我已经玩这款游戏超过1000小时了。我爱它。娱乐价值相当于400部电影。
我喜欢一边看YouTube一边放空自己打捞残骸。我做过几条故事线。
主循环对我来说已经足够令人满足。我玩过好几个角色，学会了如何活得足够好，以至于不会立刻陷入危险。但大多数时候我还清债务，弄到一艘好船，然后开始造访太阳系的其余部分。

[h2]优点[/h2]
[list]
[*] 氛围——喜欢这个设定和背景故事，即使我记不住全部，也不需要记住。
[*] 买一艘船或自己造一艘，想怎么造就怎么造
[*] 这是缓慢的太空。没有即时满足感。这增添了感觉
[*] 有很多玩法——我主要专注于把每一艘残骸拆光，拿走值$$$的部件
[*] 开发者非常积极回应——我报告或遇到的几件事都在一个月内被修复了
[*] 氛围感，一切都感觉有人生活过，真实。
[/list]

[h2]缺点[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bug：经常有轻微bug，但它们[i]大多[/i]不再崩溃或阻碍游玩了。
[*] [strike]卡顿：游戏过去会严重变慢[/strike] 过去几个月的更新大多修复了这个问题。
[*] 任务：这些需要一些改进。有时不清楚该做什么来推进它们，除非去查wiki或discord。
[*] 雇员：雇人往往弊大于利。他们无视你的命令，还想不戴头盔走到外面去。
[*] AI寻路可能会疯得离谱。
[*] 心情状态和社交战斗？从来不清楚该做什么，也不清楚为什么我角色的心情这么差。每个人都太饥渴了。
[/list]

这不是一款简单的游戏。但在最初十个小时之后，你应该能活得足够久，不至于意外死亡。旅行时放轻松。加速游戏，而不是加速你的飞船。
如果你愿意，提交详细的bug报告会有帮助，而且通常会被处理。

如果你想要快速战斗和疯狂动作，这真的不适合你。

I have been playing this game off and on from its first day in early access. It is honestly my dream game, and one I will be coming back to for years. almost 300hrs I've spent with Ostranauts and I have not even left the starting area, so in some ways I cannot say much to the wider parts of this game. I don't know what ship combat is like. Though my latest ship has a reactor installed on it, I've never fired it up since I'm pretty sure I will just blow myself up. There are a few complaints I might have for it. The AI is not always great, and once and a while I will run into a bug or two, but as this is still in early access, I'm not exactly worried about it. I love the setting and the detail put into this gritty space sim. I will say that not everyone will like this game. It is niche, but very much a niche I can get down with

Edit for 1.0: I'm not sure why all the hate on this game. people are talking about broken need meters? I have not experienced this myself. Broken AI? maybe, but again i haven't experienced a problem yet. Should this be a 1.0? I think that is fine for the type of game this is...do I hope to see more in the future worked on? Yes...and the devs promised to do so for at least a year.....at the time of this edit I have put 317hrs into this amazing game and plan on playing long into the future. 15 dollars is what I spent on lunch yesterday and it took me 30 minutes to eat it....for a 600hr+ lunch, this is well worth my money, and if you look deep into this experience I believe you will too. Don't skip on this one for its reviews, some folks who want this niche will sorely miss out on a banger due to poor reviews and that just makes me sad....Thank you Bluebottle for the heart and sweat that went into making this unique experience, I am forever grateful to your efforts. Please make more games

我从这款游戏抢先体验的第一天起就断断续续地玩它。老实说，这是我的梦想游戏，也是我会在未来几年里不断回归的一款游戏。我在《Ostranauts》上花了将近300个小时，甚至还没离开起始区域，所以在某些方面，我对这款游戏更广泛的部分说不出太多。我不知道飞船战斗是什么样子。虽然我最新的一艘飞船上装了一个反应堆，但我从未启动过它，因为我相当确定我会把自己炸飞。我可能对它有一些抱怨。AI并不总是很好，偶尔我会遇到一两个bug，但由于这仍处于抢先体验阶段，我并不特别担心。我喜欢这个设定以及投入在这款粗粝太空模拟游戏中的细节。我要说，不是每个人都会喜欢这款游戏。它很小众，但非常是我能接受的那种小众。

1.0版本编辑：我不确定为什么这款游戏遭到这么多恨。人们在说需求计量表坏了吗？我自己没有经历过这个。AI坏了？也许吧，但同样，我还没有遇到问题。这应该是1.0吗？我觉得对于这种类型的游戏来说这没问题……我希望未来能看到更多内容被继续开发吗？是的……而且开发者承诺至少会做一年……在写这条编辑时，我已经在这款了不起的游戏里投入了317个小时，并计划在未来很长一段时间里继续玩。15美元是我昨天午餐花的钱，而我花了30分钟才吃完……对于一顿600小时以上的午餐来说，这钱花得非常值，如果你深入了解这段体验，我相信你也会这么觉得。不要因为它的评测而跳过这一款，一些想要这种小众体验的人会因为差评而痛失一款佳作，这让我很难过……感谢Bluebottle为打造这段独特体验所投入的心血和汗水，我永远感激你们的努力。请做更多游戏。

items.text:
One of my biggest discoveries this year. Same dev as Neo Scavenger, so expect an incredible atmosphere, god-tier writing, and an unforgiving yet incredibly satisfying gameplay loop.

You start as a shipbreaker trying to escape an inhumane, dead-end job that barely pays enough to survive. You take out a massive loan and buy what is basically a flying coffin that's falling apart before your eyes, all so you can finally start making your own choices in the harsh, unforgiving reality of the OKLG.

I still remember the first time I sold a big haul. After one crazy expedition that I somehow survived in one piece, I made more money than I had earned after years of grinding, sacrificing, and saving every dollar while working as another disposable megacorp employee. There's something incredibly compelling—almost relatable—about that feeling.

It's a space sim where you go from absolutely nothing to... maybe not a millionaire, but someone who took control of their own life and built the future they wanted. All of this takes place in a dystopian world where humanity has colonized the Solar System while simultaneously losing contact with Earth (Kessler Syndrome).

This is the good part—actually, the great part.

But then there's the second part.

I would summarize it in one sentence:

Lots of small, medium, big, or just game-breaking problems have been reported over the years, and they're still in the game. The devs know about them very well.

So what do they do?

Yep. They decide to ship 1.0 next month.

As a software engineer myself, it's just painful to watch.

Here's a short list of those problems:

- CTDs.
- Insane loading times (partially fixable with Nexus mods).
- Broken quests (people on Steam and Discord literally recommend not engaging with them).
- A UI that feels like it was designed to make you suffer.
- The game clearly wasn't designed around controlling more than one character, yet it pushes you hard to hire a crew. The AI is from hell, the UI somehow gets even worse, and this introduces all sorts of problems the devs simply didn't think through. The absolute king is below:
- And the worst part: horrible performance. At some point (mid to late game), it becomes literally unplayable. I'm not talking about the usual stuttering that's already everywhere. I'm talking about one frame every three seconds. Yes—0.33 FPS. Performance is such a well-known issue that it even has its own thread on official Discord server. You can reproduce it very easily: just queue around 20 commands (for example, dismantling ship hull walls) while having 4 or more NPCs. The lag persists even after cancelling those commands. Good luck saving the game or reloading it while running at one frame every three seconds. Kekw's on you.

Now look at this list of problems and ask yourself:

"Why. instead of fixing above. the devs are shipping new features that introduce even more bugs, and then set 1.0 release date for next month?"

¯\_(ツ)_/¯

If you still want to play it, here's one pro tip:

Don't hire NPCs. The game was clearly designed around playing a single character. You'll have a lot more fun that way, while minimizing negative-fun you are getting. Trust.
items.text_zh:
这是我今年最大的发现之一。和《Neo Scavenger》是同一个开发者，所以可以期待令人难以置信的氛围、神级的写作，以及一个毫不留情却又极其令人满足的游戏循环。

你一开始是一名拆船工，试图逃离一份不人道、没有前途、几乎不够糊口的工作。你贷了一大笔款，买了一艘基本上就是会飞的棺材、在你眼前分崩离析的船，只为了终于能在OKLG严酷无情的现实中开始做出自己的选择。

我仍然记得第一次卖掉一大批货物的时候。在一次我不知怎么毫发无伤地活下来的疯狂远征之后，我赚到的钱比我作为又一个可随意丢弃的巨型企业员工，多年苦熬、牺牲、省下每一块钱所赚到的还要多。那种感觉有一种难以置信的吸引力——几乎让人感同身受。

这是一款太空模拟游戏，你从一无所有到……也许不是百万富翁，但成为一个掌控了自己人生、建立了自己想要未来的人。这一切都发生在一个反乌托邦世界里，人类已经殖民了太阳系，同时却与地球失去了联系（凯斯勒综合征）。

这是好的部分——其实，是极好的部分。

但接着还有第二部分。

我会用一句话来总结：

多年来人们报告了大量小的、中等的、大的，或者干脆就是破坏游戏的问题，而它们仍然留在游戏里。开发者们对此非常清楚。

那他们怎么做？

没错。他们决定下个月发布1.0。

作为一名软件工程师，看着实在令人痛苦。

以下是这些问题的一小部分清单：

- 崩溃到桌面。
- 疯狂的加载时间（用Nexus的模组可以部分修复）。
- 损坏的任务（Steam和Discord上的人真的建议不要碰它们）。
- 一个感觉像是专门设计来让你受罪的UI。
- 这款游戏显然不是围绕控制多个角色设计的，却硬是逼着你雇佣船员。AI来自地狱，UI不知怎么变得更糟，还引入了开发者根本没想清楚的各种问题。绝对的王者在下面：
- 而最糟糕的部分：可怕的性能。在某个时候（游戏中后期），它会变得简直无法游玩。我说的不是那种已经无处不在的常见卡顿。我说的是每三秒一帧。没错——0.33 FPS。性能问题如此出名，以至于它在官方Discord服务器上都有自己的专属频道。你可以非常容易地复现它：只要在拥有4个或更多NPC时排队大约20条命令（例如拆解船体墙壁）。即使取消这些命令后，卡顿依然存在。在以每三秒一帧运行的时候，祝你好运去存档或读档。Kekw，你自找的。

现在看看这份问题清单，然后问问自己：

“为什么。开发者不去修复上面这些。反而在发布会引入更多bug的新功能，然后还把1.0发布日期定在下个月？”

¯\_(ツ)_/¯

如果你还是想玩，这里有一个专业提示：

不要雇佣NPC。这款游戏显然是围绕扮演单个角色设计的。那样你会玩得开心得多，同时把你获得的负面乐趣降到最低。相信我。

1.0 coming next month and NPC AI update was just released. I should probably say "finally!" but what I'm thinking is "too late for me". this game is definitely special and worth checking out. I just can't forget it's out for like 6 years now and for all that time, my NPC's were biggest AI idiots I had displeasure to meet. I grew so tired of watching them (for like 3 weeks worth of time), I'm not able to play this game anymore. I had mild PTSD-like feeling after reading the changelog instead of being euphoric. curious.
 
Obviously, AI quality is my biggest gripe. Additionally, I felt disappointed because of constant stuttering and save game implementation. "but, but, EA!" well, 5+ years is not really early access to me anymore. but, good news, all those cons most likely not an issue today. I also suspect stations to receive much love in the final release. so, yeah, lucky those who will try it out in August for the first time.

Nevertheless, (and acknowledging I might sound like an entitled little b*ch) I recommend checking this game out. I like the idea very much, I just wish more experienced and bigger studio developed it.

1.0版本下个月推出，NPC AI更新刚刚发布。我大概应该说“终于！”，但我心里想的是“对我来说太晚了”。这个游戏绝对很特别，值得一试。我就是无法忘记它已经推出大约6年了，而在那整个期间，我的NPC们是我有幸遇到的最蠢的AI白痴。我看着他们看得太累了（大约相当于3周的时间），我已经没法再玩这个游戏了。读完更新日志后，我没有感到欣喜若狂，反而有一种轻微的类似PTSD的感觉。真奇怪。
 
显然，AI质量是我最大的不满。此外，我还因为持续的卡顿和存档实现而感到失望。“但是，但是，EA嘛！”好吧，5年多对我来说已经不算早期访问了。不过，好消息是，所有这些缺点今天很可能都不再是问题。我还猜测空间站在最终发布时会得到很多关爱。所以，是的，那些8月第一次尝试它的人真幸运。

尽管如此，（并且承认我可能听起来像个自以为是的小婊子）我推荐试试这个游戏。我非常喜欢这个想法，我只是希望它是由更有经验、更大的工作室开发的。

items.text:
Games like Ostranauts make me hate Early Access.

I was really excited about this game when it came out. A hobo simulator from the creator of NEO Scavenger, only now in space? Being able to create, modify and dismantle ships in an open world sandbox where other space hobos went about their day, blazing your path through the galaxy, all in a systems-intensive, survival sim where taking care of your ship is as important as taking care of yourself?! Sign me the hell up! Okay, sure, it's in a bit of a rough shape right now, but it just came out on Early Access, I'm sure with time things will improve.

And one year passed by. Two. Three. Six years Ostranauts has permanently been installed in my computer, always taking a peek after a major update, and always bouncing off hard due to very frustrating, elemental jank that would force enormous rollbacks to my save. Confusing UI; brain-dead AI getting into looping, nonsensical conversations; unintuitive objectives relying on poorly explained unique interactions. Over the span of months the developers would keep futzing around, fleshing out one ancillary feature while introducing 5 more bugs and while the rest of the core loop would remain a raging dumpster fire: AI ships colliding because they couldn't figure out the way to dock, NPCs acting completely randomly, entire stations decompressing, broken pathing... game breaking ♥♥♥♥ would keep getting pushed to the main version, and slowly but surely, reality started to set in: the game wasn't going to grow, we'd be lucky if the developers ended up making it playable.

Ostranauts has barely developed through Early Access. It entered as barely an alpha, and it's leaving barely a beta. The only thing Blue Bottle Games has managed to do in this time is add fluff like missions full of scripting errors and vague, blink-and-you'll-miss objectives that you will never again be able to track once that dialog box closes, and even if we ignore the still very real colossal ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ that can absolutely brick your game unless you roll back 30 minutes worth of progression, the core game loop is just not fun, because it's barely developed from the almost placeholder gameplay from 2020. Every single feature feels as ugly, unintuitive and ungainly as the gameplay itself.

The game still feels like there's a ton of progression that either was never intended to be there, or that the developers gave up on. The difference between "space hobo" and "actually pretty well off" is minimal, as itemization usually boils down to "you have nothing" or "you have the best tool in the game because there's only one". Maybe you'll get a second, middle option if you're lucky (as in, you may have no screwdriver, a normal screwdriver or an *electric* screwdriver). You can still collect all kinds of trash and put them in containers, boxes and bins, but since there's no crafting, you don't really have a reason to do so and it becomes incredibly tedious to browse through which bin has the bag that has the jacket that has your food. What worked in NEO scavenger to make you feel resourceful and crafty becomes bloated and purposeless in Ostranauts.

The mechanical tinkering and systems management which was once one of the most exciting prospects when the game came out is for the most part reduced to a few increasingly flashy flavors of "on or off". There's no logic, no programming, no deeper interactions than "connect air pump to air sensor". Expanding your ship feels unsatisfying and clunky, mostly due to the godawful UI. Okay, let me put an example:

Let's say you want to move 5 units of cable. You can't queue up orders, instead, what you want to do is:

- Click your PDA
- Click on "orders"
- Click on "uninstall"
- Unselect all the options except "conduit" (otherwise you're going to uninstall the floor)
- Drag a square through those 5 units
- Set your character on "autotask"
- Wait for them to uninstall the 5 units of cable
- Pick up the cable (otherwise your character is going to pick each piece individually)
- Select "install" (not "orders" you silly goose!)
- Scroll down a list of every single item in the game (yes, that includes every single variant of floor and wall, regardless of whether it's in your inventory or vicinity) until you find the exact thing you want to install.
- Set down the work order for each item you want to install
- Set your character on "autotask"
- Wait for them to do the job.

The alternative is to right click on each piece of cable, select "uninstall", and wait for the character to uninstall the bit of cable before being able to right click on the next one, being very careful that each of those right clicks actually selects the cable, otherwise you might uninstall the floor and completely vent your ship to space. Oops! Hope you saved not too long ago!

Taking care of your character is similarly a thankless, overwrought chore, with a billion little interactions that will keep slightly tweaking up or down a million sub-needs like "intimacy" or "self worth", none of which ever really amount to anything. You will never make meaningful connections with NPCs because interactions amount to little more than Sims-like random topic exchanges lacking even a tiny bit of flavor text to make conversations feel real; and with quests being sterile, incredibly basic "this guy asks you to find this other guy and talk to him" affairs that require chasing down NPCs that will keep spazzing all over the place while trying to talk to them, Ostranauts fails feel alive or immersive. It fails to be a survival game, a sandbox game, an RPG, a builder, or a narrative adventure. It fails at everything. It is astonishingly bad, moreso when considering that its predecessor, NEO Scavenger, did actually a really good job when it came to progression, survival, and questing. It's just a loose collection of rough mechanics that never feel fun by themselves and never play into each other, controlled by a redundant, clunky, annoying UI that calling "undercooked" would be a kindness to.

For years I've kept hoping Ostranauts would actually develop in the direction it aimed for when it released, and yet it's going to "release" in what could barely be qualified as acceptable by the standards it itself set six years ago. It is a hollowed husk of potential ruined by a developer that has just been faffing around solving problems of their own creation instead of actually developing the game. It is a colossal disappointment, and a game that I'm truly sad to advise against.

Play NEO Scavenger instead. It's a bit of a rough gem with a lot of questionable design choices that really really likes to screw the player over, but it just does everything Ostranauts tries to do but better. If you want a mechanically deep, complex survival game, then play Stationeers instead. Want something snappier and less involved? Hardspace Shipbreaker. If you want a procedural, detailed world with hints of survival, Qud or Dwarf Fortress are good options.

Do not buy this game. Even if worked like it should (which it doesn't), and even if it was fun (which it isn't), it's just an incredibly shallow, unsatisfying, frustrating mess of a game. 3/10.
items.text_zh:
像《Ostranauts》这样的游戏让我痛恨抢先体验。

这款游戏刚出来的时候我真的很兴奋。一个由《NEO Scavenger》创作者打造的流浪汉模拟器，只不过这次是在太空里？能够在一个开放世界沙盒中创建、改装和拆解飞船，其他太空流浪汉也各自过着自己的日子，你在银河系中开辟自己的道路，这一切都发生在一个系统密集的生存模拟中，照顾你的飞船和照顾你自己一样重要？！算我一个！好吧，当然，它现在状态有点粗糙，但它才刚进入抢先体验，我相信随着时间推移情况会改善的。

然后一年过去了。两年。三年。六年了，《Ostranauts》一直永久安装在我的电脑里，每次大更新后我都会瞄一眼，然后总是被极其令人沮丧的、根本性的毛病狠狠劝退，这些毛病会迫使我大幅回滚存档。令人困惑的UI；脑死亡的AI陷入循环的、毫无意义的对话；依赖解释不清的独特交互的不直观目标。在数月的时间里，开发者们一直在瞎折腾，充实一个附属功能的同时引入5个新bug，而核心循环的其余部分仍然是一团熊熊燃烧的垃圾箱大火：AI飞船因为搞不清对接方式而相撞，NPC行为完全随机，整个空间站失压，寻路损坏……破坏游戏的♥♥♥♥不断被推送到主版本，慢慢地但确凿地，现实开始显现：这游戏不会成长了，如果开发者最终能让它变得可玩，我们就该谢天谢地了。

《Ostranauts》在抢先体验期间几乎没有发展。它进入时勉强算个alpha，离开时勉强算个beta。Blue Bottle Games在这段时间里唯一做到的就是添加一些填充内容，比如充满脚本错误的任务，以及模糊的、眨眼就会错过的目标，一旦那个对话框关闭你就再也无法追踪它们，而且即使我们忽略那些仍然非常真实的、巨大的♥♥♥♥♥♥♥——除非你回滚30分钟的进度，否则它绝对能让你的游戏彻底报废——核心游戏循环就是不好玩，因为它从2020年几乎占位符式的玩法以来几乎没有发展。每一个功能都像玩法本身一样丑陋、不直观、笨拙。

这游戏仍然感觉有大量进程要么从来就没打算存在，要么开发者已经放弃了。"太空流浪汉"和"其实过得挺不错"之间的差别微乎其微，因为物品化通常归结为"你什么都没有"或者"你拥有游戏里最好的工具，因为只有这一个"。如果你运气好，也许会有第二个中间选项（也就是说，你可能没有螺丝刀、有一把普通螺丝刀，或者有一把*电动*螺丝刀）。你仍然可以收集各种垃圾并把它们放进容器、箱子和垃圾桶里，但既然没有制作系统，你其实没有理由这么做，而且翻找哪个垃圾桶里有那个装着那件夹克的包、而那件夹克里又有你的食物，会变得极其繁琐。在《NEO Scavenger》中让你感到足智多谋、心灵手巧的东西，在《Ostranauts》中变得臃肿且毫无目的。

机械修修补补和系统管理，曾经是游戏刚出来时最令人兴奋的前景之一，如今在很大程度上被简化为几种越来越花哨的"开或关"。没有逻辑，没有编程，没有比"把气泵连接到空气传感器"更深入的交互。扩展你的飞船感觉不令人满意且笨拙，主要是因为那糟糕透顶的UI。好吧，让我举个例子：

假设你想移动5单位电缆。你不能排队下达命令，相反，你要做的是：

- 点击你的PDA
- 点击"订单"
- 点击"卸载"
- 取消选择除"导管"以外的所有选项（否则你会把地板也卸载掉）
- 拖一个方框框住那5单位
- 把你的角色设置为"自动任务"
- 等他们卸载那5单位电缆
- 捡起电缆（否则你的角色会一根一根地捡）
- 选择"安装"（不是"订单"，你这个傻瓜！）
- 向下滚动游戏里每一个物品的列表（是的，包括地板和墙壁的每一种变体，不管它是在你的库存里还是在附近）直到找到你想安装的那个确切东西。
- 为你想要安装的每个物品设置工作订单
- 把你的角色设置为"自动任务"
- 等他们完成工作。

另一种选择是右键点击每一段电缆，选择"卸载"，等角色卸载完那段电缆后才能右键点击下一段，同时要非常小心每一次右键点击确实选中了电缆，否则你可能会卸载地板，让你的飞船完全向太空泄压。哎呀！希望你不久前刚存过档！

照顾你的角色同样是一件吃力不讨好的、过度繁重的苦差事，有无数琐碎的交互会不断微调上百万个子需求，比如"亲密感"或"自我价值"，而这些需求从来都不会真正带来任何结果。你永远不会和NPC建立有意义的联系，因为交互不过是类似《模拟人生》的随机话题交换，连一丁点让对话显得真实的调味文本都没有；而任务则是干巴巴的、极其基本的"这个人让你去找另一个人并和他说话"之类的事，需要你追着那些在你想和他们说话时不停抽搐乱动的NPC跑，《Ostranauts》既无法让人感到鲜活，也无法让人沉浸。它作为生存游戏、沙盒游戏、RPG、建造游戏或叙事冒险都失败了。它什么都失败。它糟糕得令人震惊，尤其是考虑到它的前作《NEO Scavenger》在进程、生存和任务方面实际上做得非常好。它只是一堆松散拼凑的粗糙机制，本身从不让人觉得有趣，也从不相互配合，由一个冗余、笨拙、烦人的UI操控，说它"欠火候"都算是客气了。

多年来我一直希望《Ostranauts》能真正朝着它发布时所瞄准的方向发展，然而它即将以按照它自己六年前设定的标准都勉强算合格的状态"发布"。它是一个被掏空的潜力躯壳，被一个只是一直在瞎忙活、解决自己制造的问题而不是真正开发游戏的开发者毁掉了。这是一个巨大的失望，也是一款我真的很遗憾要劝人别买的游戏。

去玩《NEO Scavenger》吧。它是一颗有点粗糙的宝石，有很多可疑的设计选择，非常非常喜欢坑玩家，但它就是把《Ostranauts》试图做的一切都做得更好。如果你想要一个机制深刻、复杂的生存游戏，那就去玩《Stationeers》。想要更爽快、更轻松的？《Hardspace Shipbreaker》。如果你想要一个程序生成的、细节丰富的、带点生存元素的世界，《Qud》或《Dwarf Fortress》都是不错的选择。

不要买这个游戏。即使它像应该的那样运作（但它并没有），即使它好玩（但它并不好玩），它也只是一款极其肤浅、令人不满、令人沮丧的烂游戏。3/10。

items.text:
TLDR:
Someday, someone is going to give me the deep, fiddley, system-heavy space game I'm looking for.  It doesn't look like ostranauts is going to be it. 
:(
Early Access Review
This is a compelling sandbox, but in no way is it a finished game.  They're saying its less than a month from 1.0 release and it feels like it just entered beta testing.  If there were 1 or more years left on the dev's roadmap I would say this has excellent potential.  It sits in a niche that no AAA developers are ever going to address and it kills me that there are so many near misses in that niche.  I'm probably going to have to chalk this one up as a near miss as well.

The writing is really superb, there just isn't very much of it.  You get a neat little blurb every time you visit a new place.  The intro quest is very well written and easy to follow.  There are a handful of 'story' quests.  And thats it.  Once you leave the starter area (which is a significant task), there is really very little to do.

The new space combat is fine but not terribly compelling.  I was expecting something that requires multiple crew working in tandem to pull off like FTL.  

The AI is absolutely atrocious.  NPCs are largely useless.  The job queing system lacks custom priority settings and causes all kinds of nonsense to happen.  All tools and spacesuits require batteries that the AI is completely incapable of managing.  The dialogue system is a slog to interact with.  Pathing in stations and on bigger ships causes serious performance issues.

There isn't really any 'endgame' activity other than combat.  You spend a significant chunk of time building a ship capable of interplanetary travel.  You can then do some space trucking and make significantly more money than when you were restricted to the starter planet/asteroid/whatever.  You can spend all that money on... a condo and thats about it.
items.text_zh:
长话短说：
总有一天，会有人给我做出我一直在找的那种深度、繁琐、系统繁多的太空游戏。看起来Ostranauts不会是这个游戏。
:(
抢先体验评测
这是一个引人入胜的沙盒，但绝不是一款完成的游戏。他们说距离1.0发布不到一个月，可感觉它才刚刚进入beta测试。如果开发者的路线图上还剩1年或更久，我会说这有极好的潜力。它处在一个AAA开发者永远不会涉足的细分领域，而这个细分领域里有这么多差一点就成的作品，真让我难受。我大概也只能把这款也算作差一点就成的作品了。

文本写得真的很棒，只是量不够多。每次你到一个新地方，都会得到一小段很精巧的简介。开场任务写得很好，也很容易跟着做。还有少量“故事”任务。然后就没了。一旦你离开起始区域（这本身就是一项不小的任务），就真的没什么可做的了。

新的太空战斗还行，但并不是特别吸引人。我原本期待的是像FTL那样需要多名船员协同配合才能完成的东西。

AI简直糟糕透顶。NPC基本没什么用。任务排队系统缺少自定义优先级设置，还会导致各种荒唐的事情发生。所有工具和太空服都需要电池，而AI完全不会管理这些电池。对话系统交互起来很折磨。空间站和较大飞船上的寻路会导致严重的性能问题。

除了战斗之外，其实没有什么“终局”活动。你会花相当大一部分时间建造一艘能够进行行星际旅行的飞船。然后你可以跑跑太空货运，赚到比你还被困在起始星球/小行星/随便什么地方时多得多的钱。你可以把所有这些钱花在……一套公寓上，差不多就这样。

items.text:
This will be a positive review if logic gates become logical. Automating ANYTHING is simply not possible, everything needs manual toggling. I haven't seen any mention of an overhaul in the works which makes me concerned seeing as one of the best late-game features for a simulator is learning to automate things you have been doing for dozens of hours.

Also Solar Panels shouldn't need to be a mod they should be a full feature with logical systems tide to them. The mining aspect is neat but was never the real appeal of a Space Scavenger Sim. 

Also Also, interactions with NPCs are absurdly rigid and bare-bones, they feel more like RNG skill checks than people, and I feel like dragging a random unconscious half dead shipbreaker onto your ship from a derelict should be more interesting, the only options are literally to strip their equipment or drag them around, no medical treatment or examination, no investigation until they inevitibly die because you can't interact with them at all. 

I really love this game but it seems that areas I couldn't care less about have recieved the bulk of development attention while the main premise of ShipBreaking and space-life-sim has fallen by the wayside.

如果逻辑门变得合乎逻辑，这会是一篇好评。自动化任何东西根本不可能，一切都需要手动切换。我没有看到任何关于正在进行的重做的提及，这让我很担心，因为对于模拟器来说，最好的后期功能之一就是学会自动化你已经做了几十个小时的事情。

另外，太阳能板不应该需要做成模组，它们应该是一个完整的功能，并配有与之绑定的逻辑系统。采矿方面很巧妙，但从来都不是太空打捞模拟器的真正吸引力所在。

还有还有，与NPC的互动僵硬且简陋得离谱，他们感觉更像是RNG技能检定而不是人，而且我觉得从废弃船上把一个随机昏迷的半死拆船工拖到你的船上应该更有意思，唯一的选择实际上就是扒光他们的装备或者拖着他们到处走，没有医疗处理或检查，没有调查，直到他们不可避免地死去，因为你根本无法与他们互动。

我真的很喜欢这款游戏，但似乎我毫不在意的那些领域获得了大部分开发关注，而拆船和太空生活模拟的主要前提却被搁置一旁了。

observations.description: 无法自动化，所有操作都需手动切换
observations.evidence: Automating ANYTHING is simply not possible, everything needs manual toggling
observations.evidence_zh: 自动化任何东西都根本不可能，所有东西都需要手动切换

items.text: AI is not very good and it has some woke stuff. Apart from that its a fun game. I would like to recomend it but I really feel like the AI needs to be fixed. You can basically kill a whole station just by opening the airlocks venting all the oxygen, they don't try close the doors. Another example: If they eva suits they also end up dying as they don't swap out or charge the suit battery which I think regulates airflow for co2.
items.text_zh: AI不是很好，而且有一些觉醒（woke）的东西。除此之外，这是个有趣的游戏。我想推荐它，但我真的觉得AI需要修复。你基本上只要打开气闸舱把所有氧气排空就能杀死整个空间站的人，他们不会尝试关门。另一个例子：如果他们穿着EVA服，他们最终也会死，因为他们不会更换或给宇航服电池充电，而我认为那电池调节着二氧化碳的气流。

items.text:
Most of the positive reviews seem to follow the same pattern: "I love this game, however..." or "This is a great game, but..."

And that's exactly the problem. It could be a great game, but right now too much of it is either broken or poorly designed. Unless you're an experienced player who already knows how to work around bugs and identify important yet poorly communicated information, the game can feel incredibly inaccessible.

Take K-Leg, the starting station, as an example. You'll regularly find NPCs lying on the ground wearing pressure suits. The issue is that these suits don't have oxygen tanks; they only contain whatever air pressure is already inside them. So these NPCs have somehow decided that, while standing in a perfectly safe, breathable station, they should wear what is effectively a plastic bag over their heads.

The same kinds of problems extend into more complex systems later in the game. Crewmates, for instance, will sometimes wander outside the ship into the vacuum of space to repair something without putting on a spacesuit first. Or if they are wearing a suit, they'll wear it until they drop dead.

There are other baffling design decisions. You can stack floor tiles, but walls have to be placed one by one through dragging. Every few minutes, you find yourself returning to the ship just to remove your helmet, put it back on again, and carry on.

None of this is fun. It's not particularly realistic either. They're simply quirks players learn to tolerate and work around as quickly as possible. Instead of enjoying the game, it often feels like you're battling against its cumbersome systems and questionable design choices.

I would love to recommend this game, I'll likely continue playing it despite the problems, but for most people i'd say steer clear unless you're willing to deal with frustration.
items.text_zh:
大多数好评似乎都遵循同样的模式：“我喜欢这款游戏，但是……”或者“这是一款很棒的游戏，但……”

而这正是问题所在。它本可以是一款很棒的游戏，但现在它有太多部分要么是坏的，要么是设计得很糟糕。除非你是一名经验丰富的玩家，已经知道如何绕过bug，并识别那些重要但传达得很差的信息，否则这款游戏会让人感觉极其难以入门。

以K-Leg，也就是起始空间站为例。你会经常发现NPC穿着压力服躺在地上。问题在于，这些压力服没有氧气罐；它们只包含里面已有的空气压力。所以这些NPC不知怎么地决定了，虽然站在一个完全安全、可呼吸的空间站里，他们也应该把实际上相当于塑料袋的东西套在头上。

同样类型的问题延伸到游戏后期更复杂的系统中。比如船员，有时会不先穿上宇航服就游荡到飞船外面的真空中去修理东西。或者如果他们穿着宇航服，他们会一直穿着，直到倒地死亡。

还有其他令人费解的设计决定。你可以堆叠地板砖，但墙壁必须通过拖拽一块一块地放置。每隔几分钟，你就会发现自己回到飞船，只是为了摘掉头盔，再重新戴上，然后继续。

这些都不好玩。也并不是特别真实。它们只是玩家学会尽快忍受并绕开的怪癖。与其说是在享受游戏，不如说常常感觉像是在与它笨重繁琐的系统和可疑的设计选择作斗争。

我很想推荐这款游戏，尽管有这些问题，我可能还是会继续玩，但对大多数人来说，我会说除非你愿意忍受挫败感，否则还是避开吧。

items.text: This game simulates rather well, space pressurization, heat, cold, does a pretty good job of simplified electric grids and building in a way that works well. It even simulates crew needs too, and the ship building is pretty straightforward, but only issue is the vanilla game is kind of dumb with it's AI autotask building. It only does 1 item at a time, but there is a Steam Workshop item that fixes this, and makes your crew work smarter, not time consumingly harder. it also takes place in the same universe as Neo Scavenger, with the short and sweet lore being - There is so much debris in space, Earth is no longer accessible, whether it's getting on or off planet. Thus comes you space borne in this Newtonian Physics space faring game, with Love Craftian themes attached.
items.text_zh: 这款游戏相当好地模拟了太空加压、高温、低温，对简化电网和建造的模拟也做得不错，运作良好。它甚至模拟了船员需求，而且造船相当直观，唯一的问题是原版游戏在AI自动任务建造方面有点蠢。它一次只处理一个项目，但有一个Steam创意工坊物品修复了这一点，让你的船员更聪明地工作，而不是耗时费力地更辛苦。它还和《新拾荒者》发生在同一个宇宙中，简短而甜蜜的背景设定是——太空中有太多碎片，地球无论上还是下都不再可达。于是就有了你，在这款牛顿物理太空航行游戏中，带着洛夫克拉夫特式主题，在太空中漂泊。

observations.description: 原版AI自动建造任务一次只处理一个物品
observations.evidence: It only does 1 item at a time
observations.evidence_zh: 它一次只处理一个项目

items.text:
I want to preface this review by saying that I adore this game. I've played it for many hours - hell, I've made what is arguably one of the first major expansion mods for the game.

With that, I have to say that I cannot recommend this game as it stands. I have no doubt it'll be good in, say, three years, but as it stands? No.

The game is straight-up broken, as it stands. The developers have prioritised completing their promised roadmap over anything else and it shows. 
Despite all the hype around the complex NPC system, said NPCs can't even, like, stay alive. I was docked at the major station you always start at for an extended period of time for periods and whatnot, and a significant amount of NPCs there just died. It should also be noted that said NPCs don't actually do anything interesting. You won't see people getting into arguements and whatnot, the most complex activity they can perform is the maintenance techs in stations repairing damaged modules. All these promises of a living, breathing world, and the NPCs can't even stay alive in environments where all their needs are provided for.

This jank extends to all levels of gameplay - for example, a major (dare I say, even central) point of the game is building yourself a ship with parts you pull from wrecks. Not only are the ship designs used here are rather poor (for a variety of reasons I can't get into here) but the 'damage pass' meant to simulate scavengers picking over the wreck is very poorly implemented. The result is that, while supposedly-incredibly-rare things like reactor parts are relatively easy to find, common electronics like O2 pressure sensors are incredibly rare. Despite the whole salvage economy thing, none of these common parts are readily available for purchase either. In the time it took me to find enough parts to build a mighty freighter capable of interplentary travel, with a reactor and various atmo-scrubbers and whatnot, I still hadn't found enough sensors for the various life support systems I had. To this day, despite pulling dozens of reactors off of wrecks, I do not have the contaminants sensor I need to plug into my contaminants scrubber. This makes ship-building incredibly frustrating.

The entire 'social needs' system falls flat because there's no way to meaningfully fulfill any of them. All these social needs, and the gameplay boils down to doing nothing but clicking the same 'doomscroll on social media lol' button over and over again, then pressing the 'cocoon' option to recover the privacy you lost doomscrolling on social media.
And for some reason, doomscrolling on your PDA is significantly better than any other way of filling these needs. That's the funniest part - the game doesn't facilitate, say, going down to Mescaform to get a drink with your crew, but even if you managed to chat someone up down there, that's still the sucker's way of filling those needs because the 'social interaction' system, being closer to 'social combat' than conversation, sucks at filling those needs.
In this game, social activitiy is a bad way of filling social needs.

Character creation is also very, very bad. A lot of the traits are basically meaningless ('Lustful' for example just means your intimacy need goes up slightly faster) but there are a few that are cripplingly bad. For example, 'Zero-G Hypervolemic' affects a huge variety of things.
A funny detail here is that the player character starts with all the 'cripplingly bad' traits by default. A lot of the game's difficulty comes from beginners not knowing that they can go to their trait selection, remove the crippling stuff and replace them with meaningless 'downsides' like Lustful that nonehtless give you the trait 'years' (Each positive trait you take makes you older, and each negative trait makes you younger in this game.) you need to start in the same age and condition as before, but now you're expontentionally more capable.
'Make sure to not take the traits that cripple you forever' isn't much of character creation. I'd have much preferred a system like Project Zomboid, where you have to balance positive traits with negative ones. Taking the 'smoker' trait to make up for my great athlethic capabilities felt much more of a meaningful decision than just removing the 'Do not forget to remove these' traits at the start and not doing much else.

Speaking of mecahnics, this one is a bit minor but none of the stations actually orbit their parent body. This is especially noticable at Venus Orbital where you can match the station's orbit and speed, and it will just accelerate away. All this talk about simulated ship systems and docking generally just involves accelerating at your target at full speed because orbitals aren't actually orbiting.

The maps you play across are also very weird as well. Even the more 'modest' locations you find are supposedly inhabited by hundreds of people but they look like they could maybe support five. The biggest 'aerostat' colony in the game, around Venus, has a grand 'mall' that's like, five company stalls and that's it. The grand starport (which is a seperate facility, you have to take transit down to the colony proper) can support maybe two ships. At an age where games like Star Citizen can offer believably-scaled facilities, it feels odd for supposed megaports to have like two docks. Hell, Ostranauts is a 2D game with very little overhead in huge maps, I know because I've made one myself. So it's really weird to see the illustration about the Venus aerostat colony with a huge crowd of people among skyscrapers, with a maglev line going overhead... then walking around the actual in-game map where it's a few rooms and that's it. It doesn't have to be 1:1 of course, but really? You couldn't make any attempt to pass off the supposed scale here?

I also want to speak about the modding scene a bit here. The game technically has Workshop support but anything beyond simple .json remixes require third-party loaders, and the developers, being extreme fence-sitters, have not forbidden mods with custom assemblies but has forbidden mods from loading their own assemblies. The end result is that mods with custom assemblies still exist, but now the whole process is just worse for no reason. Users have to manually install things like BepInEx in jank ways. Updates are a pain, the whole process is vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks, so on and so forth.
A lot of the game is also explicitly written in a way to discourage modding. For example, adding new stations, planets, etc. is technically trivial, you just plug in a few values like what it should orbit, how far it should be, etc. but in practice, it's impossible, because the game, despite supporting the custom star system format, explicitly only loads one star system with the name 'NewGame' and ignores the rest. Not only that, but the game *can* handle mods providing their own star system. It just chooses to explicitly ignore them and, in the case of systems with the same 'NewGame' name, chooses to completely override instead of merging. This means that a mod looking to add a new location either has to provide a full replacemement of the entire star systems (Super jank and breaks any other mods also looking to do the same) or you have to write a bunch of custom code to inject your new elements (Not only significantly more complicated than it should be, but runs into the 'no official custom assembly support' issue mentioned above) - This is just one example but a lot of the game's code is like this. At every step of modding, you run into either deliberate ignorance or just plain incompetence. Something is hardcoded in a very specific way, or something very laborous doesn't a common helper you can just plug stuff into.
items.text_zh:
我想在开头说，我非常喜欢这款游戏。我已经玩了很多小时——见鬼，我还为这款游戏制作了可以说是最早的大型扩展模组之一。

话虽如此，我必须说，就目前的状态而言，我无法推荐这款游戏。我毫不怀疑它在大约三年后会变得很好，但就目前而言？不。

就目前而言，这款游戏简直是坏掉了。开发者把完成他们承诺的路线图置于其他一切之上，这一点显而易见。
尽管围绕复杂NPC系统的宣传铺天盖地，但那些NPC甚至连活着都做不到。我曾在你总是会起始的那个主要空间站停靠了很长一段时间，处理生理期之类的事情，而那里相当多的NPC就那么死了。还应该指出的是，那些NPC实际上并不会做任何有趣的事情。你不会看到人们争吵之类的事，他们能执行的最复杂活动就是空间站里的维护技师修理受损模块。所有这些关于一个活生生、会呼吸的世界的承诺，而NPC甚至无法在一切需求都得到满足的环境中活下去。

这种粗糙贯穿了游戏玩法的各个层面——例如，游戏的一个主要（我敢说，甚至是核心）要点就是用你从残骸中拆下来的部件为自己建造一艘飞船。不仅这里使用的飞船设计相当糟糕（出于各种我无法在此展开的原因），而且那个本意是模拟拾荒者翻检残骸的‘损伤处理’实现得也非常差。结果是，虽然像反应堆部件这种据说极其罕见的东西相对容易找到，但像氧气压力传感器这样的普通电子元件却极其稀有。尽管有整套打捞经济系统，这些普通部件也不容易买到。在我花时间找到足够部件、造出一艘能够进行星际航行、配有反应堆和各种大气净化器之类的强大货船时，我仍然没有找到足够传感器来供应我拥有的各种生命维持系统。直到今天，尽管我从残骸上拆下了几十个反应堆，我仍然没有那个需要插进我的污染物净化器的污染物传感器。这让造船变得极其令人沮丧。

整个‘社交需求’系统彻底失败，因为没有任何办法能有意义地满足其中任何一项。有这么多社交需求，而玩法却归结为除了反复点击同一个‘在社交媒体上末日刷屏 lol’按钮之外什么都不做，然后再按‘茧居’选项来恢复你在社交媒体上末日刷屏时失去的隐私。
而且不知为何，在你的PDA上末日刷屏比任何其他满足这些需求的方式都明显更好。这才是最好笑的部分——游戏并不支持比如说下到Mescaform和你的船员喝一杯，但即使你设法在那里跟人搭讪，那仍然是满足这些需求的傻瓜方式，因为‘社交互动’系统更接近‘社交战斗’而不是交谈，在满足这些需求方面很烂。
在这款游戏里，社交活动是满足社交需求的一种糟糕方式。

角色创建也非常、非常糟糕。很多特质基本上毫无意义（例如‘好色’只是意味着你的亲密需求上升得稍微快一点），但有几个则糟糕到会严重削弱你。例如，‘零重力高血容量’会影响一大堆东西。
这里有个有趣的细节：玩家角色默认就带着所有那些‘糟糕到会严重削弱你’的特质。这款游戏的很多难度来自于新手不知道他们可以去特质选择界面，移除那些会严重削弱自己的东西，并用像好色这样毫无意义的‘缺点’来替换它们，而这些缺点尽管如此仍会给你所需的特质‘年份’（在这款游戏里，每选一个正面特质都会让你变老，每选一个负面特质都会让你变年轻），让你以和之前相同的年龄和状态开局，但现在你的能力强得不成比例。
‘确保不要选那些会永远削弱你的特质’算不上什么角色创建。我本会更喜欢像《僵尸毁灭工程》那样的系统，在那里你必须用负面特质来平衡正面特质。选择‘吸烟者’特质来弥补我出色的运动能力，感觉比一开始只是移除那些‘别忘了移除这些’的特质然后几乎什么都不做要有意义得多。

说到机制，这一点有点次要，但所有空间站实际上都不围绕它们的母体运行。这在金星轨道站尤其明显，在那里你可以匹配空间站的轨道和速度，而它会直接加速离开。所有关于模拟飞船系统和对接的讨论，通常都只是全速朝你的目标加速，因为轨道站实际上并不在轨道上运行。

你游玩所跨越的地图也非常奇怪。即使是你找到的那些更‘ modest’的地点，据说也居住着数百人，但它们看起来也许只能容纳五个人。游戏中最大的‘浮空器’殖民地，位于金星周围，有一个宏大的‘购物中心’，大概就是五个公司摊位，仅此而已。那个宏大的太空港（这是一个独立设施，你必须乘交通艇下到真正的殖民地）大概只能容纳两艘飞船。在一个像《星际公民》这样的游戏都能提供可信规模设施的时代，所谓的巨型港口却只有两个泊位，感觉很奇怪。见鬼，Ostranauts是一款2D游戏，在巨大的地图上开销非常小，我知道，因为我自己做过一个。所以看到金星浮空器殖民地插画里有一大群人在摩天大楼之间，头顶还有磁悬浮线路……然后在实际游戏地图里走动时却只有几个房间，仅此而已，这真的很奇怪。当然，它不必是1:1，但真的吗？你连一点尝试都不肯做，来糊弄一下这里所谓的规模吗？

我还想在这里稍微谈谈模组圈。这款游戏技术上支持创意工坊，但任何超出简单.json混搭的东西都需要第三方加载器，而开发者作为极端的骑墙派，没有禁止带有自定义程序集的模组，却禁止模组加载它们自己的程序集。最终结果是，带有自定义程序集的模组仍然存在，但现在整个过程毫无理由地变得更糟。用户不得不以粗糙的方式手动安装像BepInEx这样的东西。更新很痛苦，整个过程容易受到中间人攻击，等等等等。
这款游戏的很多部分也明确以阻止模组制作的方式编写。例如，添加新的空间站、行星等，技术上很简单，你只需填入几个值，比如它应该围绕什么运行、它应该有多远等等，但实际上这不可能，因为游戏尽管支持自定义星系格式，却明确只加载一个名为‘NewGame’的星系，并忽略其余部分。不仅如此，游戏*能够*处理提供自己星系的模组。它只是选择明确忽略它们，并且在星系名称同为‘NewGame’的情况下，选择完全覆盖而不是合并。这意味着，一个想要添加新地点的模组要么必须提供整个星系的完整替换（超级粗糙，并且会破坏任何其他也想这么做的模组），要么你必须写一堆自定义代码来注入你的新元素（不仅比应有的复杂得多，而且还会遇到上面提到的‘没有官方自定义程序集支持’问题）——这只是一个例子，但游戏的很多代码都是这样。在模组制作的每一步，你都会遇到要么是故意的无视，要么就是纯粹的无能。某些东西以非常特定的方式被硬编码，或者某些非常费力的东西却没有一个你可以直接插入东西的通用辅助工具。
我想先说明，我非常喜爱这款游戏。我已经玩了很多小时——见鬼，我甚至制作了可以说是这款游戏最早的大型扩展模组之一。

话虽如此，我必须说，就目前的状态而言，我无法推荐这款游戏。我毫不怀疑它在大约三年后会变得很好，但就目前而言？不。

就目前的状态而言，这款游戏简直是彻底坏掉了。开发者把完成他们承诺的路线图置于一切之上，而这一点显而易见。
尽管围绕复杂的NPC系统有那么多炒作，这些NPC甚至连活着都做不到。我曾在你总是会出生的那个主要空间站停靠了很长一段时间，处理各种事务之类的，而那里相当多的NPC就那么死了。还应该指出的是，这些NPC实际上并不会做任何有趣的事。你不会看到人们争吵之类的，他们能执行的最复杂活动就是空间站里的维护技师修理受损模块。所有这些关于一个活生生、会呼吸的世界的承诺，而NPC们甚至无法在一切需求都得到满足的环境中活下去。

这种粗糙贯穿了游戏玩法的各个层面——例如，游戏的一个主要（我敢说，甚至是核心）要点就是用你从残骸中拆下来的部件为自己建造一艘飞船。不仅这里使用的飞船设计相当糟糕（出于各种我无法在此展开的原因），而且那个本应模拟拾荒者翻检残骸的‘损伤处理’实现得也非常糟糕。结果是，虽然像反应堆部件这样据说极其罕见的东西相对容易找到，但像氧气压力传感器这样的普通电子元件却极其稀有。尽管有整套打捞经济系统，这些普通部件也没有任何地方可以随时购买。在我找到足够部件来建造一艘能够进行行星际航行、配有反应堆和各种大气净化器之类的强大货船的那段时间里，我仍然没有找到足够的传感器来供应我所拥有的各种生命维持系统。直到今天，尽管我从残骸上拆下了几十个反应堆，我仍然没有找到那个我需要插进污染物净化器里的污染物传感器。这让造船变得极其令人沮丧。

整个‘社交需求’系统彻底失败，因为没有任何办法能有意义地满足其中任何一项。有这么多社交需求，而玩法却归结为除了反复点击同一个‘在社交媒体上末日刷屏 lol’按钮之外什么都不做，然后再按下‘茧居’选项来恢复你在社交媒体上末日刷屏时失去的隐私。
而且不知为何，在你的PDA上末日刷屏比任何其他满足这些需求的方式都要好得多。这才是最搞笑的部分——游戏并不支持比如说下到Mescaform去和你的船员喝一杯，但即使你设法在那里和人搭上话，那仍然是满足这些需求的傻瓜方式，因为‘社交互动’系统更接近‘社交战斗’而非交谈，在满足这些需求方面很糟糕。
在这款游戏里，社交活动是一种满足社交需求的糟糕方式。

角色创建也非常、非常糟糕。很多特质基本上毫无意义（例如‘好色’只是意味着你的亲密需求上升得稍微快一点），但有几个则是灾难性地糟糕。例如，‘零重力高血容量’会影响一大堆东西。
这里有个有趣的细节：玩家角色默认就带有所有‘灾难性地糟糕’的特质。游戏的很大一部分难度来自新手不知道他们可以进入特质选择，移除那些致残的东西，然后用像‘好色’这样毫无意义的‘缺点’来替换它们，而这些缺点尽管如此还是会给你‘年龄’特质（在这款游戏里，你每选一个正面特质就会变老，每选一个负面特质就会变年轻）。你需要以和之前相同的年龄和状态开始，但现在你的能力却成倍地更强。
‘确保不要选那些会永远致残你的特质’算不上什么角色创建。我更喜欢像《僵尸毁灭工程》那样的系统，在那里你必须用负面特质来平衡正面特质。选择‘吸烟者’特质来弥补我出色的运动能力，感觉比一开始就只是移除那些‘别忘了移除这些’的特质然后几乎什么都不做要有意义得多。

说到机制，这一点有点次要，但所有空间站实际上都不围绕它们的母体运行。这在金星轨道站尤其明显，在那里你可以匹配空间站的轨道和速度，而它却会直接加速飞走。所有关于模拟飞船系统和对接的讨论，通常都只涉及以全速朝你的目标加速，因为轨道站实际上并没有在轨道上运行。

你所游玩的各种地图也非常奇怪。即使是那些更‘朴素’的地点，据说也居住着数百人，但它们看起来最多也许只能容纳五个人。游戏中最大的‘浮空器’殖民地，位于金星周围，有一个宏伟的‘购物中心’，大概就是五个公司摊位，仅此而已。那个宏伟的太空港（这是一个独立的设施，你必须乘坐交通工具下到殖民地本体）大概只能容纳两艘飞船。在一个像《星际公民》这样的游戏都能提供可信规模设施的时代，所谓的巨型港口却只有大约两个泊位，这让人感觉很奇怪。见鬼，Ostranauts是一款2D游戏，在巨大的地图上几乎没有额外开销，我知道这一点，因为我自己就做过一张。所以看到关于金星浮空器殖民地的插图，里面有摩天大楼之间的一大群人，头顶还有一条磁悬浮线路……然后在实际的游戏地图里走动时，却只有几个房间，仅此而已，这真的很奇怪。当然，它不必是1:1的，但说真的？你就不能做任何尝试来糊弄一下这里所谓的规模吗？

我还想在这里稍微谈谈模组圈。这款游戏技术上支持创意工坊，但任何超出简单.json混搭的东西都需要第三方加载器，而开发者们，作为极端的骑墙派，没有禁止带有自定义程序集的模组，却禁止模组加载它们自己的程序集。最终结果是，带有自定义程序集的模组仍然存在，但现在整个过程却毫无理由地变得更糟了。用户不得不以各种别扭的方式手动安装像BepInEx这样的东西。更新很痛苦，整个过程容易受到中间人攻击，等等等等。
游戏的很多部分也明确是以一种阻碍模组制作的方式编写的。例如，添加新的空间站、行星等，技术上很简单，你只需填入几个值，比如它应该围绕什么运行、它应该有多远等等，但在实践中，这是不可能的，因为游戏尽管支持自定义星系格式，却明确只加载一个名为‘NewGame’的星系，并忽略其余的。不仅如此，游戏*能够*处理提供自己星系的模组。它只是选择明确忽略它们，而对于那些具有相同‘NewGame’名称的星系，则选择完全覆盖而不是合并。这意味着，一个想要添加新地点的模组要么必须提供整个星系的完整替换（超级粗糙，并且会破坏任何其他也想这么做的模组），要么你必须编写一堆自定义代码来注入你的新元素（不仅比它本应具有的复杂程度高得多，而且还会遇到上面提到的‘没有官方自定义程序集支持’的问题）——这只是一个例子，但游戏的很多代码都是这样。在模组制作的每一步，你都会遇到要么是故意的无视，要么就是纯粹的无能。某些东西以非常特定的方式被硬编码，或者某些非常费力的东西却没有一个你可以直接插入东西的通用辅助工具。
同样的'NewGame'名称，选择完全覆盖而不是合并。这意味着一个想要添加新地点的模组要么必须提供整个星系系统的完整替换（超级蹩脚，并且会破坏任何其他也想做同样事情的模组），要么你必须编写一堆自定义代码来注入你的新元素（不仅比它本应具有的复杂度高得多，而且还会遇到上面提到的'没有官方自定义程序集支持'的问题）——这只是一个例子，但游戏的大量代码都是这样。在模组制作的每一步，你都会遇到要么是故意的无视，要么就是纯粹的无能。某些东西以非常特定的方式被硬编码，或者某些非常费力的东西没有你可以直接插入东西的通用辅助工具。
