items.text:
Fun but way too many bugs as of now, full of stuttering and other problems.
Turning off ceiling mode and pressing alt turns it back on, you need to go back to menus to turn it off again.
Zone designations barely work, sometimes drag clicking adds tiles to a zone, sometimes it does not, if a zone ends near a corner tile, there is a chance that your character will infinitely stack items on top of a wall tile.
Path finding is abysmall, the characters always choose the shortest path even though it might take 3x longer.
Some UI Elements seem to sometimes just flat out dissapear and not reappear until you reload the save.
The character needs menu does not work as intended, it might be 10% full but the tooltip says that the character is very tired, same goes with food and thirst.
Combat is very janky and unintuitive.
Very tedious to change out and recharge tool batteries when you are expanding your ship, not only the building itself is time consuming, navigating the inventories of rechargers and your tools is tedious.
You can rearrange your inventory bars... untill you close your inventory and once you open it up again, they are all in default spots, it might take up to half the screen if you have enough inventories on you.
You can hire crew and set their schedules, sadly the idiots refuse to sleep before you manually remove their helmets, what's the point of a schedule when you have to babysit each and every one of the crew?
Hauling command makes the game less tedious but is implemented poorly, the crew will deliver as many items at a time as many there are on a single floor tile, even though they could pick 20 nearby items and stash them in their inventory, they will rather take 20 trips than one.
Water... there are tanks for many different gasses in the game, but for water you need to manually go and buy water bottles to refill your sinks, making sinks basically useless since you can do all the water based interactions of the sink straight from the bottles
items.text_zh:
有趣，但目前来说bug太多了，满是卡顿和其他问题。
关闭天花板模式后按alt又会把它打开，你得回到菜单才能再次关掉它。
区域划定几乎没法用，有时候拖拽点击会给区域添加格子，有时候又不会，如果某个区域在角落格子附近结束，你的角色就有可能无限地把物品堆叠在墙格上。
寻路糟糕透顶，角色总是选择最短路径，哪怕那可能会多花3倍的时间。
有些UI元素似乎有时会直接消失，直到你重新加载存档才会重新出现。
角色的需求菜单没有按预期工作，可能只满了10%，但提示却说角色非常疲惫，食物和口渴也是一样。
战斗非常别扭且不直观。
在扩建飞船时更换和充电工具电池非常繁琐，不仅建造本身耗时，浏览充电器和工具的物品栏也很烦人。
你可以重新排列你的物品栏栏位……直到你关闭物品栏，等你再次打开时，它们全都回到了默认位置，如果你身上带够多物品栏，它可能会占掉半个屏幕。
你可以雇佣船员并设置他们的日程，可惜这些白痴在你手动摘掉他们的头盔之前拒绝睡觉，当你不得不照看每一个船员时，日程还有什么意义？
搬运命令让游戏没那么繁琐，但实现得很差，船员一次会运送和单个地板格上一样多的物品，哪怕他们本可以捡起附近20件物品并把它们塞进自己的物品栏，他们也宁愿跑20趟而不是一趟。
水……游戏里有各种不同气体的储罐，但水却需要你手动去买水瓶来给水槽加水，这让水槽基本没用，因为水槽所有基于水的互动你都可以直接用水瓶完成

items.text:
Really enjoying this game so far. 

I have to admit the first time I tried it, it was maybe a bit too daunting, and i was on steam deck. I didn't quite give it the time it deserved and it wasn't until I recently came back to it that I have seen how it shines.

Its a big confusing complex world with many fiddly systems and things to learn, but you are given a level of freedom in space to do things your way that scratches all of my itches.

Basic loop is roll into a character, make some choices and land with a weak body and a ship that you owe tonnes of money on. learn how to repair, breakdown, and build ships and venture out into deep space to find your target.

Starting tips: definitely start with a gig from the gig nexus. there are a couple easy body identification ones available <not sure how random these are, only my most recent character did gigs, and had 2x gigs for murdered corpses on the same ship. netted me 50K not including salvaging their ship.

but wait, if you want to salvage purchase a salvaging license from the licenses kiosk, good for 24h and up. your license also has to be valid to sell your salvage back to said kiosk. otherwise you need a criminal trait to deal with black market.

but wait, is your ship airtight? does it have oxygen tanks that arent leaking and a working pump hooked up to an o2 sensor ? did you remember to don your spacesuit ? is your ship fueled? did you bring the proper tools for salvaging ? do you have a battery charger for your welder gun ? 

does any of this complexity and immediate and constant danger sound fun? try this game if so. because its an emergent gameplay beast.

sidenote: i recently encountered a space pirate on a hulk ship. (said ship had a nuclear reactor on it, great $$$) after trying to fight him, evade him, and salvage his ship components from a space walk, he followed me on to my ship. I managed to lock him outside my airlock and promptly flew to a nearby Police ship and requested docking with it. the officer dealt with my pirate friend and i collected his weapons and was on my merry way to take his nuclear reactor, pellet feeder, and laser array. what a glorious game.

Graphics: low-fi and at times busy and messy. but i wouldn't change a thing. character portraits are lovely, and the  painted scenes lush.

Music and SFX : excellent. nice ambient music and sound, everything is appropriate. It might be nice in the future to have music devices for playback,

Features: pretty rich and presumably growing in the future. some things a bit lacking like social interactions and combat is a little messy and confusing. Ship salvaging and building is pretty good though, however it would be nice to have some middle ground between task orders and manually doing things. Let us queue tasks from the context menu, it makes no sense to be able to queue endlessly with the order system, but if using the context menu you have to cancel current action to start another. queue queue queue. 

Also autotask is nice, to allow your character to make the choice of walking to the cabin to vent co2, but can we improve it so they dont want until current task is complete? if repairing or installing something, they will damn near die on the spot to finish before going to vent.

I guess thats it for now, bottom line : amazing game, can't wait to see it grow more.

Edit - to expand on queuing tasks, please give us a context menu haul option:
1: right click, select haul
2: scroll to target destination and select destination using appropriate grid size of object to specify target tiles
3: confirm and move to next queued haul. 

this would be so much cleaner than orders and tasks when dealing with a single player scenario vs crew autonomy.
items.text_zh:
到目前为止真的很喜欢这款游戏。

我得承认，第一次尝试时，它可能有点太令人生畏了，而且我当时用的是Steam Deck。我没有给它应得的时间，直到最近重新回来玩，我才看到它的闪光点。

这是一个庞大、令人困惑、复杂的世界，有许多繁琐的系统和需要学习的东西，但你在太空中拥有一定程度的自由，可以按自己的方式做事，这满足了我所有的渴望。

基本循环是：创建一个角色，做出一些选择，然后带着虚弱的身体和一艘欠了一屁股债的飞船落地。学习如何修理、拆解和建造飞船，然后冒险进入深空寻找你的目标。

新手提示：一定要从任务枢纽接一个任务开始。有几个简单的尸体鉴定任务可用 <不确定这些有多随机，只有我最近的角色做过任务，而且同一艘飞船上接到了2个被谋杀尸体的任务。净赚了5万，还不包括打捞他们的飞船。

但是等等，如果你想打捞，要从许可证亭购买打捞许可证，有效期24小时起。你的许可证还必须有效，才能把打捞物卖回给那个亭子。否则你需要一个犯罪特质来应对黑市。

但是等等，你的飞船气密吗？它的氧气罐没有泄漏吗？有连接到氧气传感器的工作泵吗？你记得穿上宇航服了吗？你的飞船加燃料了吗？你带了合适的打捞工具吗？你有电焊枪的电池充电器吗？

这种复杂性和即时且持续的危险听起来有趣吗？如果有趣，就试试这款游戏吧。因为它是一个涌现式玩法的猛兽。

附注：我最近在一艘废船上遇到了一个太空海盗。（那艘船上有一个核反应堆，值大钱$$$）在试图与他战斗、躲避他，并在太空行走中打捞他的飞船部件之后，他跟着我上了我的飞船。我设法把他锁在我的气闸外面，然后迅速飞向附近的一艘警察飞船，请求与其对接。警官处理了我的海盗朋友，我收集了他的武器，然后愉快地继续去拿他的核反应堆、弹丸供给器和激光阵列。多么辉煌的一款游戏。

画面：低保真，有时繁杂凌乱。但我一点也不会改。角色肖像很可爱，手绘场景很茂盛。

音乐和音效：极好。不错的环境音乐和音效，一切都恰到好处。如果将来能有音乐设备用于播放，可能会很不错，

功能：相当丰富，想必未来还会增长。有些东西略显不足，比如社交互动，战斗有点凌乱和令人困惑。不过飞船打捞和建造相当不错，然而如果能在任务指令和手动做事之间有一些中间地带就好了。让我们从上下文菜单排队任务吧，用指令系统能无限排队，这毫无道理，但如果使用上下文菜单，你必须取消当前动作才能开始另一个。排队排队排队。

另外自动任务也不错，让你的角色自己选择走到舱室排放二氧化碳，但能不能改进一下，让他们不要等到当前任务完成？如果在修理或安装什么东西，他们几乎会当场死掉也要先完成才去排气。

我想目前就这些了，底线：惊人的游戏，迫不及待想看到它成长更多。

编辑 - 为了扩展任务排队，请给我们一个上下文菜单搬运选项：
1：右键点击，选择搬运
2：滚动到目标目的地并选择 
使用适当的物体网格尺寸指定目标地砖的目的地
3：确认并移动到下一个排队的搬运任务。

在处理单人场景对比船员自主性时，这比命令和任务系统要干净得多。

items.text:
It's a buggy mess that'll just raise your bloodpressure. You can go in with the best will in the world. Watch all the tutorials you can find, and the game will still ♥♥♥♥ it all up for you because of some random bug. You'll even get stuck in the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ tutorial mission, because the game won't recognise any actions that you make, if you should for some reason load the game.

Should you make it past that, and think that the game might still be playable;  don't worry, the NPC's have enough pointless actions crammed down their schedule to make your computer stutter all the way to ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ Venus, because god forbid that they shut the ♥♥♥♥ up and stand still for a brief second. 

Then we have the ability to bankrupt ourselves by hiring an NPC! This is a wonderful feature, which much like in real life, comes with some small text at the bottom of the contract, making sure you'll end up in financial ruin. You think you're only paying them for their work ? (which they rarely if ever ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ do btw), nah. They want death insurance as well. If you're not ready to fork over another 80+ thousand to cover that, you'll have to pay interest on top of that as well. 

Well golly gee, that sounds great, you may think to yourself. I can't wait to go into space and break those ships for some cash! Well, you're in for a treat. This works - FOR A WHILE - before the game randomly decides that you're not wearing your suit - even if you are - and then you suddenly die, with your suit in perfect condition, batteries on full, O2 bottle at 75%, and your CO2 filter at 99%. No explanation, just yeah, you died from space dude. Shame about that.

The game SEEMS like a fun game to begin with - It's detailed! it sucks you in, as long as it works as intended - but this does NOT last. It's just enough to make you waste a few days of your life, and then it ♥♥♥♥♥ you over with any of an amazing amount of random bugs that'll break the game.

Don't bother.
items.text_zh:
这就是一团会只会让你血压升高的bug烂摊子。你可以怀着世上最美好的意愿进入游戏。看完你能找到的所有教程，游戏还是会因为某个随机bug把一切都♥♥♥♥搞砸。你甚至会卡在♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥的新手教程任务里，因为如果你出于某种原因加载了游戏，游戏就不会识别你做出的任何操作。

就算你熬过了那一段，觉得游戏也许还能玩；别担心，NPC们的日程里塞满了足够多毫无意义的动作，能让你的电脑一路卡顿到♥♥♥♥♥♥♥金星，因为老天 forbid 他们闭上♥♥♥♥嘴、安安静静站上一小会儿。

然后我们还有靠雇佣NPC让自己破产的能力！这是个绝妙的功能，和现实生活中很像，合同底部会附带一些小字，确保你最终陷入财务毁灭。你以为你只是在为他们的工作付钱？（顺便说一句，他们很少甚至从来♥♥♥♥♥♥♥不干活），不。他们还要死亡保险。如果你不准备再掏出8万以上来覆盖这笔费用，你还得为此额外支付利息。

哎呀呀，这听起来太棒了，你可能会这么想。我迫不及待要进入太空，拆掉那些飞船换点现金！好吧，你有得享受了。这确实能行——能行一阵子——然后游戏会随机认定你没穿宇航服——即使你穿着——接着你就突然死了，而你的宇航服状态完美，电池满格，氧气瓶75%，二氧化碳过滤器99%。没有任何解释，就是这样，你死于太空，老兄。真可惜。

这游戏一开始看起来像是一款有趣的游戏——它很细致！只要它按预期运行，就会把你吸进去——但这并不会持久。它刚好足以让你浪费生命中的几天，然后用数量惊人的随机bug中的任何一个把你♥♥♥♥♥得死去活来，把游戏彻底搞坏。

别费这个劲了。

items.text:
This game is chock full of severe, game-breaking, run-ruining bugs, many of which have been in the game for multiple years with no indication they will be fixed any time soon. The typical playthrough ends when the game is eventually rendered unplayable by steadily accumulating glitches, which happens sooner or later every single time.  It's a testament to how good the underlying idea is that it's still one of the best games I've played in years.

You should buy this game if it looks at all interesting, you're probably going to love it, you just need to understand what you're getting.  This is not a finished product.  It's a rough, work-in-progress development build of an absolute masterpiece.  There is jank absolutely everywhere.  Your game will crash sometimes.  Your saves will be corrupted. Your NPC crew will, if they can ever reach a treadmill, run on that treadmill until they die of exhaustion. The AI will occasionally decide to jump out of airlocks without suits or helmets. Your need bars will routinely duplicate themselves, resulting in infinite exhaustion that can never be cleared no matter how much you sleep.  And when it works, it won't matter, because you'll be having a blast.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏充满了严重的、破坏游戏、毁掉存档的漏洞，其中许多已经在游戏里存在了好几年，没有任何迹象表明它们会在短期内被修复。典型的游玩过程最终会以游戏因不断累积的故障而变得无法游玩告终，每一次都迟早会发生。这证明了其底层创意有多好，因为它仍然是我多年来玩过的最好的游戏之一。

如果这款游戏看起来哪怕有一点意思，你就应该买它，你可能会爱上它，你只需要明白自己买的是什么。这不是一个完成品。它是一款绝对杰作的粗糙、开发中的版本。到处都是粗糙感。你的游戏有时会崩溃。你的存档会损坏。你的NPC船员，如果它们能走到跑步机前，就会一直跑到累死为止。AI偶尔会决定不穿宇航服或头盔就从气闸跳出去。你的需求条会经常自我复制，导致无限的疲惫，无论你睡多久都无法清除。而当它正常运作时，这些都无所谓，因为你会玩得非常开心。

items.text:
Great game for an early access title. I spent a lot of time just going around space disassembling ships to build out my own ship from lighter ship pieces, I found the experience kind of cathartic after learning how to safely dock my ship. 

UI was kinda clunky when I played, and there were some bugs and minor annoyances that definitely need to be worked on. My character would sometimes just randomly wander off during his work shift ignoring the work orders I gave him and I'd have to lock him in the ship to keep him from wandering off. Some of the systems can be kind of hard to figure out on your own, I definitely recommend watching a guide on flying your ship and docking, and on how to set up a reactor for your ship. The mood/emotion system was kinda wonky, I didn't have a crew that I managed just my initial character so my main interaction with it was spamming social interactions whenever my character got depressed. 

I'm a pretty big fan of base building building and resource collection games and this ticks a special box for me. Going around salvaging derelict ships and potentially running into space pirates all to build myself a magnificent ship to fly off to different systems was enough to get me to sink quite a few hours into the game, but there's also some weird things you can encounter that I found quite interesting...

Overall I'd recommend this to anyone that has experience playing early access games that doesn't mind quite a bit of inventory management and some grinding. If you can get past some of the flaws of the game you'll see just how much this game could shine with the right polish. Definitely going to come back and play more some time to check out the recent updates

作为一款抢先体验游戏，这游戏很棒。我花了很多时间只是在太空中四处拆解飞船，用更轻的飞船部件来建造自己的飞船，在学会如何安全停靠飞船后，我发现这种体验有点让人感到宣泄。

我玩的时候UI有点笨拙，还有一些bug和小烦恼肯定需要解决。我的角色有时会在工作轮班期间随机乱逛，无视我给他的工作指令，我不得不把他锁在飞船里防止他乱跑。有些系统靠自己可能有点难搞懂，我强烈建议看看关于驾驶飞船和停靠的指南，以及如何为飞船设置反应堆。情绪/情感系统有点不稳定，我没有管理船员，只有我的初始角色，所以我和它的主要互动就是在我角色抑郁时狂点社交互动。

我是基地建设和资源收集游戏的忠实粉丝，这款游戏对我来说满足了一个特别的点。四处打捞废弃飞船，可能还会遇到太空海盗，这一切都是为了给自己造一艘宏伟的飞船飞往不同的星系，这足以让我在这游戏里投入好几个小时，但也有一些奇怪的东西你会遇到，我觉得挺有意思的……

总的来说，我会推荐给任何有玩抢先体验游戏经验、不介意大量物品管理和一些刷的人。如果你能克服游戏的一些缺陷，你就会看到这款游戏在适当的打磨下能有多闪耀。肯定会找个时间回来玩更多，看看最近的更新

items.text:
Look, I want to love this game. I should love this game. The atmosphere, the design, the mechanics – they're all weird and fascinating in a way that should hook me for hours. And yet... after multiple attempts, I'm still stuck in that awkward limbo between 'just wait for the game to get better' and 'screw it, just play through the jank and chaos.'

Every time I start a new run, something feels... missing. Not in the survival-horror-in-space way. I mean structurally. Like I'm piloting a half-finished ship built on ambition and duct tape.

I get that it's Early Access, and progress takes time. But it's hard to shake the feeling that this game's still searching for its core gameplay loop. Or maybe it's there, buried beneath layers of broken AI routines and menus that feel like they were designed as punishment.

All I’m asking is: when will this game finally feel complete enough to sink into? Right now it feels more like I’m bug-testing someone’s dream, not playing a game.

I don’t want perfection. I just want a stable foundation. Is that too much to ask... in space?
items.text_zh:
听着，我想爱上这款游戏。我应该爱上这款游戏。氛围、设计、机制——它们都以一种本该让我沉迷数小时的方式显得怪异而迷人。然而……在多次尝试之后，我仍然卡在“就等游戏变好”和“算了，直接忍着这些毛病和混乱玩下去”之间那个尴尬的中间地带。

每次我开始新的一局，总觉得……少了点什么。不是那种太空生存恐怖的感觉。我是说结构上的。就像我在驾驶一艘用野心和胶带拼凑起来的半成品飞船。

我明白这是抢先体验，进展需要时间。但很难摆脱这种感觉：这款游戏仍在寻找它的核心玩法循环。又或者它就在那里，埋在层层破碎的AI程序和那些感觉像是被设计成惩罚的菜单之下。

我只想问：这款游戏什么时候才能终于完整到让人能沉浸其中？现在感觉更像是我在给某人的梦想做bug测试，而不是在玩游戏。

我不想要完美。我只想要一个稳定的基础。这要求太过分了吗……在太空里？

items.text:
とりあえず、大体触れたと思うのでレビュー。
船の解体などはほかの方がレビューされているので省きます。

私が話すのは惑星間航行についてです。
中盤に差し掛かると惑星間の行き来が行えるようになります。
本作では核融合炉についている、touch driveにて加速及び原則を行います。その過程はすべてオートパイロットで行われます。(もちろん手動でもできます）
惑星間高校自体には行う意味がなく、付随して受けられる、宅配、死亡調査などといった仕事を受けることでその価値は倍増します。支払われる報酬は惑星内で完結できる仕事の10倍から100倍にも上ります。
現環境ではオーバーと言って差し支えなく、今後航行中の漂流物衝突など様々なリスクが追加されると考えられます。これに関しては期待としか言いようがないです。

AIについて
本作ではキャラクターを手動及び、AIで操作を行うことができます。ですがそのAIはお粗末なもので、十分な物資があっても飲食、睡眠は必要とされても積極的に行わず、困る場面が多々あります。正直言ってほかの作品、RImworldのような仕様にしてほしいと思います。

た
items.text_zh:
总之，我觉得大致上已经接触过了，所以写个评测。
关于拆船之类的内容，其他人都已经评测过了，我就省略了。

我要说的是关于行星际航行。
到了中期，就可以在行星之间往来了。
在本作中，是通过核聚变炉上附带的touch drive来进行加速和航行的。整个过程全部由自动驾驶完成。（当然也可以手动操作）
行星际航行本身并没有什么意义，但通过附带可以接到的快递、死亡调查等工作，其价值会翻倍。支付的报酬能达到在行星内就能完成的工作的10倍到100倍。
在当前环境下，说它过于优厚也不为过，我认为今后会追加航行中撞上漂浮物等各种风险。关于这一点，我只能说非常期待。

关于AI
在本作中，角色可以手动操作，也可以由AI操作。但那个AI很粗糙，即使有充足的物资，虽然需要饮食和睡眠，也不会主动去做，经常会出现让人困扰的情况。老实说，我希望它能像其他作品，比如RimWorld那样的规格。

た

items.text:
Ostranauts has a steep learning curve for newcomers, and even now there's many things I didn't know about and just found out. However, once the initial setback is overcome, you'd appreciate the many depths of the mechanics implemented into it's gameplay.

You'd understand that living and working in space isn't the most friendliest environment for a human body, which makes customising the space on your ship into something that's worth living in, which is also what makes it so special.

In short, it's a micromanagement simulator that makes you feel satisfied, while role-playing as someone who's trying to make a living in space-filled corporatism. And it being a sandbox gives players so much freedom into playing out this exact role they've been put in.

As the game progresses, things get much easier. You'll be able to recruit a crew mate to divide the labour, alternate your shifts, and focus in developing your own individual skills. Your initial mortgage gets paid off, and in turn you can pursue for more lucrative ways to earn money, without the weight of constant payments weighing on your mind.

My only concern is the AI of the game is lacking in many departments, which is what the Early Access tag is all about. The developers are doing a great job in fixing the bugs, and there's an entire community that's helping in this process. But I firmly believe, once the many annoying bugs are ironed out, more fruitful content can be pushed out, which is what this game is lacking a little after 100+ hours.

The beauty of it is that, I enjoyed the entire time that I've been playing, and I'm only on my first play-through! There's replay-ability in creating new saves, as the character creation screen has one of the most unique mechanic I've seen in a while. So I'll definitely be starting a new play-through once more content is added into the game.

If you're a big fan of space simulators, micro-management games, and sandbox freedom, this game is definitely for you! Plus, the art-style in this game is really charming! Give it a try!!

Disclaimer - it is for sure not everybody's cup of tea, but it fits into the right niche of gamers. And does a good job of doing so.
items.text_zh:
对于新手来说，《Ostranauts》的学习曲线很陡峭，即使到现在，仍有许多我不知道、刚刚才发现的东西。然而，一旦克服了最初的挫折，你就会欣赏到其玩法中实现的众多机制深度。

你会明白，在太空中生活和工作对人类身体来说并非最友好的环境，这使得将你飞船上的空间定制成值得居住的地方变得很有价值，也正是这一点让它如此特别。

简而言之，这是一款让你感到满足的微观管理模拟器，同时让你扮演一个试图在充满太空的企业主义中谋生的人。而它作为沙盒游戏，给予玩家极大的自由去演绎他们被赋予的这一确切角色。

随着游戏进展，事情会变得容易得多。你将能够招募一名船员来分担工作，轮换你们的班次，并专注于发展你自己的个人技能。你最初的抵押贷款会被还清，反过来你就可以追求更有利可图的赚钱方式，而不用让持续付款的重担压在心头。

我唯一的担忧是游戏的AI在许多方面都有所欠缺，而这正是抢先体验标签的意义所在。开发者在修复bug方面做得很好，而且有一个完整的社区在帮助这一过程。但我坚信，一旦许多烦人的bug被解决，就能推出更丰富的内容，而这正是这款游戏在100多个小时后略显欠缺的地方。

它的美妙之处在于，我享受了我玩这款游戏的整个时光，而我才刚刚完成第一周目！创建新存档具有重玩性，因为角色创建界面拥有我一段时间以来见过的最独特的机制之一。所以一旦游戏加入更多内容，我肯定会再次开始新的周目。

如果你是太空模拟器、微观管理游戏和沙盒自由的忠实粉丝，这款游戏绝对适合你！另外，这款游戏的美术风格真的很迷人！试一试吧！！

免责声明——它肯定不是每个人的菜，但它契合了合适的玩家群体。而且在这方面做得很好。

observations.description: 游戏AI在许多方面表现不足
observations.evidence: the AI of the game is lacking in many departments
observations.evidence_zh: 游戏的AI在很多方面都有所欠缺

items.text:
*In short, Sims in space. Quickly becoming my favorite game. Cant wait for the 1.0 so I can get lost again*

Let me tell you a story of me getting this game.
Several months ago I picked this up on sale, smoked a bowl and booted the game up, was digging the hell out of it, not really paying attention, took me like 2 hours to get to the point where I could get a ship lol. Feeling a little overwhelmed (remember high and the games pretty complicated) I wander around the station not really knowing wtf is going on or what im doing, trying to figure everything out and following the Tutorial. I sit in the cockpit and the nav screen clicks on and holy smokes! I am WAY to high to try to figure this ♥♥♥♥ out. Turned it off and played some Helldivers 2 probably. 

Recently ive been yearning for a solid Scifi RPG. Recently started playing Space Station 14 again, played SS13 over a decade ago a lot. But I commonly play lit and keeping up with the mostly chill vibe im looking for. I randomly saw Ostranauts in my list of games trying to find something to play and the cover art caught my eye so i booted it up, forgot all about it tbh. Didnt remember anything about the game (Playing high again lol), I sat down in the Nav console and OH CRAP THIS GAME AGAIN! and I closed it laughing. then i sat there and thought, "If I dont try it, I almost always play lit, ill never play it". So I launched it again and slowly learned what the hell I was doing lol. 

The next thing I know its 6am and im wide awake, went to sleep, woke up 6 hours later (I have insomnia and sometimes struggle to sleep or stay asleep) and start playing again. Literally the next thing I know it was 6 am again. This literally happened during the Presidents day weekend and most of the day before after work. 

This game is nearly everything I could have wanted in a space game. Im a big SciFi nerd and love Hard SciFi (Think more Expanse and less Star Trek) its just complicated enough for me to have to learn and feel accomplished. The first time a meteorite or something slammed into my hull taught me to compartmentalize, im trying to not save scum unless im testing a game system to make sure i get how it works. and forced me to react, I try to play real time when doing things, I speed up time when hauling and stuff. For me its a very immersive Space life sim, Im just my Character just trying to make it, no goals unless I want goals outside of making money for my loan. 

I have a tenancy of losing interest in games after 20 or so hours, rarely go games hold me for over 100 hours, Never in 1 fracking week lol. I understand this game is going 1.0 next year, I worry ill have the same problem I have with many EA games, Is I burn out on them and dont want to have to redo that part to see the new stuff, or too much time has passed and I forgot about it completely. This will be the first game I will tag for follow, I want to know everything about this game. However knowing thats a risk im getting all my enjoyment from it now, Assuming ill have to restart on 1.0, I hope I am just as enthralled with this game again. 

Now im not saying its not a buggy mess, complicated, many annoying UI issues, information that's hard to find (How ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ often is long term docking fees charged? whats the point of PDAs, etc), bad AI, Really cool conversation system but convoluted and hard to understand (Should take inspiration from the sims), not being able to tell your guy to auto build using specific materials, instead they will grab anything (so you have to build your ship manually if you want it looking a specific way) among many MANY issues. But even with all that, the times im not playing im thinking about what ill be going once I hop on, caught myself while out to dinner sketching out ship designs at Chilis lol. 

Im finally at the point where im docking my ship and tearing it all apart and building my Dream ship, Solo (No crew), and I want to have an outer hull with a technical corridors (with breaks using more TC) so when something hits me (Looking at you F*** Around and Find Out! MF has hit me 3 times and busted my ship.

I dont know if its accurate but it feels like Star Citizen/Elite Dangerous Meets Rimworld Meets The Sims all Single player. 

From what im reading the goals, this game will lose me, my body will be found at this computer with this game running... Mr EMS or my wife, please seal whatever leak killed me, I spent a lot of time and money on this ship, its all I have lol. 

Also good god how do you improve firearms use without blowing a hole in my suit every time?
items.text_zh:
*简而言之，太空版模拟人生。迅速成为我最喜欢的游戏。等不及1.0了，这样我就能再次迷失其中*

让我给你讲讲我得到这款游戏的故事。
几个月前，我在打折时买了它，抽了一碗，然后启动了游戏，玩得超级投入，没怎么注意，大概花了2个小时才达到能弄到一艘船的地步，哈哈。感觉有点不知所措（记得当时嗨了，而且游戏相当复杂），我在空间站里闲逛，不太知道到底发生了什么，也不知道自己在做什么，试图弄清楚一切并跟着教程走。我坐在驾驶舱里，导航屏幕亮了，我的天！我嗨得太过头了，根本没法搞明白这♥♥♥♥。关掉游戏，可能去玩了一些《地狱潜者2》。

最近我一直渴望一款扎实的科幻RPG。最近又开始玩《空间站14》，十多年前玩过很多《空间站13》。但我通常玩得比较嗨，保持着我所追求的那种大多时候很放松的氛围。我在游戏列表里随机看到《奥斯特拉诺茨》，想找点东西玩，封面艺术吸引了我的眼球，所以我启动了它，说实话，完全忘了它。不记得关于这游戏的任何事（又玩嗨了，哈哈），我坐在导航控制台前，哦靠，又是这游戏！我笑着关掉了。然后我坐在那里想，“如果我不尝试，我几乎总是玩嗨，我永远不会玩它”。所以我又启动了它，慢慢学会了我在搞什么鬼，哈哈。

接下来我知道的就是早上6点，我完全清醒，去睡觉，6小时后醒来（我有失眠症，有时难以入睡或保持睡眠），又开始玩。真的，接下来我知道的又是早上6点。这 literally 发生在总统日周末，以及之前下班后的大部分时间。

这款游戏几乎是我对太空游戏想要的一切。我是个超级科幻迷，喜欢硬科幻（想想更多《苍穹浩瀚》，少点《星际迷航》），它刚好复杂到让我必须学习并感到有成就感。第一次陨石或什么东西撞上我的船体，教会了我分区，我尽量不存档作弊，除非我在测试游戏系统以确保我明白它如何运作。并迫使我做出反应，我在做事时尽量实时玩，在运输东西时加速时间。对我来说，这是一个非常沉浸式的太空生活模拟，我只是我的角色，只是努力生存，除了为我的贷款赚钱之外，没有目标，除非我想要目标。

我有个倾向，在玩20小时左右后对游戏失去兴趣，很少有游戏能让我玩超过100小时，从来没有在1个该死的星期内，哈哈。我知道这款游戏明年要出1.0，我担心我会遇到许多EA游戏的问题，就是我会玩腻，不想重做那部分来看新内容，或者时间过得太久，我完全忘了它。这将是我第一个标记关注的游戏，我想知道关于这款游戏的一切。然而知道这是个风险，我现在就获取所有乐趣，假设我必须在1.0时重新开始，我希望我能再次如此着迷于这款游戏。

现在我不是说它不是个满是bug的烂摊子，复杂，许多烦人的UI问题，难以找到的信息（长期停靠费到底♥♥♥♥♥♥♥多久收一次？PDA有什么意义，等等），糟糕的AI，非常酷的对话系统但 convoluted 且难以理解（应该从模拟人生中汲取灵感），不能告诉你的角色使用特定材料自动建造，而是他们会抓任何东西（所以如果你想船看起来特定样子，你必须手动建造）以及许多许多问题。但即使有所有这些，我不玩的时候都在想我一上线会做什么，在Chilis外出吃饭时发现自己草图设计飞船，哈哈。

我终于到了停靠我的船，把它全部拆开，建造我的梦想船的地步，单人（无船员），我想要一个带有技术走廊的外壳（使用更多TC来断开），这样当什么东西撞到我时（说的就是你，F*** Around and Find Out！那混蛋撞了我3次，弄坏了我的船。

我不知道是否准确，但感觉像是《星际公民》/《精英危险》遇上《边缘世界》遇上《模拟人生》，全是单人。

从我读到的目标来看，这款游戏会失去我，我的尸体会被发现坐在这台电脑前，游戏还在运行……EMS先生或我妻子，请封住杀死我的泄漏，我在这艘船上花了大量时间和金钱，这是我的一切，哈哈。

还有天哪，你怎么提高枪械使用而不每次都在我的宇航服上炸个洞？
他们会随便抓取任何东西（所以如果你想让飞船看起来有特定的样子，就必须手动建造），这只是众多问题中的一小部分。但即便如此，当我不玩的时候，我都在想我一上线要做什么，有次在外面吃晚饭时，我发现自己竟然在Chilis餐厅里画飞船设计图，哈哈。

我终于到了把飞船停靠、全部拆开、建造我的梦想飞船的阶段，单人（无船员），我想要一个带有技术走廊的外壳（用更多TC来制造隔断），这样当有什么东西撞到我时（说的就是你，F*** Around and Find Out！那混蛋撞了我3次，把我的飞船搞坏了。

我不知道这准不准确，但感觉就像是《星际公民》/《精英危险》遇上《边缘世界》遇上《模拟人生》，全是单人模式。

从我读到的目标来看，这游戏会让我迷失，我的尸体会被发现坐在这台电脑前，游戏还开着……EMS先生或者我老婆，请把我因为什么泄漏而死的地方封住，我在这艘飞船上花了很多时间和金钱，这是我的一切了，哈哈。

还有天哪，你怎么才能在每次不把自己的宇航服打出一个洞的情况下提高枪械使用技能？

items.text:
A fun game where you can scavenge ships for parts and even go on atmospheric races.

My experiences thus far:
1. Scavenge enough to expand my crew to two.
2. Get the message my crew is in trouble, only to find her suffocating because she put on a helmet with no oxygen.
3. Get the message my crew is in trouble, only to find she decided to go on a space-walk without any kind of enviroment suit.
4. Try to dock with the main station, get crushed into oblivion by another ship.

But seriously, this game still needs a lot of polish. But the potential for a great game is already there.

Protip: Save often.

10/10 would continue playing.

items.text:
If you enjoy games like Dwarf Fortress, Project Zomboid, and Rimworld then you'll probably enjoy this game quite a lot. Like all of those games you'll probably have to watch a little bit of a playthrough or a tutorial to really get a grasp of even the basic game mechanics. HOWEVER, once you put in the work this is easily one of the most rewarding games to play. 

The basic gameplay loop is as follows. You start off with a small dinky ship which (usually) immediately puts you around $500,000 to $800,000 in debt. Then you purchase a salvaging license (or don't), get in your ship, fly out to derelict ships, uninstall and repair the most expensive parts, fly back to base, sell everything, pay your bills, and repeat. But you don't have to sell the parts, instead, you can choose to install them and slowly improve your ship. This is the part I find to be the most rewarding. The ship I currently fly doesn't even remotely resemble what I started the game with even though it's technically the same ship. 

But if the game was as simple as that I wouldn't have the prerequisite of liking those other games. All of these systems are (usually) incredibly complex, or have surrounding systems that are complex. Just flying the ship requires you at least read the very short cheat sheet. But other things such knowing how to properly pressurize your ship and setting up a reactor have entire in-game fantasy manuals that read just like real ones. But it also knows exactly when to scale complexity back. Like installing additions to your ship is mainly a challenge of just having the correct parts and some time. It's the perfect thing to do while listening to music or a podcast or watching Youtube. 

There's so much I can't possibly mention all of it. You can take gigs, solve murders, flip ships, become a pirate, fight pirates, go to other planets, and I'm sure much much more that I haven't even discovered yet. 

But unfortunately as much as I would like for this review to be entirely positive there are a lot of issues and some seemingly unfinished or odd design decisions that I have to address. For instance, you can talk to and have relationships with other people you meet, with the ability to hire them as a crew. But the dialogue choices are really just a choice of whatever stat you want to raise or lower, and as a result a lot of conversations are entirely nonsensical. A back and forth might go like this (P = Player)
[list]
[*] P: How are you doing
[*] NPC: Lightly Touch
[*] P: Nod
[*] NPC: Savage Insult
[*] P: Yay!
[*] NPC: Shoot The Breeze
[*] P: Shoot The Breeze
[*] NPC: Shoot The Breeze
[*] P: Lightly Touch
[*] NPC: Savage Insult" [/list]

And if you keep that up you can make anyone your best friend. It seems oddly non-complex or unfinished for a game like this, And it isn't the only issue the dialogue has. Everyone including your character can only do one action at a time, and since talking counts as an action that means you can't speak to anyone while you or they are doing anything. You also have to be directly next to somebody to speak to them which means if an NPC is walking around you have to kind of awkwardly follow them until they stop walking, or intercept their path just to talk to them. An option to "call somebody over" like in The Sims would alleviate a lot of frustration there. My black market NPC has a set path back and forth between a cart and doing anything with them is a chore and a half just because they're constantly interacting with things (doors and the cart) and on the move. 

There's also one truly baffling UI decision which makes this game needlessly frustrating, the items in the context menu constantly change positions. Instead of having a hotkey to cancel an action you cancel it from the context menu, but it wants cancelling your task to be the first option (because you can't do anything else while doing something anyway). So it inserts "cancel action" at the top of the list, pushing all the other items and hotkeys down. This cancel action button shows up doing anything other than walking. Sometimes you'll set a path for your character to walk, then while they're walking try to tell them to do something, but because they had to open a door you accidentally told them to bash the object instead of something else.

This isn't even only a problem with cancel action because there are other instances where new items get added to the context list such as the "jettison" action. and I just don't understand why. There are 4 hotkeys for the first 4 actions, they should simply just be static. Every time you right click an object and press 3 it should repair it, I shouldn't have to EVER worry about that changing. Cancel action should just have a unique hotkey. I'm not saying it can't be in the context menu, but it has to be inserted BELOW all hotkeyed actions. This is easily one of my major frustrations with this game. 

And don't get it twisted, these aren't even close to the only frustrating issues. NPC crew mates are only "half-NPC" meaning they do things on their own, but you can also "fully control" them (you have to constantly fight their automatic actions to control them). However, they're incapable of actually taking care of themselves in any capacity. I have seen my NPC crew mate use a hygiene pack ONE TIME in a week, every other time I had to switch control to the NPC, feed them, make them drink, make them ♥♥♥♥, bathe them, swap the batteries in their equipment, Without my control they were essentially useless, stuck on an endless loop of working out for multiple hours straight, then sleeping (on the floor for some reason) until I wake them up to manually take care of their needs, only to repair ship at 1x speed because they're exhausted and sad from not taking care of themselves and endlessly working out, then after shift immediately go back to working out for hours until completely exhausted and sleeping again.

Then you dock at the port and even though they're on-shift they don't help you repair your haul they leave the ship and wander around watching TV's, talking to everyone, writing letters home, and quietly sobbing to themselves, even on auto task. Maybe I have to manually use the PDA to tell them to repair the loose items, but honestly I shouldn't have to, Eventually I had to uninstall all workout equipment but my crew mate still had the "at physical limits" moodlet for 2 entire days before I decided to just fire them because doing everything on my own was simply easier. I should not have to micromanage a crew mate this much, Taking care of your primary character is hard enough. 

I also just have to quickly mention the games performance is really bad. I have an AMD 5700, Intel i7 10700k 3.8GHz, and 32GB RAM and the game suffers from lag, stutters, freezing, and memory leaks. It's still entirely playable especially when compared to something like a heavily modded Zomboid, but I can imagine this game being a nightmare on a low-end PC. 

I could go on but I have to wrap this up. I think even in it's current state it's still worth recommending to a specific type of gamer. The game is currently in Early Access and receiving regular updates to fix bugs, tweak the UI, and more. I can live with certain oddities like the dialogue system, but some of these other issues have to be addressed. Still, I'm not disappointed in my purchase at all, Steam says I have 40 hours but I played about another 60 hours offline and I still want to play more. If this games modding scene grows the replayablility seems like it would be essentially infinite.
items.text_zh:
如果你喜欢《矮人要塞》、《僵尸毁灭工程》和《环世界》这类游戏，那你很可能会非常喜欢这款游戏。和所有这些游戏一样，你可能得看一点实况或教程，才能真正掌握哪怕是最基本的游戏机制。然而，一旦你投入了努力，这绝对是玩起来最有成就感的游戏之一。

基本的游戏循环如下。你一开始有一艘小小的破船，这（通常）会立刻让你背上大约50万到80万美元的债务。然后你购买一张打捞许可证（或者不买），登上你的船，飞到废弃船只那里，拆下并修理最贵的部件，飞回基地，卖掉一切，付清账单，然后重复。但你不一定非得卖掉那些部件，相反，你可以选择把它们安装上去，慢慢升级你的船。这是我觉得最有成就感的部分。我现在开的船和游戏开始时的那艘已经完全不像了，尽管从技术上讲它还是同一艘船。

但如果游戏就这么简单，我就不会把喜欢那些其他游戏作为前提条件了。所有这些系统（通常）都极其复杂，或者有围绕它们的复杂系统。光是开船就要求你至少读一读那份非常简短的速查表。但其他事情，比如知道如何正确地给你的船加压以及设置反应堆，都有完整的游戏内幻想手册，读起来就像真的一样。但它也完全知道什么时候该把复杂度降下来。比如给你的船安装附加部件，主要只是要有正确的零件和一些时间的挑战。这是听音乐、听播客或看YouTube时做的完美事情。

内容太多了，我不可能全部提到。你可以接活、破谋杀案、倒卖船只、当海盗、打海盗、去其他星球，而且我肯定还有更多更多我甚至还没发现的东西。

但不幸的是，尽管我很希望这篇评测全是正面的，但还是有很多问题，以及一些看似未完成或奇怪的设计决定，我必须得说一说。比如说，你可以和你遇到的其他角色交谈并建立关系，还能雇他们当船员。但对话选项实际上只是选择你想提升或降低哪项属性，结果就是很多对话完全莫名其妙。一来一回可能像这样（P = 玩家）
[list]
[*] P: 你好吗
[*] NPC: 轻轻触碰
[*] P: 点头
[*] NPC: 野蛮侮辱
[*] P: 耶！
[*] NPC: 闲聊
[*] P: 闲聊
[*] NPC: 闲聊
[*] P: 轻轻触碰
[*] NPC: 野蛮侮辱" [/list]

如果你一直这样下去，你可以让任何人成为你最好的朋友。对于这样一款游戏来说，这显得奇怪地不复杂或未完成，而且这还不是对话的唯一问题。每个人，包括你的角色，一次只能做一个动作，而既然说话也算一个动作，那就意味着当你或他们正在做任何事时，你都不能和任何人说话。你还必须紧挨着某人才能和他们说话，这意味着如果一个NPC在四处走动，你就得有点尴尬地跟着他们，直到他们停下脚步，或者拦住他们的去路才能跟他们说话。像《模拟人生》里那样一个“叫某人过来”的选项会缓解很多挫败感。我的黑市NPC有一条在推车之间来回的固定路线，和他们做任何事都麻烦得要命，就因为他们一直在和
东西（门和推车）并且在移动中。

还有一个真正令人费解的UI决定，让这款游戏变得毫无必要地令人沮丧，上下文菜单中的物品会不断改变位置。游戏没有设置取消动作的快捷键，而是让你从上下文菜单中取消，但它希望取消你的任务成为第一个选项（因为反正你在做某件事的时候也不能做其他事）。所以它把“取消动作”插入到列表顶部，把所有其他物品和快捷键都往下推。这个取消动作按钮在你做任何不是走路的事情时都会出现。有时候你会为你的角色设定一条行走路径，然后当他们正在走路时试图告诉他们去做某件事，但因为他们必须打开一扇门，你就不小心让他们去砸那个物体，而不是做别的事。

这甚至不只是取消动作的问题，因为还有其他情况会向上下文列表中添加新物品，比如“抛弃”动作。而我就是不明白为什么。前4个动作有4个快捷键，它们就应该只是固定的。每次你右键点击一个物体然后按3，它就应该修理它，我永远不应该担心那会改变。取消动作就应该有一个独特的快捷键。我不是说它不能出现在上下文菜单里，但它必须被插入到所有有快捷键的动作下面。这很容易成为我对这款游戏的主要不满之一。

别搞错了，这些甚至远不是唯一令人沮丧的问题。NPC船员只是“半个NPC”，意思是他们会自己做事情，但你也可以“完全控制”他们（你必须不断对抗他们的自动动作才能控制他们）。然而，他们完全无法以任何方式照顾自己。我见过我的NPC船员一周只用了一次卫生包，其他每次我都必须切换到控制那个NPC，喂他们，让他们喝水，让他们♥♥♥♥，给他们洗澡，更换他们装备里的电池。没有我的控制，他们基本上毫无用处，陷入一个无尽的循环：连续锻炼好几个小时，然后睡觉（不知为何睡在地板上），直到我叫醒他们来手动满足他们的需求，结果只能以1倍速度修理飞船，因为他们精疲力竭且悲伤，因为他们不照顾自己还无休止地锻炼，然后下班后立刻又回去锻炼好几个小时，直到完全精疲力竭又睡着。

然后你停靠在港口，即使他们在值班，他们也不帮你修理你的货物，他们离开飞船四处闲逛看电视、和每个人聊天、给家里写信，还悄悄地独自啜泣，即使是在自动任务模式下。也许我必须手动使用PDA告诉他们去修理散落的物品，但老实说我不应该非得这么做。最终我不得不卸载所有锻炼设备，但我的船员仍然带着“达到身体极限”的心情状态整整2天，之后我决定干脆解雇他们，因为自己做所有事情反而更简单。我不应该对一个船员进行这么多微观管理，照顾你的主要角色已经够难了。

我还必须快速提一下，游戏的性能真的很差。我有一块AMD 5700、Intel i7 10700k 3.8GHz和32GB内存，游戏却饱受延迟、卡顿、冻结和内存泄漏之苦。它仍然完全可以玩，尤其是和像打了大量模组的Zomboid之类的东西相比，但我能想象这款游戏在低端PC上会是一场噩梦。

我还可以继续说下去，但
我得把这篇收尾了。我觉得即使是在目前的状态下，它仍然值得推荐给某一类特定的玩家。这款游戏目前处于抢先体验阶段，并且会定期更新来修复bug、调整UI等等。对话系统之类的某些古怪之处我可以忍受，但其他一些问题必须得到解决。不过，我对自己的购买完全不失望，Steam显示我玩了40小时，但我离线又玩了大约60小时，而且我还想继续玩。如果这款游戏的模组社区发展起来，重玩性似乎基本上会是无限的。

I have seen my NPC crew mate use a hygiene pack ONE TIME in a week, every other time I had to switch control to the NPC, feed them, make them drink, make them ♥♥♥♥, bathe them, swap the batteries in their equipment

items.text:
I think this quite possibly might be the best game I have ever played. Its the perfect mix of everything I like in a video game. Its a challenging game which doesn't hold your hand and allows you to figure out its quirks and strategies on your own, which is genuinely a lot of fun! Expect for your first few characters to die horribly and just keep at it. 

This game is the perfect mix of hardcore game play with an amazing setting and a satisfying loop. There's many ways to make your fortune and each way is just so satisfying! Building and upgrading your own ship using the scrap you find feels awesome as you slowly progress through blood sweat and tears. Finally breaking out of debt felt incredible. 

There are a few issues, but all of them are mostly due to the game being in early access. The social mechanics are bare bones, combat with enemies is extremely easy if you know how to fight and the AI of the other pilots is... bad. I have genuinely had to reload hundreds of times in my play through because one of the KLEG haulers has flown into me at max speed which is very annoying. All of these issues are issues that are likely to be fixed in future updates.

I cannot recommend this game enough. I think this is the best game I have ever played. If you are considering getting this game do it.
items.text_zh:
我觉得这很可能是我玩过的最好的游戏。它完美地混合了我在电子游戏中喜欢的一切。它是一款有挑战性的游戏，不会手把手教你，让你自己去摸索它的怪癖和策略，这真的非常有趣！预计你前几个角色会死得很惨，只要坚持下去就好。

这款游戏是硬核玩法与绝佳背景设定和令人满足的循环的完美结合。有很多方式可以发财，每一种方式都那么令人满足！用你找到的废料建造和升级你自己的飞船，随着你在血汗和泪水中慢慢进步，感觉棒极了。终于摆脱债务的感觉不可思议。

有一些问题，但所有这些问题大多是因为游戏处于抢先体验阶段。社交机制很简陋，如果你知道怎么战斗，与敌人的战斗极其容易，而其他飞行员的AI……很糟糕。在我的游玩过程中，我真的不得不重载数百次，因为某艘KLEG运输船以最高速度撞上了我，这非常烦人。所有这些问题都很可能在未来的更新中得到修复。

我怎么推荐这款游戏都不为过。我认为这是我玩过的最好的游戏。如果你正在考虑入手这款游戏，那就买吧。

items.text:
Can't recommend after the developer made it clear they don't care about the abundant bugs. They've essentially put out a barely playable beta version that manages to dazzle with a seemingly promising outlook and a great soundtrack. And to be clear, this could be a great game if they ever got beyond the basics.

This outlook got corrected with the dev stating that after six years of part-time development, they don't have any plans to go beyond 1% of the initially promised content of a living solar system. This happened right after they managed to get an infamous "indie-riffic" publisher (meaning "never the big time") with more bug-ridden shovelware games on board. The devs are not above deleting critical threads on the forum, and reporting and banning players for imagined infractions either.

It's not just the game breaking bugs that have been discussed many times on the forum without response from the devs. I had to use the debug console multiple times just to keep my save going, not to cheat in any way. It's also a line of baffling design decisions about the clunky UI producing endless amounts of inventory tetris and other annoyances. NPC AI is broken beyond belief even in the "1.0" version. Even save game management is broken in ways that should never have been released to the public.

The basic gameplay loop features almost zero actual tactical decisions, instead it's 95% waiting for timers to run down. Timers to uninstall parts, timers to repair them. Then return to the space station to sell everything and watch the game break in front of your eyes. Hoarding and selling like the most basic 90s dungeon crawler but surprise: there is no actual dungeon. Even the fights are a poor excuse for what could have been. Most quests simply break along the way and cannot be completed.

Another failed early access title, and the part-time amateur developers who put two types of marihuana cigarettes into their game don't even understand how to work constructively with the community for modding and content creation.
items.text_zh:
在开发者明确表示他们不在乎大量bug之后，无法推荐。他们基本上发布了一个勉强能玩的测试版，靠着看似有前途的前景和出色的配乐让人眼花缭乱。而且要说清楚，如果他们能超越基础层面，这本来可能是一款很棒的游戏。

这种前景在开发者声明之后被纠正了：经过六年的兼职开发，他们没有任何计划去实现最初承诺的活太阳系的1%内容。这发生在他刚刚找到一个臭名昭著的“独立范儿”发行商（意思是“永远成不了大气候”）之后，该发行商旗下还有更多满是bug的劣质游戏。开发者也不是不会删除论坛上的批评帖子，还会因为想象出来的违规行为举报和封禁玩家。

不只是那些在论坛上被讨论过很多次却得不到开发者回应的破坏游戏的bug。我不得不多次使用调试控制台只是为了让我存档能继续下去，完全不是为了作弊。还有一系列关于笨拙UI的令人费解的设计决策，产生了无穷无尽的库存俄罗斯方块和其他烦人之处。NPC AI即使在“1.0”版本中也破碎得令人难以置信。甚至存档管理也以绝不应该公开发布的方式坏掉了。

基本玩法循环几乎没有任何实际的战术决策，相反，95%的时间都是在等待计时器走完。卸载零件的计时器，修理零件的计时器。然后回到空间站卖掉一切，看着游戏在你眼前崩溃。像最基础的90年代地牢爬行游戏那样囤积和出售，但惊喜来了：根本没有真正的地牢。就连战斗也是对本来可以做成什么样的一种糟糕借口。大多数任务在途中就直接坏掉，无法完成。

又一个失败的抢先体验作品，而那些把两种大麻香烟放进游戏里的兼职业余开发者，甚至都不懂如何与社区建设性地合作进行模组制作和内容创作。

items.text:
The game, interestingly enough plays like a hybrid of Project Zomboid and Space Station 13 with less of an emphasis on combat and more on building/salvaging. The core gameplay loop is there, but once you get to the point to of buying derelicts to flip you have pretty much beaten the game. There are other late game things you can do, but there isn't as much engagement there. I've put in over a hundred hours so far and am now finally starting to lose interest as the only real meat in this game is finding and selling parts with the main incentive being to upgrade your own ship and equipment.

The social elements tend to hinder this game quite a bit, and to be honest the game would benefit from dropping it if it isn't radically changed in some way. You can hire crew, but they tend to be on the less useful side if not an outright liability. You CAN leave the boneyard you start in, but there is little reason to do so unless you want to trade cargo.

In spite of all this, nothing stopped me from turning my scrappy box sled into a fusion powered cruiser with all the amenities I need. A fun a satisfying game that will easily give you more hours of game time than dollars you have spent.
items.text_zh:
有趣的是，这款游戏的玩法像是《僵尸毁灭工程》和《太空站13》的混合体，但更不强调战斗，而更注重建造/打捞。核心玩法循环是存在的，但一旦你到了购买废弃船只来翻新转卖的地步，你基本上就已经通关了。还有其他后期可以做的事情，但那里的参与度就没那么高了。到目前为止我已经投入了一百多个小时，现在终于开始失去兴趣了，因为这款游戏唯一真正的肉就是寻找和出售零件，主要动机是升级你自己的飞船和装备。

社交元素往往会相当程度地拖累这款游戏，说实话，如果不以某种方式彻底改变的话，去掉它反而对游戏有好处。你可以雇佣船员，但他们往往不太有用，甚至完全是累赘。你确实可以离开你开始时的废船场，但除非你想交易货物，否则没什么理由这么做。

尽管如此，这一切都没有阻止我把我那艘破破烂烂的盒子雪橇变成一艘拥有我所需要的一切便利设施的聚变动力巡洋舰。一款有趣而令人满足的游戏，轻松就能给你带来比你花费的美元更多的游戏时间。

items.text:
"The Expanse" meets "Stationeers". 

Got this during Winter Sale, so it was discounted. After the first 5 hours, I knew I'd be willing to get it at full cost.

As of writing this, the game is still in Early Access, so expect the game to have bugs. 
Personally haven't experienced any of the big gamebreaking ones, just some annoying minor types (e.g. graphical issues, crew that keeps following me, even after i've fired them and told them to stop following). 

The game's concept is simple enough to understand, but there are aspects that aren't directly obvious, e.g character interactions with NPCs (as in what each option does, and how they affect future interactions), precisely what each skill does (both negatives and positives) and how it'd affect the bigger picture. 

Just 36 hours in (so far), but having a blast with it. Biggest downside; no multiplayer. Even if MP isn't in the cards at all for this one, when it gets fully fleshed out and gets it's 1.0 release, this looks to become an exceptionally great timesink, 

"Just.... One.... More.... Derelict!!!" (If that one went over your head, this will probably not be of much interest in the long run)

我是在冬季特卖时买的，所以是打折价。玩了头5个小时后，我就知道自己愿意按全价买它。

写这篇评测时，游戏仍处于抢先体验阶段，所以请预料到游戏会有bug。
就我个人而言，没遇到过什么严重破坏游戏的大bug，只是一些烦人的小问题（例如画面问题、船员一直跟着我，即使我已经解雇了他们并叫他们别再跟着）。

游戏的概念足够简单易懂，但有些方面并不那么直接明显，例如角色与NPC的互动（也就是每个选项具体做什么，以及它们如何影响未来的互动）、每项技能究竟有什么作用（正面和负面效果都算），以及它会如何影响大局。

才玩了36个小时（到目前为止），但已经玩得不亦乐乎。最大的缺点：没有多人模式。即使这款游戏完全没打算做多人模式，等它内容完全充实并发布1.0正式版后，这看起来也会成为一个极其出色的时间黑洞，

“就……再……来……一艘……废弃飞船！！！”（如果你没看懂这个梗，那这款游戏从长远来看大概也不会让你太感兴趣）

items.text: the 1.0 launched feels rushed, with station feeling bare bones and with nothing to do on them. Like different types of jobs, shipyards to pay to repair/refill ammo of your ship for you at the cost of some time, bars to buy info on some juicy derelict ship floating adrift. Ship battery capacity is way to small, and no way to upgrade said capacity, aside the torch drive. which becomes expensive quick, and that's if you have a He3, D2O, and cryo tanks as well. What about solar panels, radioactive heat decay into electricity using nuclear generators or chemical fuel cells? An armored version of the eva suit/s for melee and/or gun fights and/or ship combat. Or a light weight eva that is battery powered & has o2 cans, with a backpack slot for all the loot goblins. I would love to use more than one crew member, but it's like babysitting a toddler sometimes. having to stop and redirect him every quite often, that's not to mention the disappearing items that come with having mulitiple crew members. So it's easier to build/design/remodel ships for a single guy, plus it's really cost effective/time efficient too. Lots of missed opportunities, in terms of ideas expressed on the discord but then never done. To then pop up on the workshop. Ever wish you could build a station out of salvaged ship wrecks? need workshop mod for that. Want bigger back packs, cause the vanilla bags are puny. need a workshop mod for it. Want your He3 tanks to sit next to each other? need a workshop mod for it. I could probably write an essay on the amount of bugs that are currently plaguing this game currently. that if ya don't believe, just checkout their discord.
items.text_zh: 1.0版本发布感觉仓促，空间站显得简陋，没什么可做的。比如不同类型的工作、可以付费在船坞花些时间修理/补充你飞船的弹药、酒吧里可以购买关于某艘漂浮废弃飞船的诱人情报。飞船电池容量太小了，而且除了火炬驱动器之外没有办法升级容量。而火炬驱动器很快就会变得昂贵，前提是你还得有He3、D2O和低温罐。那太阳能板呢，用核发电机或化学燃料电池把放射性热衰变转化为电能呢？为我近战和/或枪战和/或飞船战斗用的装甲版EVA服。或者轻量级EVA，电池供电并带有氧气罐，还有一个背包槽位给所有拾荒狂魔。我很想使用不止一个船员，但有时候就像照看一个蹒跚学步的孩子。得经常停下来重新指挥他，更别提多个船员带来的物品消失问题。所以为一个人建造/设计/改造飞船更容易，而且也非常省钱省时。很多错失的机会，就Discord上表达的想法而言，但后来从未实现。然后突然出现在创意工坊里。曾经希望你能用打捞来的飞船残骸建造空间站吗？需要创意工坊模组才行。想要更大的背包，因为原版包太小了。需要创意工坊模组才行。想让你的He3罐并排放置吗？需要创意工坊模组才行。我大概能写一篇论文来讲述目前困扰这款游戏的bug数量。如果不信，就去看看他们的Discord吧。

items.text:
EDIT: Okay, well, unfortunately, the devs have decided to rush this game into release even though it's a buggy mess. We all knew this game was years away from being completed but now they're saying it's just around the corner. For that reason, I will have to change my review to a negative as the current state of the game is just unacceptable as a full release.

Absolutely excellent game. Yes, the learning curve is extreme, and you'll be googling ♥♥♥♥ all night. Yes, the bugs are legion and you'll have to get creative to get around them. By the level of game mechanics represented in even this early assess iteration of the game is outstanding. I've had moments in this game I've never had elsewhere. Like when a conduit to my nav console failed and I needed to find a creative way to fix it without the proper materials or risk smashing into something because I was already going incredible speeds. I ended up disconnecting some components just to get the power back. I hopped back into the console and continued on my way to the station with a stash worth over 100k. You just always have to be ready to puzzle solve --- figuring out how things work and building a real, practical knowledge base of the game. People in the community call it getting "hardened" because you the player are taking a very active role in things. The characters aren't the only ones that needs skills to survive: you do. And the game is a very harsh teacher. But the ability to improvise and innovate is so so fulfilling in this game. Your ship is your baby and you hate letting the borderline retarded crew ai touch it lol. 10/10 but not for everyone. It desperately needs polish --- especially the crew ai. If they were more of a help this game would truly shine. After that point, I wouldn't complain about bugs: it would just be a matter of content. Which there is plenty of at this point.
items.text_zh:
编辑：好吧，不幸的是，开发者决定把这款游戏仓促推入正式发布，尽管它还是一团满是bug的烂摊子。我们都知道这款游戏距离完成还有好几年，但现在他们却说马上就要完成了。因此，我不得不把我的评测改为差评，因为游戏当前的状态作为正式发布版是完全不可接受的。

绝对出色的游戏。是的，学习曲线极其陡峭，你会整晚都在谷歌上查♥♥♥♥。是的，bug多如牛毛，你必须发挥创造力来绕过它们。但即便是在这个早期测试版本中，游戏机制所呈现出的水平也已经非常杰出。我在这款游戏里经历过别处从未有过的时刻。比如，当我导航控制台的一条导管失效时，我需要找到一种创造性的方法来修复它，既没有合适的材料，又面临着撞上什么东西的风险，因为我当时已经在以惊人的速度飞行。我最终断开了一些组件，只是为了恢复电力。我跳回控制台，带着价值超过10万的物资继续前往空间站。你总是必须准备好解谜——弄清楚事物如何运作，并建立一套真正实用的游戏知识库。社区里的人把这称为“变硬”，因为你作为玩家在事情中扮演着非常主动的角色。不只是角色需要技能才能生存：你也需要。而这款游戏是一位非常严苛的老师。但在这款游戏中，即兴发挥和创新的能力是如此令人满足。你的飞船就是你的宝贝，你讨厌让那个近乎弱智的船员AI碰它，哈哈。10/10，但不适合所有人。它迫切需要打磨——尤其是船员AI。如果它们能更有帮助，这款游戏会真正大放异彩。到那时，我就不会抱怨bug了：那只会是内容多少的问题。而目前内容已经相当充足了。

items.text:
>>> TLDR: This is a comprehensive set of systems to simulate space-scrapper's life with very little motivation to actually do it. It's also extremely clunky, filled with questionable mechanics and technical solutions, with a lot of esoteric systems that either need a Wiki open or make no sense regardless. This game has huge playability issues and Steam achievements' percentages reflect it justfully <<<

**Review after 1.0**
Thankfully, they improved technical state of the game. There are less bugs, the game stores its save files in the memory to minimize disk access times, game stutters way less, etc. However, player experience is still absolutely horrible (which is confirmed by achievements percentages). UI is awful (you can't even leave character creation menu), auto-tasking doesn't work properly half of the time, hauling is laughably inefficient (you haul one item at a time regardless of your inventory space and there is no *reasonable* item filtering system), pathfinding still completely fails beyond certain distance, controlling multiple characters is still a chore, super fast forward is better but still unreliable.

The worst thing about this game is badly designed game loop. It's more of a "game half-circle". You start with a debt, you can completely cover it in 3-5 game days and then money loose most of their value. Sure, you can buy some expensive real estate, but what's the point of this if your real estate is already docked to the station? Sure, you can buy some ship components from a vendor, but what's the point of this if the stock is random and the amount of hull parts is minuscule? Okay, instead of selling the components you can expand your ship. Cool. But it quickly hits practical limit and becomes purely an aesthetical activity (which is discouraging, because the process is very tedious and involves a lot of idle waiting). You can trade. Okay, but money don't really matter. You can flip ships. Nice, but there's not many uses for money. You can do high-paying missions. But they're repetitive and money aren't needed. In short, a lot of the game revolves around earning money, but money have almost no value past the very start of the game. Mods partially alleviate some of the issues but they can't fix game's core.



**Previous pre-release review** 
Don't look at my hour counter please, I played well over 100 hours of this game.
Overall, it's a great framework with functional simulations of a space scrapper's life and hazards. It needs more content, but mechanics are very solid, if a little bit intimidating to learn at first. And developer promised more content to come, so it's all good.

However. On the technical side game has multiple issues that are mainly the reason why this review is negative, unfortunately. 
- First of all, performance. Large ships lag a lot. Large amounts of NPCs lag a lot. The older the save, the more laggy it becomes. You *have* to use dev tools to debloat your save from time to time to keep game's performance adequate.
- Pathfinding. NPCs can't pathfind very well and can't pathfind at all beyond certain distance. Pathfinding between two ships can also be a challenge depending on both ships' sizes. This makes managing a crew or bulding up your ship a chore. You have to babysit crewmates at all times and make sure nobody is idling.
- Saves. This game juggles around a lot of data. It stores everything in JSON format, creating a separate file for every "ship" entity in the game, and packs each save in it's own archive. Due to how fractured saves are, they take a while to pack and unpack, which makes loading and saving the game take a while, even on a SSD. The game also doesn't save in a "quick" way, each save it goes over every single bit of data and creates new archive. It's taxing not only on player's time, but also on SSD's health. Game also allows a lot of garbage to accumulate on an older save, which includes all of the ships that flew outside of NPC salvagers' range of operations. On older save there could be dozens of pirate vessels drifting away to outer space which game has to account for. 
- Bugs. Every patch a lot of bugs get ironed out, yes, but there are still a lot of them present and very apparent. Ships can get stuck, NPCs can go to 4th dimension, constantly trying to pathfind out of it and eating away at performance, UI can break, shifts can break, super fast forward is unpredictable and unreliable, quests can break, etc.

If you can ignore all of the aforementioned issues, you can get a lot of fun out of Ostranauts. But I really want the developers to go over technical side of the game, because it's the weakest and the most crucial part of the experience in my opinion.
items.text_zh:
>>> 太长不看：这是一套全面的系统，用来模拟太空拾荒者的生活，但几乎没有真正去做的动力。它还极其笨拙，充斥着可疑的机制和技术方案，有大量晦涩难懂的系统，要么需要开着 Wiki，要么无论如何都说不通。这款游戏有巨大的可玩性问题，Steam 成就的百分比公正地反映了这一点 <<<

**1.0 之后的评测**
谢天谢地，他们改善了游戏的技术状态。Bug 更少了，游戏把存档文件存在内存中以尽量减少磁盘访问时间，游戏卡顿少多了，等等。然而，玩家体验仍然绝对糟糕（成就百分比证实了这一点）。UI 很糟糕（你甚至无法离开角色创建菜单），自动任务有一半时间不能正常工作，搬运效率低得可笑（无论你的库存空间有多大，你一次只能搬一件物品，而且没有*合理的*物品过滤系统），寻路在超过一定距离后仍然完全失效，控制多个角色仍然是一件苦差事，超级快进更好了但仍然不可靠。

这款游戏最糟糕的地方是设计糟糕的游戏循环。它更像是一个“游戏半圆”。你一开始背负债务，可以在 3-5 个游戏日内完全还清，然后钱就失去了大部分价值。当然，你可以买一些昂贵的房地产，但如果你的房地产已经停靠在空间站上，这又有什么意义呢？当然，你可以从供应商那里买一些飞船部件，但如果库存是随机的，而且船体部件的数量少得可怜，这又有什么意义呢？好吧，与其卖掉部件，你可以扩建你的飞船。很酷。但它很快就会触及实际限制，变成纯粹的美学活动（这令人沮丧，因为过程非常繁琐，涉及大量空闲等待）。你可以贸易。好吧，但钱并不真的重要。你可以倒卖飞船。不错，但钱没有多少用处。你可以做高报酬的任务。但它们重复性高，而且不需要钱。简而言之，游戏的大部分内容都围绕着赚钱，但在游戏刚开始之后，钱几乎没有任何价值。Mod 部分缓解了一些问题，但无法修复游戏的核心。



**之前的抢先体验评测**
请不要看我的小时数，我玩这款游戏远远超过 100 小时。
总体而言，这是一个很棒的框架，功能性地模拟了太空拾荒者的生活和危险。它需要更多内容，但机制非常扎实，尽管一开始学习起来有点吓人。而且开发者承诺会有更多内容，所以一切都好。

然而。在技术方面，游戏有多个问题，不幸的是，这些主要是这篇评测为负面的原因。
- 首先是性能。大型飞船会严重卡顿。大量 NPC 会严重卡顿。存档越旧，就越卡。你*必须*时不时使用开发者工具来精简你的存档，以保持游戏性能足够。
- 寻路。NPC 寻路能力很差，超过一定距离就完全无法寻路。根据两艘飞船的大小，在两艘飞船之间寻路也可能是个挑战。这使得管理船员或建造飞船成为一件苦差事。你必须时刻照看船员，确保没人在闲置。
- 存档。这款游戏要处理大量数据。它以 JSON 格式存储所有内容，为游戏中的每个“飞船”实体创建一个单独的文件，并将每个存档打包
放在它自己的存档里。由于存档碎片化严重，打包和解包需要一段时间，这使得加载和保存游戏都要花上一阵子，即使是在固态硬盘上也是如此。游戏也不是以“快速”方式保存的，每次保存都会遍历每一个数据位并创建新存档。这不仅消耗玩家的时间，也消耗固态硬盘的寿命。游戏还允许大量垃圾在旧存档中积累，其中包括所有飞出NPC打捞者作业范围之外的飞船。在旧存档中，可能有数十艘海盗船漂向外太空，而游戏必须对它们进行追踪处理。
- Bug。没错，每个补丁都会修掉很多bug，但仍然存在大量bug，而且非常明显。飞船可能卡住，NPC可能进入第四维度，不断尝试寻路脱离并消耗性能，UI可能崩溃，轮班可能崩溃，超级快进不可预测且不可靠，任务可能崩溃，等等。

如果你能忽略上述所有问题，你可以从《Ostranauts》中获得很多乐趣。但我真的希望开发者能好好处理游戏的技术层面，因为在我看来，这是整个体验中最薄弱、也最关键的部分。

items.text:
I've played this for about a hundred hours and I've had a lot of fun. I got my moneys worth out of it. That being said I probably wouldn't recommend buying it in current state. I have a few problems with it at the state it's in.

One, a lot of bugs. Loading/unloading large ships with multiple crewmembers breaks sometimes. I take the tram on one crewmember to level 2 of the station, do my stuff, take the tram back, my ship is no longer docked, my character has not traveled back to level 1, and the game is softlocked. Or the room bug where sometimes, randomly, your ship will just depressurize and fail to hold pressure until you uninstall and reinstall a wall in your ship. Or when the police won't interact with me after they force dock to inspect my ship, I undock, and they declare me resisting arrest. The bugs make what's a really good framework just unplayable.

Two, building a ship is tedious. The game progression of this is that you get handed a dumpster of a ship and a pile of debt, and you go scrapping to spruce your ship up with salvaged parts and sell your stuff. Eventually you get a large enough ship, build a reactor, and go travel the solar system since your reactor can propell you to everywhere else. I never got beyond the starting asteroid (to be fair you don't NEED to) to go explore Venus (the next main area) because of the bugs and the fact that making my ship the way I wanted it to be making felt like a job. I could just be a perfectionist but I just kind of dropped the game because it felt like work getting my ship to be the way I wanted it to be. 

The AI is not good, you need to babysit your crew or they might do stupid things. Leaving my game at FFW for 30, real life minutes while my guy goes and replaces floor tiles, punctuated every 10 minutes by me babysitting him taking off his suit, putting him on the toilet, taking a drink from a water bottle, and then putting the suit back on, is just bad gameplay and tedious. If you don't do this, your guy could starve, suffocate, or decompress himself or the ship.

Edit: 30 more hours a year later. 

They're still updating and fixing bugs. Most of the bugs I ran into seem to be fixed, and the room depressurization bug has been defined, if not patched. (don't save and reload with blueprints that go through walls or game'll fail to define your room or something) Construction is still tedious, but I know how to play the game and hired crew early on so that's not the end of the world. 

Complaints: AI is still really dumb. My gripe this save is about ship construction. I am a perfectionist and the best parts in the game are these walls and floors made by one specific manufacturer that are extra light, which matter for fuel consumption/efficiency. I go to deconstruct a ship made out of these parts, and put them on my ship. I put build orders on my ship, and deconstruction orders on the ship I'm scrapping. My crew AI will, if not stopped, go and pick up a single floor tile or cable conduit or whatever at a time and bring it back, work on it, and repeat. They have the capacity for ~50. This leads me to micromanage my crew which is annoying with one and impossible with two as I have to shift click a whole bunch of floor tiles. Crew AI will build things in the order that they're selected, which seems to be bottom to top, left to right, which in some cases can cause aggravating pathing, as they'll skip things right next to them and travel to go up to the next block regardless of distance if there is one. 

Crew pathfinding is poorly optimized and causes lots of lag (if you have more than one crew member it will slow your game to a crawl on higher FFW speeds) since they go over each task globally in order of creation and run a check on if they can or can not accomplish that task. 

The clickdrag menu has bounds poorly defined, game is made of tiles, sometimes a row of tiles is missed, most games solve this by having an overlay that pops up that shows which tiles are selected when you're clickdragging. Would be nice to see here. 

There are like, three locations in the game that you can travel to that are unique, the rest of the stations are copy pastes. Bit disappointing. 
/Complaints

I'll change my review to positive since they fixed some major bugs and seem to be committed to taking it all the way.
items.text_zh:
我已经玩了大约一百个小时，玩得非常开心。我觉得这钱花得值。话虽如此，以目前的状态，我大概不会推荐购买。就它现在的状态而言，我有几个问题。

第一，很多bug。装载/卸载有多名船员的大型飞船有时会出问题。我带着一名船员坐电车到空间站2层，办完事，坐电车回来，我的飞船不再停靠了，我的角色没有回到1层，游戏卡死了。或者房间bug，有时会随机出现，你的飞船会突然失压，并且无法保持压力，直到你卸下并重新安装飞船里的一面墙。或者警察强行停靠检查我的飞船后不与我互动，我解除停靠，他们就宣布我拒捕。这些bug让一个本来非常好的框架变得完全没法玩。

第二，建造飞船很繁琐。游戏进程是这样的：你拿到一艘垃圾一样的飞船和一堆债务，然后你去打捞，用回收来的零件把飞船整修一番，再卖掉你的东西。最终你得到一艘足够大的飞船，建造一个反应堆，然后去周游太阳系，因为你的反应堆能把你推进到其他任何地方。因为bug，以及把我飞船改成我想要的样子感觉像上班，我从未离开过起始小行星（公平地说，你并不需要离开）去探索金星（下一个主要区域）。我可能只是个完美主义者，但我还是有点放弃了这个游戏，因为把飞船弄成我想要的样子感觉像在工作。

The AI不好，你需要照看你的船员，否则他们可能会做蠢事。把我的游戏以快进速度放着30个现实分钟，让我的家伙去更换地板砖，每10分钟穿插一次我照看他脱掉宇航服、让他上厕所、从水瓶里喝口水，然后再把宇航服穿回去，这玩法就是糟糕又繁琐。如果你不这么做，你的家伙可能会饿死、窒息，或者把自己或飞船减压。

编辑：一年后又玩了30个小时。

他们仍在更新和修复bug。我遇到的大多数bug似乎都修好了，房间失压bug也已经被定义清楚了，即使还没打补丁。（不要带着穿墙的蓝图保存并重新加载，否则游戏会无法定义你的房间还是什么的）建造仍然繁琐，但我知道怎么玩这个游戏，而且很早就雇了船员，所以那也不是世界末日。

抱怨：AI还是真的很蠢。这次存档我的不满是关于飞船建造的。我是个完美主义者，游戏里最好的部件是某个特定制造商制造的这些墙和地板，它们特别轻，这对燃料消耗/效率很重要。我去拆解一艘由这些部件组成的飞船，把它们放到我的飞船上。我在我的飞船上下达建造命令，在我正在拆解的飞船上下达拆解命令。我的船员AI如果没人阻止，会一次只捡一块地板砖或一根电缆管或随便什么东西带回来，干一会儿，然后重复。他们的搬运容量大约有50。这导致我不得不微观管理我的船员，一个船员时很烦，两个船员时就不可能，因为我得按住Shift点击一大堆地板砖。船员AI会按照它们被选中的顺序建造东西，这个顺序似乎是从下到上、从左到右，这在某些情况下会导致令人恼火的寻路，因为它们会跳过就在旁边的东西，不管距离多远都跑去下一个方块，如果那里有一个的话。

船员寻路优化很差，会导致大量卡顿（如果你有不止一名船员，在较高的快进速度下游戏会慢得像爬一样），因为它们会按创建顺序全局遍历每个任务，并检查它们能否完成该任务。

点击拖拽菜单的边界定义很差，游戏是由方块组成的，有时会漏掉一行方块，大多数游戏解决这个问题的方法是弹出一个覆盖层，在你点击拖拽时显示选中了哪些方块。这里要是也能看到就好了。

游戏里大概有三个可以前往的独特地点，其余的空间站都是复制粘贴的。有点令人失望。
/抱怨

我会把评测改成好评，因为他们修复了一些主要bug，而且似乎决心把它做到底。
如果有的话。

船员寻路优化得很差，会导致大量卡顿（如果你有不止一名船员，在较高的快进速度下游戏会慢得像爬一样），因为他们会按创建顺序全局遍历每个任务，并检查他们能否完成该任务。

点击拖拽菜单的边界定义得很差，游戏是由格子组成的，有时会漏掉一整行格子，大多数游戏解决这个问题的方法是弹出一个覆盖层，在你点击拖拽时显示哪些格子被选中了。在这里能看到这个就好了。

游戏里大概只有三个可以前往的独特地点，其余的站点都是复制粘贴的。有点令人失望。
/抱怨结束

我会把我的评测改成好评，因为他们修复了一些重大bug，而且似乎决心把它一路做到底。

items.text:
This game is my new addiction. Haven't been playing for long, but I know I'll be on this for a WHOLE lot longer. At first, I was definitely stumped by the game's difficulty curve, especially ship navigation and the foreign UI. (I even ended up refunding it for a good day before immediately repurchasing it, thanks to privatel1mes' amazing series)

I tend to see learning this game as more of a molehill than a mountain. If you take breaks when you get frustrated and have fun trying to push the limits of the game, you'll find a foothold, start raking in cash and enjoy this game to its fullest. (also don't forget to save-scum as much as possible)

Overall, despite some reload-fixable bugs and slightly janky AI, this game shows a LOT of promise and already has me hooked, and could hook you too. Try it out!
items.text_zh:
这款游戏是我新的瘾。虽然还没玩多久，但我知道我会玩上长得多的时间。起初，我确实被游戏的难度曲线难住了，尤其是飞船导航和陌生的界面。（我甚至退款了整整一天，然后又立刻重新购买，多亏了privatel1mes的精彩系列）

我倾向于把学习这款游戏看作是小土堆而不是大山。如果你在感到沮丧时休息一下，并享受尝试突破游戏极限的乐趣，你就会找到立足点，开始大把赚钱，并尽情享受这款游戏。（另外别忘了尽可能多地存档作弊）

总的来说，尽管有一些可以通过重新加载修复的bug和略显笨拙的AI，这款游戏展现出很大的潜力，已经让我上瘾，也可能让你上瘾。试试吧！

items.text:
[[Early Access Review]]

While the concept of this game is something Ive been looking for in a game for quite awhile the flying mechanic just gets so tedious so quick that it ruins the fun from the other aspects of the game.  Trying to manage your social needs that degrade so quickly and trying to manage the poor AI of your crew also get tiring quite quickly.

Now I love the cassette Futurism theme of the game, the abailty to tear down floating space wrecks to sell scrap to make money and to upgrade and build out your own ship.  If the devs can tighten up the AI for the crew members, tweak how the social needs work and really adjust how flight controls work, honestly theres a place where ultra realism starts killing the fun and the Newtonian Physics here where you need to manually adjust every last aspect really crossed over that line to make it unfun and tedious.

Will check back in on this title in the next 6 months as I do really hope this can become a true diamond in the rough, at which point I will update my review to reflect how it stands then.
items.text_zh:
[[抢先体验评测]]

虽然这款游戏的概念正是我长期以来一直在游戏中寻找的东西，但飞行机制很快就变得如此繁琐，以至于破坏了游戏其他方面的乐趣。试图管理那些退化得如此之快社交需求，以及试图管理你那糟糕的船员AI，也很快就让人感到疲惫。

不过我喜欢这款游戏的卡带未来主义主题，能够拆解漂浮的太空残骸，把废料卖掉赚钱，并升级和建造自己的飞船。如果开发者能够收紧船员的AI，调整社交需求的运作方式，并真正调整飞行控制的运作方式，说实话，有些地方极端写实开始扼杀乐趣，而这里的牛顿物理学要求你手动调整每一个细节，真的越过了那条线，让它变得不好玩且繁琐。

我会在接下来的6个月里再回来看看这款作品，因为我真的希望它能成为一块真正的璞玉，到那时我会更新我的评测以反映它当时的状态。

One of the few games that compensates for lack of fancy graphics, 3D world or friendly UI with sheer gameplay. You salvage, you build, you earn and survive, all aboard veritable coffins that are proudly called 'spacecrafts'.

UI needs work, inventory needs a remake, learning curve needs a bit more help, character interractions can be a confusing mess, crew can be borderline unusable and NPCs are suicidal, yet despite that game is fun and keeps getting updates.

items.text:
Okay, I have a few hours more on the list now and it's still my "home between the stars" go-to cozy game. ;)

****
♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, what a really really great game?!? It's basically: Be a real person in space that is living on her space ship, trucking the space lanes. And you can even sit in your space kitchen made from salvage of plundered derelicts. Set your ship on a route. Leave the helm. Do things in the ship. Suddenly the alarm rings. There's wreckage on your route or you didn't watch the clock and are already a mere seconds away from crashing into Ganymed. Now run to get into the pilot seat. I love it. I'm 76 hours in. Because I was sick home last week, when I bought it!

Admittedly, there are some shadows. The UI is a little unintuitive. Left click move, right click show infos, which you get in the upper right. Then you have to look into the middle lower side of the screen to see interactions. That takes a moment to get used to it. A few other things. The AI, when you automatize crew ... uhm ... has room for improvements? The dialogue system is a hassle at it's current state. Too many options, too many repetitions. Expect bugs. Send bug reports to their discord.

But that's solvable and compared to the awesome home in space that you'll build? A small price zu pay.

EDIT: A few more hours in the game. It's still a gem, but with steadily improving UI and a decreasing number of bugs.
items.text_zh:
好吧，现在我的游戏时间又多了几个小时，它仍然是我“星际之间的家”的首选舒适游戏。;)

****
天哪，这真是一款非常非常棒的游戏？！？基本上就是：在太空中做一个真实的人，住在自己的飞船上，在太空航道上跑运输。你甚至可以坐在用掠夺废弃飞船残骸做成的太空厨房里。给你的飞船设定一条航线。离开驾驶位。在飞船里做点事。突然警报响了。你的航线上有残骸，或者你没看时间，已经离撞上木卫三只有几秒钟了。现在赶紧跑去坐到驾驶座上。我爱这个。我已经玩了76个小时。因为上周我生病在家，就买了它！

诚然，也有一些阴影。UI有点不直观。左键移动，右键显示信息，信息在右上角。然后你还得看屏幕中下方才能看到交互选项。这需要一点时间适应。还有几点别的。AI，当你自动化船员时……呃……还有改进空间？对话系统目前的状态很麻烦。选项太多，重复太多。做好遇到bug的准备。把bug报告发到他们的discord。

但这些都是可以解决的，和你将要建造的太空中的美妙家园相比？只是小小的代价。

编辑：又玩了几个小时。它仍然是一颗宝石，只是UI在稳步改进，bug数量也在减少。

items.text:
おすすめしにくい面白さ
スカベンジャーとして船を解体してパーツを売るか、廃船の権利を買い取ってまともな船に直して売り払うゲーム。
宇宙の廃船を自分の船に組み込んで自分好みの船を作っていく点や、センサーを通して宇宙に繰り出す感覚は得難い体験を齎してくれる。
クルーも特性が細かく存在していて個性があって雇うのも面白い。
廃船に辿り着いてどんなお宝や脅威が待っているのかワクワクしながらドッキングするのはとっても楽しい。

一方、作業の殆どに手間と時間がかかる。
仮にほぼ無傷の船を完全解体するとすれば現実時間でも何時間か見据える必要がある。
（ちゃんと言っておくと特段の理由がなければそんなことはしない）
あんまりAIがよくないのでオートにしても効率的に動かないし（床板を一枚ずつ運ぶとか）、必要な準備を整えたところでスーツの酸素を自動で取り換えてはくれないし、機材の充電もしてくれない。
おまけに暫く目を離すとなぜかヘルメットを宇宙空間で外して窒息死してるか、ヘルメットをかぶったまま何故食事ができないのか判らないまま餓死してくれる。
そんな訳でクルーを増やすとこの辺のマイクロマネジメントを強いられるが、現状アーリーの段階では設定は期待通りに働かない。

ともかく、ハマれば時間が吹き飛ぶことは間違いないが、バグやAI関連にダレ始めると苦痛になっていく。
オススメしにくいけれど、没入感があってロールプレイングゲームとしてとても優秀。
今後のアップデートでバグやクエスト関連やUIなどの改善を切望しています
items.text_zh:
难以推荐的有趣之处
这是一款作为拾荒者拆解飞船并出售零件，或者买下废弃飞船的权利，将其修好再卖掉的游戏。
将宇宙中的废弃飞船整合进自己的飞船，打造自己中意的飞船，以及通过传感器迈向宇宙的感觉，能带来难得的体验。
船员也有细致的特点，富有个性，雇佣他们也很有趣。
抵达废弃飞船，一边兴奋地期待有什么宝藏或威胁在等着，一边对接，非常有趣。

另一方面，几乎所有的作业都费时费力。
假设要完全拆解一艘几乎无损的飞船，即使按现实时间也需要好几个小时。
（说清楚一点，除非有特别理由，否则不会那么做）
AI 不太好，所以即使设为自动也不会高效运作（比如一块一块地搬运地板），即使做好了必要的准备，也不会自动更换宇航服的氧气，也不会给设备充电。
而且，稍微一不留神，不知为何就会在宇宙空间摘下头盔窒息而死，或者戴着头盔却不知为何无法进食，就这么饿死。
因此，增加船员就会被迫进行这方面的微观管理，但在目前的抢先体验阶段，设置并不能如预期般运作。

总之，一旦沉迷其中，时间肯定会飞逝，但一旦对 bug 和 AI 相关问题开始感到厌倦，就会变成痛苦。
虽然难以推荐，但很有沉浸感，作为角色扮演游戏非常优秀。
切望今后的更新能改善 bug、任务相关和 UI 等方面

items.text:
Wow!  This game has fantastic potential.  It hits something I've been wanting for a long time.  A gritty space sim where you crawl your way out of oppression through any means necessary... and it can surely be a grind... but as you find / build a more sustainable, more comfortable existence... it feels tangible and rewarding.  
 
Want to be a derelict ship salvager… check, want to work in refurbishing, buying damaged goods and selling higher, check… want to run cargo between stations working the economy... check.  Want to do gig work investigating murders and transporting special cargo… check.  Want to attack civilians and take of their hard earned efforts, check.  Want nuanced, impactful NPC interactions… check… Want to hire a crew to help you with any of the above, check.  And I should add… that all this simply feels like the groundwork.  It’s easy to see that there will be so much more.  However, in its current EA state… its still quite rough.  

Basically, there are a lot of jank and pathing issues.  For example, one of my character employees decided he needed to relieve himself.  Inside the ship... inside the safety of the pressurized, oxygenated cabin where he could safely remove his space suit and take care of that... instead, as he tries, I get an error message saying he can't while "airtight."  I think... ok, not bad... I can see why that might be important in some situations.  EXCEPT, then he walks out onto a derelict... unpressurized, bathroom... exposed to the vacuum of space... and then THROUGH his airtight suit... uses the bathroom.  Funny.  Essentially, the AI and game seems to lag / bog down or get more easily confused as your ship gets bigger and / or the tasks assigned become more complicated.  


Graphically the game is cute.  It captures a lot of detail about a wide range of parts… all of which can be interacted with in some way.  Some of the parts themselves could use some more detail… ie… do different hull types have different hp values, etc, but the look of the game is great.   

UI / Combat – This took some adjusting, but you start to appreciate the choices available… all things are done through narrative choices.  You choose your actions step by step in dialogue, in combat, and possibly other situations.   Also, I highly undervalued, at first, how relatable and engaging it was to see your character face and emotions (sometimes a bit over the top, but better than the standard nothing) 

Some suggestions for the Devs – More… more stuff… more reasons… better progression.  Suits could have Modular additions that enhance different things like movement or radiation resistance.  Different types of engines with different focuses and values.   Cooking would fit well in some fashion… as well as hydroponics that you can grow on your ship.  (Not looking for a farm sim, but some basics could be very congruent.) 

The learning curve is rather steep… and the found manuals in the game are DENSE… if you want to understand the Environmental settings for your ship, set up a better power supply, or learn about any number of other systems you must read… actual… in game… manuals.  No tutorials on this stuff yet as far as I know.  I understand the point and the added immersion, but a compromise might be good here.  The manuals might have linked tables of contents that flip you to the correct information / paragraph.  

Better interactions with your ship crew would be useful.   From the navigation console, for example, being able to issue ship wide instructions like … “prepare for departure” or “Prepare to be boarded.”

Piracy and Combat – This could do with another way to board another ship… or infiltrate a station.  Drop pods that burst through wall of a ship after some challenge similar to docking.  Also, a single pirate would likely be a bit more cautious than boldly walking onto a docked vessel with a crew of four gun wielding opponents.  This surely needs some balancing.  Being able to loot actually currency in ships seems like it would be useful as well.  Likewise, looking forward to seeing what the game does with the promised ship to ship.  

All in all, I do recommend this game based upon its potential.  Understand, though, that this is with the caveat that it is still noticeably early access and has many unfinished and unpolished systems.  If you want to support the devs in its current state, buy it now and give feedback… otherwise check back in some months as it is getting regular updates.  

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

As my hours might show, I've been playing this game quite a lot again.  First of all!   Much less jank.  A lot of the issues I mentioned before have been resolved or folded into in a way that feels authentic.  The game is making steady progress.   

What I'd like to see now is more in depth characters.  The dialogue options have a certain charm, but I think that they could be more robust or character relevant.  As it stands they feel a bit generic.... not to say that 100% unique is expected all the time, but more differentiation here would help distinguish NPCs.  On a similar note, more developed factions, standings with factions, missions, intrigue, alliances, and shades of gray... all could be fleshed out more.  Much in the way NPCs can be more readily Identifiable  and differentiable.   

It could also be nice to have different starts - i.e maybe instead of starting in debt to the bank paying off a ship that was your only way forward, maybe you start indebted to the crime / pirate syndicates around Venus or another faction in one way or another.   Or maybe you're not in debt at all... maybe the story derives even more from the choices you choose crafting your character.  

Either way... Mechanically speaking.  The grind to get a fusion reactor working on your ship is very long... especially if you don't understand it.  The manuals explain it decently, but it could be a bit better.  A subtle thing that might help with this could be that players can observe functioning ships with fully operational fusion systems earlier on, but have no access... or any attempt to steal a currently active ship would have serious consequences.  

Lastly, the crime system ( as well as the means and reasons to commit crime)  and law enforcement could be enhanced a bit.   I know the punishments increase in some other places, but its easy to exploit kleg a bit.   In addition, on the other hand, it would be fun if you could actually take over places from factions, by killing enough, but exploits like shoving them back by placing doors would have to be fixed first.  Also, it could also be that a place you control, if you've taken something over, could have attacks from factions.  

Anyway, 

Great Progress and can't wait to see more.
items.text_zh:
哇！这款游戏潜力巨大。它触及了我长久以来一直想要的东西。一个硬核的太空模拟游戏，你通过任何必要的手段从压迫中挣扎出来……这肯定可能很肝……但当你找到/建立起一种更可持续、更舒适的生活时……它感觉是实实在在的、有回报的。

想当一名废弃飞船打捞者……可以；想从事翻新工作，买受损货物再高价卖出……可以；想在空间站之间跑货运、玩转经济……可以。想接零工调查谋杀案、运送特殊货物……可以。想攻击平民、夺走他们辛苦赚来的成果……可以。想要细腻、有影响力的NPC互动……可以……想雇佣一支船员来帮你完成上述任何事……可以。我还应该补充……这一切感觉只是基础。很容易看出还会有更多内容。然而，在目前的EA状态下……它仍然相当粗糙。

基本上，有很多毛病和寻路问题。例如，我的一个角色员工决定他需要解手。在飞船里……在加压、供氧的舱室安全环境中，他可以安全地脱下太空服来处理这件事……结果，当他尝试时，我收到一条错误信息，说他在“气密”状态下不能这么做。我想……好吧，不错……我能理解为什么在某些情况下这很重要。但是，然后他走到一艘废弃飞船上……未加压的、厕所……暴露在太空真空中……然后透过他的气密服……上了厕所。好笑。本质上，随着你的飞船变大和/或分配的任务变得更复杂，AI和游戏似乎会卡顿/变慢或更容易混乱。


从画面来看，游戏很可爱。它捕捉了各种部件的许多细节……所有这些部件都能以某种方式互动。有些部件本身可以再多些细节……比如……不同船体类型是否有不同的生命值等等，但游戏的外观很棒。

UI/战斗——这需要一些适应，但你会开始欣赏可用的选择……所有事情都通过叙事选择来完成。你在对话、战斗以及可能其他情况中一步步选择你的行动。另外，我一开始严重低估了看到你的角色面部和情绪（有时有点夸张，但总比标准的什么都没有好）是多么有共鸣和吸引人。

给开发者的一些建议——更多……更多东西……更多理由……更好的进程。太空服可以有模块化附加装置，增强不同方面，比如移动或抗辐射能力。不同类型的引擎有不同的侧重点和数值。烹饪在某种程度上会很合适……还有可以在飞船上种植的水培。（不是想要农场模拟，但一些基础内容会非常契合。）

学习曲线相当陡峭……而且游戏中找到的手册非常密集……如果你想了解飞船的环境设置、建立更好的电源，或学习任何其他系统，你必须阅读……真正的……游戏内……手册。据我所知，目前还没有关于这些东西的教程。我理解其用意和增加的沉浸感，但折中方案可能不错。手册可以有链接目录，让你翻到正确的信息/段落。

与飞船船员更好的互动会很有用。例如，从导航控制台，能够发布全船指令，比如……“准备出发”或“准备接舷”。

海盗行为和战斗——这可以再有另一种登上另一艘船的方式……或潜入空间站。在类似对接的某种挑战后，用投放舱冲破飞船墙壁。另外，一个海盗很可能比大胆走上停靠的船只、面对四名持枪对手的船员要谨慎一些。这肯定需要一些平衡。能够掠夺飞船上的实际货币似乎也会很有用。同样，期待看到游戏在承诺的船对船方面会有什么表现。

总而言之，基于其潜力，我确实推荐这款游戏。但请理解，这是有前提的，即它仍明显处于抢先体验阶段，有许多未完成和未打磨的系统。如果你想在目前状态下支持开发者，现在就买并给出反馈……否则过几个月再回来看看，因为它正在定期更新。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

从我的游戏时长可以看出，我又玩了很多这款游戏。首先！毛病少多了。我之前提到的很多问题已经解决，或以感觉真实的方式融入了。游戏正在稳步进展。

我现在想看到的是更有深度的角色。对话选项有一定的魅力，但我认为它们可以更丰富或更与角色相关。就目前而言，它们感觉有点通用……不是说一直期望100%独特，但这里更多的差异化会有助于区分NPC。类似地，更发达的派系、与派系的关系、任务、阴谋、联盟和灰色地带……都可以进一步充实。就像NPC可以更容易被识别和区分一样。

有不同的开局也会不错——比如，也许不是一开始欠银行债务、要还清一艘你唯一前进之路的飞船，也许你一开始以某种方式欠金星周围的犯罪/海盗集团或另一个派系的债。或者也许你根本不欠债……也许故事更多地源自你塑造角色时所做的选择。

不管怎样……从机制上说。让飞船上的聚变反应堆运转起来的肝度非常长……尤其是如果你不理解它的话。手册解释得还算不错，但可以更好一点。一个可能有助于此的微妙之处是，玩家可以在早期观察到拥有完全运作聚变系统的飞船，但无法进入……或者任何试图偷窃一艘当前活跃飞船的行为都会有严重后果。

最后，犯罪系统（以及犯罪的手段和理由）和执法可以稍微增强。我知道在其他一些地方惩罚会增加，但很容易稍微利用kleg。此外，另一方面，如果你能通过杀足够多的人真正从派系手中接管地方，那会很有趣，但像通过放置门把他们推回去这样的漏洞必须先修复。另外，也可能是你控制的地方，如果你接管了什么，可能会遭到派系的攻击。

总之，

进步很大，迫不及待想看到更多。
发布全舰指令，比如……“准备出发”或“准备接舷。”

海盗行为与战斗——这方面可以再增加一种登上另一艘船……或潜入空间站的方式。投放舱在经历某种类似对接的挑战后冲破船体墙壁。另外，单个海盗很可能会比大胆地走进一艘停靠着的、船上有四名持枪对手的飞船更谨慎一些。这肯定需要一些平衡。能够掠夺飞船上的实际货币似乎也会很有用。同样，期待看到游戏如何处理承诺的船对船战斗。

总而言之，基于其潜力，我确实推荐这款游戏。但请理解，这是附带一个前提的，即它仍明显处于抢先体验阶段，有许多未完成和未打磨的系统。如果你想在其当前状态下支持开发者，现在就买并给出反馈……否则过几个月再回来看看，因为它正在定期更新。

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

正如我的游戏时长可能显示的那样，我又玩了这款游戏相当多的时间。首先！卡顿少多了。我之前提到的很多问题已经解决，或以某种感觉真实的方式融入了游戏。游戏正在稳步推进。

我现在希望看到的是更有深度的角色。对话选项有一种特定的魅力，但我认为它们可以更丰富，或与角色更相关。就目前而言，它们感觉有点泛泛……不是说一直期待100%独一无二，但这里更多的差异化会有助于区分NPC。类似地，更发达的派系、与派系的关系、任务、阴谋、联盟和灰色地带……都可以进一步充实。就像NPC可以更容易被识别和区分那样。

有不同的开局也会不错——比如，也许不是一开始就欠银行债、要偿还一艘你唯一前进之路的飞船，也许你一开始以某种方式欠金星周围的犯罪/海盗辛迪加或另一个派系的债。或者也许你根本不欠债……也许故事更多地源自你塑造角色时所做的选择。

不管怎样……从机制上说。让你的飞船上的聚变反应堆运转起来的刷取过程非常漫长……尤其是在你不理解它的时候。手册解释得还算不错，但本可以更好一点。一个可能有助于此的细微之处是，玩家可以更早观察到拥有完全可用聚变系统的正常运转飞船，但无法进入……或者任何试图偷窃一艘当前活跃飞船的行为都会有严重后果。

最后，犯罪系统（以及犯罪的手段和理由）和执法可以稍微增强一些。我知道在其他一些地方惩罚会增加，但很容易稍微利用kleg。此外，另一方面，如果你能通过杀足够多的人真正从派系手中接管地点，那会很有趣，但像通过放置门把它们推回去这样的漏洞必须先修复。另外，也可能是，如果你接管了某个地方，你所控制的地点可能会遭到派系攻击。

总之，

进步很大，迫不及待想看到更多。

I love the game, but it's simply far too buggy to recommend at this time. 

Expanding your ship? Die of hypoxia! Standing around the station? Blacking out due to high G-force! 
Constant stuttering/lag, sometimes items will just disappear, sometimes saves will just break, sometimes ships will just rotate wildly or disappear and sometimes NPC's will just die for no reason.
